https://www.premiumtimesng.com/regional/.body: The Senate on Tuesday approved President Bola Tinubu’s request to reimburse the Yobe State Government ₦100.5 billion for the construction of the Muhammadu Buhari International Cargo Airport in Damaturu, the state capital. The decision was taken after considering a report of the Senate Committee on Local and Foreign Debts, presented during the plenary by its Chairman, Aliyu Wamakko (APC, Sokoto North). The reimbursement will be made through promissory notes. A promissory note is a written and signed commitment to pay a specified sum of money to a named person or the bearer, either on a specified date or on demand. President Tinubu requested the reimbursement in October after the federal government took control of the airport ownership. Mr Wamakko said committee members met on 27 October to review documents related to the president’s request. He said the committee established that the Federal Ministry of Aviation had confirmed the airport’s construction through a technical audit, which indicated the project was fully completed and complied with international standards. The senator also said the contract was awarded in compliance with Bureau of Public Procurement (BPP) requirements. He added that the airport was fully constructed and operational, with flights already taking off, making it ready for federal takeover. After the presentation, Senate President Godswill Akpabio put the request to a voice vote, and most lawmakers voted in favour

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.summary: The All Progressives Congress (APC) has accused the African Democratic Congress (ADC) and the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) of sponsoring violence, spreading misinformation and recruiting young Nigerians to disrupt its presidential campaign activities ahead of the 2027 general elections.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.summary_zh: 全进步大会党（APC）指控非洲民主大会（ADC）和尼日利亚民主党（NDC）策划暴力活动、散布虚假信息，并招募尼日利亚青年干扰其总统竞选活动，以破坏2027年大选前的竞选活动。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.body: The All Progressives Congress (APC) has accused the African Democratic Congress (ADC) and the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC) of sponsoring violence, spreading misinformation and recruiting young Nigerians to disrupt its presidential campaign activities ahead of the 2027 general elections. The ruling party alleged that opposition elements were using hoodlums, artificial intelligence-generated images, deepfakes, fake news and sponsored protests to create tension around its campaigns and undermine public confidence in President Bola Tinubu’s administration. Dele Alake, spokesperson for the APC Presidential Campaign Council, made the allegations in a statement on Tuesday, against the backdrop of recent attacks and confrontations involving political parties and their supporters nationwide. The statement comes days after suspected political thugs disrupted an NDC town hall meeting in Ikeja, Lagos, on 12 November, where the party’s presidential candidate, Peter Obi, was expected to address supporters. Several vehicles were damaged during the confrontation, while videos circulating online showed people wielding sticks and chairs as they attacked NDC supporters. A day later, Mr Tinubu faced protests at the Shehu Shagari Central Mosque in Area 1, Abuja, where some worshippers chanted slogans against him as his convoy departed after Friday prayers. Although a presidential aide initially disputed reports that the convoy was attacked, the Federal Capital Territory Police Command subsequently confirmed that 78 suspects had been arrested over the incident. The police said some individuals threw stones and other dangerous objects at the departing convoy, damaging several vehicles and injuring security operatives. The command also disclosed that Mr Tinubu had extended clemency to the suspects and directed that they be cautioned and released. Against this background, Mr Alake said the APC had warned Nigerians ahead of the flag-off of its presidential campaign in Kaduna on 24 October about what it described as opposition plans to introduce violence and discord into political campaigns. He alleged that the ADC and NDC had developed strategies involving deepfakes, AI-generated images, fake news and sponsored protests to manipulate public opinion and spread falsehoods about the president, the APC and preparations for the 2027 elections. According to him, the alleged activities were intended to create a false impression of widespread public discontent against Mr Tinubu. “These unpatriotic and disingenuous plots by opposition elements have started unfolding. Their major objective is to deceive Nigerians and the international community by driving a narrative of discontent against President Tinubu,” he said. He cited the incident at the Abuja mosque as an example of what he described as an anti-democratic tactic, alleging that individuals mobilised by the opposition pelted the presidential motorcade with stones. The APC spokesperson commended security personnel attached to the presidential convoy for exercising restraint during the incident. He also praised Mr Tinubu for directing the police command in Abuja to release those detained over the incident, describing the president’s intervention as a demonstration of restraint. The ruling party also expressed concern over alleged threats and violence against its members and supporters in the South-east. Mr Alake claimed that some APC members in the region had been threatened and labelled saboteurs for refusing to support Mr Obi, whom he identified as the NDC presidential candidate. He also accused opposition-sponsored agents of destroying APC campaign billboards under the cover of darkness, describing the incidents as unacceptable and contrary to democratic principles. The APC spokesperson said the party supported peaceful, credible, free and fair elections and insisted that all political parties and candidates should be allowed to operate freely across the country. He called on the ADC and NDC leadership to discourage the recruitment of young Nigerians for activities that could expose them to violence and endanger their lives. “Again, we call on the ADC and NDC leaders to stop the dangerous conscription of ignorant young Nigerians for unwholesome political activities that put their lives at risk, while those leaders’ own children luxuriate in splendour abroad,” he said
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.title_zh: 全进步大会党指责非洲民主联盟和全国民主大会党在2027年选举前煽动暴力、散布虚假信息
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/head.body_zh: 全进步大会党（APC）指控非洲民主大会（ADC）和尼日利亚民主党（NDC）策划暴力活动、散布虚假信息，并在2027年大选前招募尼日利亚青年，扰乱其总统竞选活动。执政党声称，反对派正利用流氓、人工智能生成的图像、深度伪造技术、假新闻和受操纵的抗议活动，在其竞选活动周围制造紧张局势，削弱公众对总统博拉·蒂努布政府的信任。APC总统竞选委员会发言人Dele Alake于周二发表声明提出这些指控。此前，全国各地发生了涉及政党及其支持者的多起袭击和冲突。这份声明发布前数日，疑似政治打手于11月12日扰乱了NDC在拉各斯伊凯贾举行的一场城镇会议；该党总统候选人Peter Obi原本应在会上向支持者发表讲话。冲突期间，多辆汽车受损，网上流传的视频显示，有人手持棍棒和椅子袭击NDC支持者。一天后，Tinubu先生遭遇抗议；周五祈祷结束后，其车队离开阿布贾Area 1的Shehu Shagari中央清真寺时，部分礼拜者高喊反对他的口号。尽管总统助理起初否认车队遭到袭击的报道，联邦首都辖区警察司令部后来证实，当局已就这起事件逮捕78名嫌疑人。警方称，一些人向驶离的车队投掷石块及其他危险物品，损坏多辆汽车并导致安全人员受伤。该司令部还披露，Tinubu先生已对嫌疑人予以宽恕，并指示对他们进行警告后释放。在此背景下，Alake先生表示，APC已于10月24日在卡杜纳启动总统竞选活动前提醒尼日利亚公众，称反对派计划在政治竞选中引入暴力和纷争。他声称，ADC和NDC制定了利用深度伪造技术、人工智能生成的图像、假新闻及受操纵的抗议活动来操纵舆论、散布关于总统、APC以及2027年大选筹备工作的虚假信息的策略。据他称，这些活动的目的是制造公众普遍不满Tinubu先生的假象。他说：“反对派这些不爱国且不真诚的阴谋已经开始实施。他们的主要目标是欺骗尼日利亚人民和国际社会，煽起针对Tinubu总统的不满叙事。”他以阿布贾清真寺事件为例，称这是他所描述的反民主手段；他指称，反对派动员的一些人向总统车队投掷了石块。APC发言人赞扬了随行保护总统车队的安全人员在事件中保持克制。他还赞扬Tinubu先生指示阿布贾警察司令部释放因这起事件而被拘留的人员，称总统的干预体现了克制。执政党还对其成员和支持者在东南部遭遇的所谓威胁与暴力活动表示关切。Alake先生声称，该地区一些APC成员因拒绝支持他认定为NDC总统候选人的Obi先生而遭到威胁，并被贴上破坏分子的标签。他还指控由反对派支持的特工趁夜破坏APC竞选广告牌，称这些事件不可接受，违背民主原则。APC发言人表示，该党支持和平、可信、自由和公正的选举，并坚持所有政党和候选人都应获准在全国自由开展活动。他呼吁ADC和NDC领导层停止招募尼日利亚青年参与可能使他们遭受暴力、危及生命的活动。他说：“我们再次呼吁ADC和NDC领导人停止以不良政治活动之名，危险地征召无知的尼日利亚青年，使他们的生命面临风险，而那些领导人自己的子女却在国外过着奢华生活。”

The Black Challenge booked their place in the knockout stage after thrashing Iraq 6-0 in their final Group D match to finish second with four points. https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111800.body: (워싱턴=연합뉴스) 백나리 특파원 = 김진아 외교부 2차관은 대미투자 이행과 조선 협력에 있어 규제 간소화와 비자 제도 손질 등이 필요하다며 미 행정부와 의회 차원의 지원을 촉구했다. 김 차관은 17일(현지시간) 미 워싱턴DC 싱크탱크 허드슨연구소에서 '한미 경제안보와 산업역량 강화'를 주제로 열린 제10차 한미 민관합동 경제포럼의 기조연설을 맡아 이같이 밝혔다. 김 차관은 에너지와 조선 두 분야에서의 양국 협력을 거론하면서 "협력 가속화를 위해서는 규제를 간소화하고 승인 절차를 효율화하며 전문가 및 기술인력의 이동을 용이하게 하는 비자 제도가 필요하다"고 말했다. 김 차관은 3천500억 달러 규모의 대미투자 내역을 설명하면서 텍사스 가스화력발전소와 원전 협력은 거론했으나 알래스카 액화천연가스(LNG) 프로젝트는 언급하지 않았다. 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령은 한국 정부의 대미투자금 중 500억 달러가 알래스카 LNG 프로젝트에 투입된다고 일방적으로 주장했으나 한국 정부는 사업 타당성 검토를 거쳐 투자 여부를 결정한다는 방침이다. 행사에 참석한 엘리자베스 어배너스 미 에너지부 차관보는 한미 협력의 중요성을 역설하면서 "이런 프로젝트들과 미국 내 투자들이 실현되도록 해야 한다"고 강조했다. 커트 캠벨 전 미 국무부 부장관은 트럼프 대통령의 북미정상회담 추진과 관련해 "북한을 핵보유국으로 인정하는 것이 미국이나 한국의 이익에 부합한다고 보지 않는다"면서 대북 접근에 있어 한미 간 긴밀한 공조가 필요하다고 지적했다. 캠벨 전 부장관은 19일 예정된 미중러 정상회담에서 좋은 결과가 도출될지에 대해서도 회의적 시각을 보이면서 "트럼프 대통령이 동맹 및 파트너와 협력할 때보다 중러 정상 같은 인물들과 함께 있을 때 더 편안해 보인다"고 꼬집었다. 그는 미국과 일본, 호주, 인도가 '쿼드' 정상회의를 개최하도록 마코 루비오 국무장관이 트럼프 대통령을 설득한 것은 다행이지만 사전 준비는 전혀 없었다고 지적하기도 했다. 조셉 윤 전 미 국무부 대북정책특별대표는 김정은 북한 국무위원장이 러시아와의 협력 등을 통한 위상 강화로 트럼프 대통령과의 회담을 서두를 것 같지 않다고 내다봤다. 그는 전시작전통제권 전환이나 핵추진잠수함 도입과 관련해서도 트럼프 대통령의 남은 임기 2년 사이에 이뤄질 수 있을지 불확실하다면서 백악관이 이를 주도해야 하는데 그런 에너지나 열의가 있을지 의문이라 완수가 쉽지 않을 것이라는 의견도 피력했다. 웬디 커틀러 전 미 무역대표부(USTR) 부대표는 미국의 입장에서 일본과 비교했을 때 한국의 대미투자 이행 속도와 범위가 기대에 미치지 못했으나 한국이 제 궤도에 오르기 시작하면서 이같은 불만이 해소될 수 있을 것이라고 전망했다. 커틀러 전 부대표는 디지털 분야를 비롯해 여러 분야에서 미국이 한국의 규제에 불만을 갖고 있다면서 한미관계를 다시 정상궤도에 올려놓는 것이 양측의 강력한 이익에 부합하며 한미관계 악화를 내버려 둘 여유가 없다고 강조했다. 이날 행사에는 빌 해거티 미 연방 상원의원도 참석했다. 그는 "알래스카 LNG 파이프라인 사업의 구매계약이든 미국의 조선업 확대든 (한국의 대미투자) 3천500억 달러의 이행을 우선으로 삼고 더 많은 협력 기회를 모색하자"고 했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/18 05:37 송고 2026년11월18일 05시37분 송고
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111800.title_zh: 外交次官：为加快韩美合作，需要简化监管并改善签证
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111800.body_zh: （华盛顿＝韩联社）驻美特派记者金진아（Kim Jin-ah）＝韩国外交部第二次官金真雅表示，在落实对美投资和加强造船合作方面，需要简化监管、完善签证制度等，并呼吁美国行政当局和国会提供支持。金次官17日（当地时间）在美国华盛顿哥伦比亚特区Hudson研究所举行、以“韩美经济安全与产业能力强化”为主题的第10届韩美民间联合经济论坛上发表主旨演讲，并作出上述表示。金次官谈及能源和造船两个领域的两国合作时称：“为加快合作，需要简化监管、提高审批程序效率，并建立便于专家和技术人员流动的签证制度。”金次官在说明规模为3500亿美元的对美投资明细时，提到了得克萨斯州燃气发电厂和核电站合作，但没有提及阿拉斯加液化天然气（LNG）项目。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普单方面声称，韩国政府对美投资资金中有500亿美元将投入阿拉斯加LNG项目，但韩国政府表示，将在审查项目可行性后决定是否投资。出席活动的美国能源部副部长伊丽莎白·瓦伦表示了韩美合作的重要性，强调：“必须确保此类项目以及美国境内的各项投资能够落实。”美国前国务院常务副国务卿库尔特·坎贝尔谈及特朗普总统推动举行北美领导人峰会时表示：“我认为，承认朝鲜为核武国家不符合美国或韩国的利益。”他指出，在处理朝鲜问题时，韩美之间需要紧密协作。坎贝尔前副国务卿还对定于19日举行的中俄领导人会议能否取得良好结果表示怀疑，并称：“特朗普总统与中俄领导人这样的人在一起时，似乎比与盟友及伙伴合作时更自在。”他还指出，外交部长马可·鲁比奥说服特朗普总统召集美国、日本、澳大利亚和印度举行“四方”领导人会议是件好事，但事前完全没有准备。美国国务院前对朝政策特别代表约瑟夫·尹预计，金正恩朝鲜劳动党委员长似乎不会急于通过与俄罗斯合作等方式提升自身地位，与特朗普总统举行会谈。谈及战时作战指挥权转换或引进核动力潜艇，他表示不确定这些事项能否在特朗普总统剩余的两年任期内实现，并认为白宫应发挥主导作用，但对其是否有足够意愿和热情表示怀疑，因此认为难以完成。 美国前贸易代表办公室（USTR）副代表温迪·卡特勒表示，从美国角度看，韩国落实对美投资的速度和规模不及与日本相比时的预期，但随着韩国开始走上正轨，这类不满可能会得到化解。卡特勒前副代表称，包括数字领域在内，美国对韩国的监管在多个领域存在不满，并强调，让韩美关系重新回到正常轨道符合双方重大利益，双方没有余地纵容韩美关系恶化。当天出席活动的还有美国联邦参议员比尔·哈格蒂。他说：“无论是阿拉斯加LNG管道项目的采购合同，还是美国造船业扩张，都应优先落实（韩国对美投资）3500亿美元，并 seeks 寻求更多合作机会。” 本报通过KakaoTalk okjebo发送 <版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载・再分发，禁止用于AI学习及使用> 2026/11/18 05:37发送 2026年11月18日 05时37分发送

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary_zh: COP31主席国提议，到2035年将发展中国家的年度气候适应资金至少提高至1200亿美元，同时呼吁加快行动，逐步淘汰化石燃料。根据第73段，主席国提议，到2035年将适应资金增至三倍的行动规模应达到每年至少1200亿美元。然而，2024年发达国家向发展中国家提供的国际公共适应资金为282亿美元至317亿美元。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: The COP31 Presidency has proposed increasing annual climate adaptation finance for developing countries to at least $120 billion by 2035, while calling for accelerated action to phase out fossil fuels. The proposals are contained in an 18-page draft cover decision released on 16 November as negotiations entered their second week at the ongoing United Nations climate conference in Antalya, Türkiye. The document outlines proposed actions on climate finance, energy transition, health, workers’ rights, oceans and gender equality, among other issues. However, it also highlights gaps in how it addresses agriculture and food systems, which are important to climate adaptation and mitigation. The draft remains an unedited negotiating document and does not represent an agreement among participating countries. Its provisions are subject to further negotiations before the conference concludes on 20 November. Under paragraph 73, the Presidency proposes that efforts to triple adaptation finance by 2035 should reach at least $120 billion annually. It also calls on developed countries to increase their collective financial support to developing countries and provide a roadmap showing how the target will be achieved. The proposal comes amid a significant shortfall in funding available to countries already experiencing the effects of climate change. The United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP), in its 2026 Adaptation Gap Report released earlier this month, estimated that developing countries would require approximately $305 billion annually by 2035 to meet their adaptation needs. However, international public adaptation finance from developed to developing countries stood at between $28.2 billion and $31.7 billion in 2024. UNEP warned that even if the existing international ambition to triple adaptation finance by 2035 is achieved, it would cover only 20 to 29 per cent of estimated needs. The COP31 proposal also acknowledges the difficulties developing countries face in accessing climate finance, including high borrowing costs, limited fiscal space, unsustainable debt and complicated funding procedures. It consequently encourages greater provision of public, grant-based and highly concessional finance, rather than loans that could further increase the debt burden of vulnerable countries. Another proposed measure is establishing the Antalya-to-Addis Ababa Roadmap on Adaptation and Resilience Finance. The initiative would identify predictable sources of public funding for adaptation and loss and damage, with its findings expected to be presented for consideration at COP32 in 2027. The draft also highlights the disparity between financial requests from countries experiencing climate-related losses and the resources available through the Fund for responding to Loss and Damage (FRLD). Paragraph 84 states that requests submitted under the fund’s Barbados Implementation Modality total about $2.8 billion, compared with available allocations of about $342 million. It further notes that only 50 per cent of the $822 million pledged to the fund has reportedly been converted into contributions. The Presidency is proposing that developed countries announce ambitious financial pledges to the loss and damage fund and other climate funds by the end of 2027. The figures highlight the difference between financial commitments announced by governments and the resources actually made available to affected countries and communities. Beyond climate finance, the document includes proposals accelerating the transition away from fossil fuels, an issue that remains contentious in international climate negotiations. Paragraph 65 reaffirms the commitment made at COP28 in Dubai to transition away from fossil fuels in energy systems in a just, orderly and equitable manner. Paragraph 66 goes further, calling for accelerated action to phase out fossil fuels, including an immediate transition away from their use in energy systems. The proposed language is significant because it moves beyond the broader commitment to transition away from fossil fuels toward more explicit action to phase them out. The draft also proposes increasing electricity’s share of total final energy consumption to 35 per cent by 2035, alongside efforts to triple global renewable energy capacity and double the annual rate of energy efficiency improvements by 2030. On methane emissions, it encourages improved measurement and reporting, rapid d detection and repair, and the elimination of routine gas flaring and venting. However, the document clarifies that these are global efforts to which countries would contribute according to their national circumstances. They do not establish specific targets or obligations for individual countries. The Presidency also addresses the social and economic implications of moving towards low-emission economies. Paragraphs 111 and 112 call for just transition pathways that would enable developing countries to participate in technology value chains, strengthen industrial capacity and create decent employment. The draft recognises workers’ rights, decent work and quality jobs as central to effective climate action. It also stresses the need to protect workers and their families from the social and economic consequences of technological and industrial changes. However, translating these provisions into practical protections will require more than recognising workers’ rights in a climate agreement. It will also depend on workers’ and trade unions’ participation in decisions affecting their livelihoods, as well as adequate funding for skills development and economic diversification. Despite their importance to climate adaptation, mitigation and livelihoods, agriculture and food systems receive limited attention in the proposed decision. The document contains no dedicated provisions setting out measures for food systems adaptation or mitigation, including specific action on agricultural methane emissions. Although it references food and nutrition insecurity in its discussion of climate-related health impacts, as well as the contribution of forests to food security, these references do not amount to a comprehensive approach to climate-resilient food production and supply systems. This omission is particularly relevant to developing countries, where climate-related disruptions to rainfall, rising temperatures, flooding, d drought threaten agricultural production, food availability, d rural livelihoods. For countries such as Nigeria, where agriculture remains an important source of employment and livelihoods, stronger attention to climate-resilient agriculture and food systems is essential to addressing the wider economic and social consequences of climate change. The draft recognises that climate change is already affecting physical and mental health, particularly in vulnerable communities. It identifies heat stress, malaria, dengue, cholera, maternal health risks, food and nutrition insecurity, and damage to health facilities during extreme weather events among the impacts requiring attention. It consequently calls for countries to integrate health considerations into their national adaptation and climate plans, while strengthening climate information and early warning systems to protect public health. For mountain regions, paragraph 31 proposes a dedicated work programme on climate change, a standing agenda item under the Conference of the Parties and a high-level dialogue at COP32. The document also encourages countries to incorporate sustainable ocean-based measures into their national climate commitments and adaptation plans, supported by predictable finance, technology and capacity-building. On inclusion, it calls for meaningful participation by Indigenous Peoples, women, children, young people, persons with disabilities and local communities in climate action and decision-making. The draft also addresses developing countries’ concerns about unilateral climate-related trade measures. Paragraph 115 expresses concern that such measures could transfer the economic burden of climate action to developing countries, with consequences for market access, competitiveness, investment and industrialisation. It proposes discussions on common guiding principles for climate-related trade measures, including transparency, non-discrimination and interoperability. Paragraph 119 further calls on developed countries to phase out unilateral climate-related trade-restrictive measures and other measures that negatively affect international climate cooperation by the end of 2027. The proposals reflect wider concerns among developing countries that climate policies adopted by wealthier economies should not create additional economic barriers for countries with fewer resources to transition to low-emission industries. The proposals come as countries enter the final stretch of COP31, with major disagreements still to be resolved. COP31 President of Negotiations Chris Bowen said more than 100 agenda items and around 60 significant mandates remained under consideration, covering issues including climate finance, adaptation, mitigation and just transition. COP31 President Murat Kurum said the coming week would be crucial to translating the progress made during the conference into concrete decisions. “We will intensify our ministerial-level consultations and work hard to translate the issues under consideration by countries into common decisions,” Mr Kurum said. Mr Bowen also acknowledged that some provisions in the draft would not receive support from all participating countries, describing the document as an early basis for discussions ahead of further negotiations. As the conference approaches its scheduled conclusion on 20 November, countries will have to resolve differences over climate finance, the future of fossil fuels and support for vulnerable nations

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: COP31主席国提议，到2035年将发展中国家的年度气候适应资金至少增加至1200亿美元，同时呼吁加快行动，逐步淘汰化石燃料。相关提议载于11月16日发布的一份18页决定草案封面文件中；当时，正在土耳其安塔利亚举行的联合国气候大会谈判进入第二周。该文件概述了在气候资金、能源转型、健康、工人权利、海洋和性别平等等议题上的拟议行动。不过，文件也指出，其对农业和粮食系统的处理存在不足，而农业和粮食系统对气候适应与减缓十分重要。草案仍是一份未经编辑的谈判文件，并不代表参与国之间已经达成协议。在大会于11月20日闭幕前，相关条款仍需进一步谈判。根据第73段，主席国提议，将到2035年把适应资金增至三倍的努力落实为每年至少1200亿美元。主席国还呼吁发达国家增加对发展中国家的集体资金支持，并提供一份路线图，说明如何实现这一目标。该提议出台之际，已经受到气候变化影响的国家获得的资金仍存在严重缺口。联合国环境规划署在本月早些时候发布的《2026年适应差距报告》中估计，到2035年，发展中国家每年需要约3050亿美元才能满足适应需求。然而，2024年发达国家向发展中国家提供的国际公共适应资金仅为282亿至317亿美元。联合国环境规划署警告称，即使现有的到2035年将适应资金增至三倍的国际雄心得以实现，也只能满足估算需求的20%至29%。COP31的提议还承认，发展中国家在获取气候资金时面临诸多困难，包括借款成本高、财政空间有限、债务不可持续以及资金拨付程序复杂。因此，该提议鼓励增加公共资金、赠款和优惠程度极高的资金，而不是提供可能进一步加重脆弱国家债务负担的贷款。另一项拟议措施是建立“安塔利亚至亚的斯亚贝巴适应与韧性融资路线图”。该倡议将确定适应以及损失与损害领域的可预测公共资金来源，其研究结果预计将提交2027年COP32审议。草案还指出，正在遭受气候相关损失的国家提出的资金申请，与损失与损害应对基金（FRLD）能够提供的资源之间存在差距。第84段称，根据该基金的《巴巴多斯实施模式》提交的申请总额约为28亿美元，而可用拨款约为3.42亿美元。该段进一步指出，据报道，认捐给该基金的8.22亿美元中，只有50%已转化为实际缴款。主席国提议，发达国家应在2027年底前宣布面向损失与损害基金及其他气候基金的雄心勃勃的资金承诺。这些数字凸显了各国政府宣布的资金承诺与实际提供给受影响国家和社区的资源之间的差距。除气候资金外，文件还提出了加快摆脱化石燃料的提议，而这一议题在国际气候谈判中仍存在争议。第65段重申了COP28在迪拜作出的承诺，即以公正、有序和公平的方式推动能源系统摆脱化石燃料。第66段更进一步，呼吁加快行动淘汰化石燃料，包括立即停止在能源系统中使用化石燃料。拟议措辞意义重大，因为它不再仅仅停留于较为宽泛的摆脱化石燃料承诺，而是转向采取更加明确的淘汰行动。草案还提议，到2035年将电力在终端能源消费总量中的占比提高至35%，同时努力到2030年将全球可再生能源装机容量增至三倍，并将能源效率改善速度提高至每年两倍。在甲烷排放方面，草案鼓励改进测量和报告工作，迅速发现和修复泄漏，并停止常规天然气燃烧和放空。不过，文件明确说明，这些都是各国将根据自身国情参与落实的全球行动，不对单个国家设定具体目标或义务。主席国还处理了向低排放经济转型所带来的社会和经济影响。第111和112段呼吁制定公正转型路径，使发展中国家能够参与技术价值链、强化工业能力并创造体面就业。草案将工人权利、体面劳动和高质量就业视为有效气候行动的核心，并强调需要保护工人及其家庭免受技术和产业变化带来的社会与经济后果。然而，要将这些条款转化为切实保护，仅在气候协定中承认工人权利是不够的。相关保护还取决于工人和工会能否参与影响其生计的决策，以及是否有充足资金用于技能发展和经济多元化。尽管农业和粮食系统对气候适应、减缓及生计至关重要，草案决定却仅对其给予有限关注。文件没有专门条款列出粮食系统适应或减缓措施，也没有就农业甲烷排放提出具体行动。尽管文件在讨论气候相关健康影响时提及粮食和营养不安全，并在讨论森林对粮食安全的贡献时作出相关表述，但这些提及不足以构成一套完整的、具有气候韧性的粮食生产和供应体系方案。这一缺失对发展中国家尤其重要，因为在这些国家，与气候有关的降雨变化、气温上升、洪涝和干旱正威胁农业生产、食物供应和农村生计。对尼日利亚等农业仍是重要就业和生计来源的国家而言，更重视具有气候韧性的农业和粮食系统，对于应对气候变化带来的广泛经济和社会后果至关重要。草案承认，气候变化已经对身心健康产生影响，脆弱社区尤其如此。文件列出了需要关注的影响，包括热应激、疟疾、登革热、霍乱、孕产妇健康风险、粮食和营养不安全，以及极端天气事件对医疗设施造成的破坏。因此，草案呼吁各国将健康因素纳入本国适应计划和气候计划，同时加强气候信息和预警系统，以保护公众健康。对于山区，第31段提议制定气候变化专项工作计划，将气候变化列为缔约方大会的常设议程项目，并在COP32期间举行高级别对话。文件还鼓励各国将基于海洋的可持续措施纳入本国气候承诺和适应计划，并由可预测资金、技术和能力建设予以支持。在包容性方面，草案呼吁原住民、妇女、儿童、青年、残障人士和地方社区切实参与气候行动和决策。草案还处理了发展中国家对单边气候相关贸易措施的关切。第115段对这类措施可能将气候行动的经济负担转移给发展中国家表示关切，并指出这会影响市场准入、竞争力、投资和工业化。草案提议就气候相关贸易措施的共同指导原则展开讨论，包括透明度、非歧视性和互操作性。第119段进一步呼吁发达国家在2027年底前取消单边气候相关贸易限制措施，以及其他对国际气候合作产生不利影响的措施。这些提议反映出发展中国家的更广泛关切：较富裕经济体采取的气候政策，不应为资源较少、难以向低排放产业转型的国家设置更多经济壁垒。COP31即将进入最后阶段，但各主要分歧仍待解决。COP31谈判主席Chris Bowen表示，仍有100多项议程项目和约60项重要授权待审议，涉及气候资金、适应、减缓及公正转型等议题。COP31主席Murat Kurum表示，未来一周将是把会议期间取得的进展转化为具体决定的关键一周。Kurum先生说：“我们将加强部长级磋商，并努力将各国正在审议的议题转化为共同决定。”Bowen先生也承认，草案中的某些条款不会得到所有参与国支持，并将该文件称为后续谈判前的初步讨论基础。随着大会临近11月20日预定闭幕日期，各国将必须解决气候资金、化石燃料的未来以及对脆弱国家支持等方面的分歧……

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary: Former President Goodluck Jonathan has warned that growing political intolerance, violence and ethnic divisions could threaten Nigeria’s stability ahead of the 2027 general elections. Mr Jonathan said political parties and campaign organisations were increasingly adopting the characteristics of cult groups, with young people recruited and used as instruments of violence against political opponents.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary_zh: 前总统古德勒克·乔纳森警告，在2027年大选前夕，日益加剧的政治不宽容、暴力和族群分裂可能威胁尼日利亚的稳定。乔纳森先生表示，政党和竞选组织正越来越多地采用邪教团体的做法，招募年轻人并利用他们作为针对政治对手实施暴力的工具。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: Former President Goodluck Jonathan has warned that growing political intolerance, violence and ethnic divisions could threaten Nigeria’s stability ahead of the 2027 general elections. Mr Jonathan said political parties and campaign organisations were increasingly adopting the characteristics of cult groups, with young people recruited and used as instruments of violence against political opponents. He made the remarks on Tuesday at a peace and security conference organised by the Goodluck Jonathan Foundation in Abuja. The conference was themed ‘Safeguarding Peace and Strengthening Social Cohesion in a Competitive Political Environment.’ The former president said he had received concerns from Nigerians and people abroad about the country’s political direction and the possibility of post-election crises. He identified political intolerance, thuggery and the unwillingness of political actors to accept opposing views as some of the emerging threats to peaceful elections. “There appears to be an increasing unwillingness among political actors to accommodate opposing views or recognise the legitimate right of others to compete for political power,” he said. Mr Jonathan added that the recruitment of young people to perpetrate violence had worsened the situation, warning that political campaigns were increasingly taking the form of organised cult activities. “It’s becoming obvious. We are running political organisations, campaign teams as cult groups,” he said. Mr Jonathan also expressed concern over conflicting court judgments, particularly decisions issued by courts of coordinate jurisdiction, warning that such controversies could erode public confidence in the judiciary. Although the courts have the constitutional responsibility to interpret laws and settle disputes, he said contradictory rulings on similar matters could generate tension and encourage citizens to seek alternatives to legal processes. “We must protect the integrity and independence of our judiciary. When citizens begin to lose faith in the courts and resort to self-help, the consequences can be disastrous,” he said. He warned that declining confidence in public institutions could create conditions for lawlessness, urging Nigerians to prevent what he described as a possible descent into anarchy. The former president further cautioned against attempts to exploit ethnic differences for political advantage, saying the 2027 elections should not become a platform for ethnic rivalry at national and state levels. “Nothing could be more dangerous to our national existence than the deliberate encouragement of ethnic rivalry,” he said. Mr Jonathan called for reforms to Nigeria’s political recruitment process, arguing that ethnic, religious and other considerations often prevent competent individuals from emerging as political leaders. He said Nigerians must pay greater attention to the quality and capacity of candidates seeking elective offices at federal and state levels. Referring to his recent observation in Lagos, the former president said the country needed to move away from a system that prioritises primordial considerations over leadership capacity. He urged voters to place national interest and public service above personal and sectional interests when choosing leaders in 2027. “Our democracy must produce leaders capable of uniting our people and advancing our collective development,” he said. Also speaking at the conference, Omar Touray, a former president of the Economic Community of West African States (ECOWAS) Commission and keynote speaker, said Nigeria’s forthcoming elections would have implications beyond its borders. Mr Touray said the country’s population, economic influence and diplomatic standing made its democratic performance significant to the wider African continent. He said the 2027 elections offered Nigeria an opportunity to demonstrate that a diverse society could sustain competitive politics without compromising national unity. “A peaceful, transparent and credible electoral process in Nigeria would reinforce confidence in democratic governance across the continent,” he said. Mr Touray also cited Mr Jonathan’s decision to concede defeat in the 2015 presidential election before the final results were announced as an enduring example of democratic statesmanship. Former Vice President Namadi Sambo, in his remarks, said democracy depended on public trust, mutual respect, credible institutions and citizens’ confidence in the electoral process. He acknowledged that political competition was necessary in a democracy but warned that it should not come at the expense of national unity and institutional stability. Mr Sambo said political actors must ensure that their pursuit of power does not weaken the institutions responsible for sustaining democratic governance or threaten the country’s shared identity
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title_zh: 乔纳森谴责2027年选举前的政治暴力和族群分裂
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 前总统古德勒克·乔纳森警告称，在2027年大选前，日趋严重的政治不宽容、暴力和族群分化可能威胁尼日利亚的稳定。乔纳森先生表示，各政党和竞选组织正越来越多地采用邪教组织的做法，招募年轻人并利用他们作为针对政治对手的暴力工具。周二，他在阿布贾举行的古德勒克·乔纳森基金会组织的和平与安全会议上发表了这番言论。大会主题是“在竞争激烈的政治环境中维护和平与加强社会凝聚力”。这位前总统表示，他收到了尼日利亚国内外人士对国家政治方向以及选举后危机可能性的忧虑。他指出，政治不宽容、街头暴力以及政治行为者不愿接受 opposing views，是 peaceful elections 面临的新兴威胁之一。他说：“政治行为者似乎越来越不愿容纳 opposing views，也不愿承认他人竞争政治权力的合法权利。”乔纳森先生补充说，招募年轻人实施暴力进一步恶化了局势，并警告称，政治竞选正日益呈现为有组织的邪教活动。他说：“情况正变得越来越明显。我们把政治组织、竞选团队当成邪教组织来运作。”乔纳森先生还对相互冲突的法院判决表示担忧，尤其是同级别管辖法院作出的裁决，并警告称，此类争议可能削弱公众对司法机构的信任。他说，尽管法院负有解释法律和解决争端的宪法责任，但对相似事项作出相互矛盾的裁决可能制造紧张局势，促请公民放弃法律程序而寻求其他途径。他说：“我们必须维护司法机构的完整性和独立性。一旦公民开始失去对法院的信心，转而依靠自助方式，后果可能是灾难性的。”他警告称，公众对公共机构的信心下降可能为违法乱纪创造条件，并敦促尼日利亚人防止他所说的国家滑向无政府状态。前总统还告诫不要试图利用族群差异谋取政治利益，称2027年选举不应成为全国和州一级族群竞争的舞台。他说：“没有什么比蓄意煽动族群竞争更危险，会危及我们的国家生存。”乔纳森先生呼吁改革尼日利亚的政治人才选拔机制，认为族群、宗教及其他方面的考量往往会阻碍有能力的人成为政治领袖。他说，尼日利亚人必须更加关注竞选联邦和州级公职的候选人的素质与能力。谈及他最近在拉各斯的观察，这位前总统表示，国家需要摆脱一种把族群和原生身份等先决考量置于领导能力之上的制度。他敦促选民在2027年选择领导人时，把国家利益和公共服务置于个人及派系利益之上。他说：“我们的民主制度必须培养出能够团结人民、推动我们共同发展的领导人。”西非国家经济共同体（ECOWAS）委员会前主席兼主旨发言人奥马尔·图雷也在大会上发言表示，尼日利亚即将举行的选举将产生超越其国界的影响。图雷先生说，该国的人口、经济影响力和外交地位，使其民主表现对更广泛的非洲大陆具有重要意义。他说，2027年选举为尼日利亚提供了展示多元社会能够维持竞争性政治而不损害国家团结的机会。他说：“尼日利亚和平、透明和可信的选举进程将增强整个非洲大陆对民主治理的信心。”图雷先生还援引乔纳森先生在2015年总统选举最终结果公布前承认败选的决定，称这是民主政治风范的长久范例。前副总统纳马迪·桑博在发言中表示，民主取决于公众信任、相互尊重、可信的制度以及公民对选举进程的信心。他承认，政治竞争是民主制度所必需的，但警告说，不应以牺牲国家团结和制度稳定为代价。桑博先生说，政治行为者必须确保追求权力不会削弱维系民主治理的制度，也不会威胁国家的共同身份

From when the law was passed this year, 7.8 billion Ghana cedis have been paid as royalties for big-scale gold.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/sliding-scal.summary_zh: 总统约翰·马哈马表示，自今年实行浮动比例矿权使用费制度以来，加纳已从大型金矿企业取得78亿塞地尔的矿权使用费，这是确保该国矿产资源收益惠及其民众的努力之一。马哈马总统透露，自该法律于2026年通过以来，大型金矿企业已缴纳78亿塞地尔的矿权使用费。自该法律于今年通过以来，大型金矿企业已缴纳78亿加纳塞地尔的矿权使用费。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/sliding-scal.body: President John Mahama says Ghana has generated GH¢7.8 billion in royalties from large-scale gold mining companies since the introduction of a sliding-scale royalty regime this year, as part of efforts to ensure the country's mineral wealth benefits its people. He says African countries must rethink existing mineral agreements and exercise more control over their natural resources to ensure that the wealth extracted translates into jobs, investment and improved living conditions for communities. Speaking at the West Africa Integration and Investment Summit in Sierra Leone, President Mahama said Ghana had moved away from fixed royalty arrangements that locked payments at three per cent under development and stability agreements. Under the new arrangement, royalties are adjusted according to prevailing gold prices, with the rate ranging from five per cent when prices are low to 12 per cent when they rise. “So we signed the development agreements and locked in the royalty at 3%. So today I said, no, we cannot have that. Let us change to a sliding scale, so if the price comes down, we will come to the minimum royalty, 5%. If it goes up, as gold has done, we'll charge you 12%,” he said. President Mahama disclosed that since the law was passed in 2026, large-scale gold mining companies had paid GH¢7.8 billion in royalties. He said, “So since we passed that law, gold has remained high, so we are getting 12%. From when the law was passed this year, 7.8 billion Ghana cedis have been paid as royalties for big-scale gold. We must look at all these mineral rights again and see how we invest in order that it benefits our people”. He argued that Africa must move beyond mineral extraction arrangements that create wealth elsewhere while leaving host communities in poverty. “From our colonial inheritance, we were taught that people come and ask for concessions, we sign a concession, a 30-year concession, and where does the value go? It goes to build wealth in other jurisdictions,” he said. President Mahama also cited Ghana's Gold Board as another measure aimed at retaining more value from the country's mineral resources. He said artisanal and small-scale gold production increased from 64 tonnes, valued at $4.6 billion in 2024, to 104 tonnes, generating $10.8 billion for the Ghanaian economy following the introduction of the Gold Board law. The law requires all gold exports to pass through the Gold Board, with violations attracting confiscation of the gold and imprisonment. President Mahama said the main objective was to ensure that Africa's natural resources become a source of wealth and prosperity for its people. “African minerals must be a source of wealth and prosperity for African people,” he stressed
https://www.myjoyonline.com/sliding-scal.title_zh: 累进矿业使用费为加纳带来78亿加纳塞地
https://www.myjoyonline.com/sliding-scal.body_zh: 总统约翰·马哈马表示，自今年实行浮动税率矿业权使用费制度以来，加纳已从大型黄金开采公司获得78亿加纳塞地元的矿业权使用费，这是确保该国矿产资源财富惠及民众的努力之一。他说，非洲国家必须重新审视现有矿产协议，加强对自然资源的掌控，确保开采出的财富能够转化为就业、投资，并改善当地社区的生活条件。马哈马总统在塞拉利昂举行的西非一体化与投资峰会上表示，加纳已经放弃固定矿业权使用费安排；根据开发和稳定协议，这类安排将费率锁定在3%。在新制度下，矿业权使用费会根据当前黄金价格调整，费率从价格低迷时的5%到价格上涨时的12%不等。他说：“我们签署开发协议时，将矿业权使用费锁定在3%。所以今天我说，不，我们不能这样做。让我们改用浮动税率，价格下跌时，我们就采用最低矿业权使用费5%；价格上涨时，就像黄金价格过去那样，我们就收取12%。”马哈马总统透露，自2026年法律通过以来，大型黄金开采公司已经缴纳了78亿加纳塞地元的矿业权使用费。他说：“所以，自我们通过那部法律以来，黄金价格一直保持高位，因此我们收取的是12%。从今年法律通过至今，大规模采金业已经缴纳了78亿加纳塞地元的矿业权使用费。我们必须重新审视所有这些矿产权利，考虑如何进行投资，使其惠及我国民众。”他主张，非洲必须摆脱那种在其他地方创造财富、却让东道主社区陷入贫困的矿产开采模式。他说：“从殖民时期继承的观念来看，我们被教导说，人们前来申请特许权，我们便签署一份30年的特许协议，那么价值流向何处？它被用于其他司法管辖区创造财富。”马哈马总统还提到，加纳黄金局也是旨在从该国矿产资源中保留更多价值的另一项措施。他说，在实施《黄金局法》后，手工采金和小规模采金产量从2024年的64吨增至104吨，为加纳经济创造了108亿美元的价值。该法律要求所有黄金出口都必须经过加纳黄金局，违规者将被没收黄金并处以监禁。马哈马总统表示，主要目标是确保非洲自然资源成为其人民 wealth 与繁荣的源泉。他强调：“非洲矿产必须成为非洲人民财富与繁荣的源泉。”

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: A retired Justice of the Court of Appeal, Oludotun Adefope-Okojie, has urged Nigerian courts to hold political parties accountable when they violate their constitutions or electoral laws, warning that party autonomy should not protect unlawful decisions from judicial scrutiny. She also cautioned judges against declaring candidates who did not win elections as winners, saying courts should not take over the power of voters to choose their leaders. Ms Adefope-Okojie spoke on Tuesday in Lagos while delivering the annual lecture of Gavel International, titled Electoral Process in Nigeria: Managing the Boundaries of Judicial Intervention. “The courts must no longer refuse to intervene where political parties violate their own constitution and ‘rubbish’ the Electoral Act. They must intervene to sanitise the system,” she stated. The chairman of the event, Anthony George-Ikoli, a Senior Advocate of Nigeria (SAN), said the judiciary must protect electoral integrity without assuming the responsibilities of voters or electoral bodies. “The judiciary must neither become an alternative electoral commission nor abdicate its responsibility as the ultimate guardian of electoral legality. That is the delicate boundary we are here this morning to interrogate,” he said. Mr George-Ikoli said courts must be prepared to address unlawful conduct without exceeding their constitutional responsibilities. “Judicial restraint should not amount to judicial retreat, just as judicial courage should not degenerate into overreach,” he said. He added that an election could not be considered credible simply because a winner had emerged, but because the process that produced the winner could withstand legal scrutiny. Ms Adefope-Okojie stated that the 1,209 petitions filed after Nigeria’s 2023 general elections reflected the level of distrust in the electoral process. The petitions involved 1,280 elective positions, amounting to about 94.5 petitions for every 100 positions contested. Some seats attracted multiple petitions. Comparing Nigeria’s experience with other countries, she said Zambia recorded about 83 parliamentary petitions after its 2021 elections for 156 seats, while Malawi had 44 petitions for 193 seats following its 2019 elections. Kenya recorded 388 petitions involving 1,882 elective positions after its 2017 elections. The figure dropped to 123 after the 2022 elections, representing about 6.5 petitions per 100 seats. Ghana recorded 16 petitions for 275 parliamentary seats after its 2020 elections. She also cited figures from the United Kingdom, South Africa and the United States. The UK recorded 302 petitions across parliamentary, European and local elections between 1900 and 2016. South Africa received 579 objections to its Electoral Commission after the 2024 elections, while the US recorded 756 election-related cases in 2023 and 2024, most concerning pre-election rules. She acknowledged that the figures covered different categories of disputes and were not directly comparable. “These figures do not measure the quality of justice. They measure trust, and on that measure the Nigerian electoral process is in severe deficit,” she said. Ms Adefope-Okojie pointed to Kenya’s reduction in election petitions as an example of how stronger electoral institutions and effective dispute-resolution mechanisms could ease the burden on courts. She urged Nigeria to improve the handling of disputes within political parties and at the electoral commission level so that more disagreements could be resolved before they reach election tribunals. A report by the Policy and Legal Advocacy Centre (PLAC), From Ballot to the Courts: Analysis of Election Petition Litigation from Nigeria’s 2023 General Elections, also examined the outcome of the disputes. PLAC analysed 1,503 court records, comprising 895 Election Petition Tribunal judgments, 588 Court of Appeal judgments and 20 Supreme Court judgements. At the tribunal stage, 99 petitions succeeded, while 794 were dismissed. The Court of Appeal allowed 115 appeals and dismissed 446. PLAC also identified 43 cases in which petitioners won at both the tribunal and appeal stages. Another 42 petitioners lost at the tribunal but succeeded on appeal, while 30 who initially won at the tribunal lost their cases on appeal. The organisation stated that 4.8 per cent of the tribunal petitions analysed resulted in victories that were sustained through the appeal stage. It found that the ability of petitioners to establish their cases with credible and admissible evidence determined the outcome of about 73 per cent of the petitions examined. Failure to meet mandatory procedural requirements accounted for 14.7 per cent, lack of jurisdiction for 8.5 per cent and lack of legal standing for 3.7 per cent. Ms Adefope-Okojie said political parties could not rely on the principle of internal autonomy to justify actions that violated their constitutions or electoral laws. She cited the Supreme Court’s decision in PDP v Alhaji Sule Lamido, Appeal No. SC/CV/164/2026, delivered on 30 April 2026. The case followed Mr Lamido’s attempt to obtain a nomination form to contest for the position of national chairman of the Peoples Democratic Party at its 2025 national convention. In a split 3-2 decision, the Supreme Court held that although courts generally avoid interfering in the internal affairs of political parties, they could intervene where a party violated its constitution or acted contrary to the law. Ms Adefope-Okojie supported the majority decision, arguing that courts should not turn away from alleged violations simply because they concern the internal affairs of political parties. She also referred to Zamfara APC v Marafa, the Bayelsa governorship dispute involving the PDP and Degi-Eremienyo, and the Plateau election disputes as examples of the consequences of unlawful party decisions and nomination processes. The issue is particularly relevant under the Electoral Act 2026, which was signed into law on 18 February and repealed the 2022 Act. Section 83(5) bars suits concerning the internal affairs of political parties, while Section 88(2) allows an aspirant to approach the Federal High Court where a party fails to comply with the Act or its nomination guidelines in selecting or nominating a candidate. Section 85 also places limits on the criteria parties may use in selecting candidates. The retired judge identified four approaches to electoral justice: corrective, protective, substitutive and abdicative. She explained that corrective justice involves restoring a lawful vote or correcting an electoral wrong, while protective justice may require a fresh election where the original process cannot produce a reliable result. Substitutive justice occurs when a court declares a candidate who did not receive the voters’ mandate as the winner. Abdicative justice, meanwhile, arises when a court refuses to examine credible allegations of malpractice because of procedural or evidential obstacles. “No longer should an election be upheld in favour of a person the electorate did not vote for. The matter must be returned to the electorate for their own choice. Their choice must not be hijacked by the substitution of non-deserving candidates.” Where a candidate’s qualification is defective but the lawful votes cannot establish who actually won, she said, a fresh election may be more appropriate than declaring the runner-up the winner. “The test of a good election judgment is not only whether it applies the law correctly, but whether, at the end of it, the person who holds office is the person the lawful votes chose, or, if that cannot be known, whether the choice has been returned to the voters,” she said. She cited Kenya’s Raila Odinga v IEBC judgment in 2017, in which the Supreme Court nullified the presidential election and ordered a fresh poll within 60 days. She also referred to Malawi’s Mutharika v Chilima and Chakwera case, which led to the annulment of the 2019 presidential election and a rerun. Other cases from Ghana, South Africa, India, the United States and the United Kingdom illustrated how courts in different jurisdictions have handled election disputes. Ms Adefope-Okojie said the difficulty of proving electoral malpractice remained a major obstacle for petitioners. She noted that petitioners were often required to establish irregularities polling unit by polling unit and show that the alleged breaches substantially affected the election result. With about 176,000 polling units across the country, meeting that requirement could be difficult. She cited the Edo State governorship election petition filed by Asue Ighodalo of the PDP against Monday Okpebholo of the APC after the 2024 election. The tribunal dismissed the petition, citing shortcomings in the evidence presented. The decision was subsequently upheld by the Court of Appeal and the Supreme Court. The retired judge questioned aspects of the treatment of documentary evidence, particularly the requirement for petitioners to call witnesses to establish the contents of public documents. She referred to Sections 102 to 105 of the Evidence Act, which provide for the admissibility of public documents, including certified copies. She also cited Paragraph 46(4) of the First Schedule to the Electoral Act 2026, which allows documentary evidence to be tendered and taken as read, with counsel addressing the court on its contents. She urged judges to give proper consideration to admissible documentary evidence rather than reject it simply because the person who produced or certified it was not called to testify. She also raised concerns about the difficulty petitioners face in securing the attendance of electoral officials as witnesses. Since the Independent National Electoral Commission is often a respondent in election petitions, she said, its officials might be reluctant to testify against the commission unless compelled to do so. She called for amendments to Paragraphs 4(5) and 4(6) of the First Schedule to the Electoral Act to exempt subpoenaed witnesses from the requirement to frontload witness statements. She further urged clearer rules on electronic evidence, particularly the use of the Bimodal Voter Accreditation System (BVAS) and the INEC Result Viewing Portal (IReV). According to her, the undefined use of the expression “communication failure” could create uncertainty in disputes involving electronic transmission of results and undermine confidence in the electoral process. The concerns come as the judiciary prepares for another round of election disputes ahead of the 2027 general elections. The presidential and National Assembly elections are scheduled for 16 January 2027, while governorship and State House of Assembly elections will be held on 6 February. At a meeting with election tribunal judges on 10 November, the Chief Justice of Nigeria, Kudirat Kekere-Ekun, and the Attorney-General of the Federation, Lateef Fagbemi, warned judicial officers against political interference, intimidation and inducement. The President of the Court of Appeal, Monica Dongban-Mensem, said 375 judicial officers had been nominated to serve on election petition tribunals, comprising 237 new members and 138 returning members. INEC Chairman Joash Amupitan also identified disputes over electronic transmission of results, BVAS, IReV, party primaries and candidate nominations as likely sources of litigation after the elections. The 2023 elections placed considerable demands on the judiciary. In September 2023, Ms Dongban-Mensem said 98 panels were required to handle the 1,209 petitions filed after the polls. Ms Adefope-Okojie urged the Chief Justice of Nigeria, the President of the Court of Appeal and other heads of courts to appoint judges of proven integrity and political neutrality to election tribunals. “The Constitution places sovereignty in the people and makes the Courts the guardians of that sovereignty, not its holders,” she said.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title_zh: 前上诉法院法官敦促法官要求政党为违反本党章程及《选举法》的行为负责
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 上诉法院退休法官奥卢多通·阿德福佩-奥科吉呼吁尼日利亚法院，在政党违反其章程或选举法时追究政党的责任，并警告说，政党自治不应成为免受司法审查的挡箭牌，使非法决定逍遥法外。她还告诫法官不要裁定未赢得选举的候选人为胜者，称法院不应取代选民的权力来选择领导人。阿德福佩-奥科吉女士周二在拉各斯发表Gavel International年度讲座，题为《尼日利亚选举进程：管理司法干预的边界》。她表示：“当政党违反自身章程并对《选举法》作出‘荒唐’行为时，法院不得再拒绝介入。法院必须介入，以净化制度。”活动主席安东尼·乔治-伊科利是一名尼日利亚高级出庭律师（SAN），他说，司法机关必须维护选举诚信，同时不能取代选民或选举机构的职责。“司法机关既不能成为替代选举委员会的机构，也不能逃避其作为选举合法性最终守护者的责任。今天上午我们正是要探讨这条微妙的边界。”他说。乔治-伊科利先生说，法院必须准备处理违法行为，同时不得超越其宪法职责。“司法克制不应演变为司法退却，正如司法勇气也不应蜕变为司法越权。”他说。他补充说，一项选举不能仅因选出了胜者就被认为可信，而应由于产生胜者的程序能够经受住法律审查。阿德福佩-奥科吉女士表示，尼日利亚2023年大选后提交的1,209份请愿反映了人们对选举进程的不信任程度。这些请愿涉及1,280个选任职位，相当于每100个竞选职位约有94.5份请愿。有些职位受到多份请愿。她将尼日利亚的情况与其他国家进行比较，指出赞比亚在2021年选举后就156个议席提交了约83份议会请愿，而马拉维在2019年选举后针对193个议席提交了44份请愿。肯尼亚在2017年选举后收到388份请愿，涉及1,882个选任职位。2022年选举后，这一数字降至123份，相当于每100个议席约有6.5份请愿。加纳在2020年选举后针对275个议会席位收到16份请愿。她还列举了英国、南非和美国的相关数据。1900年至2016年间，英国在议会、欧洲议会和地方选举中共收到302份请愿。2024年选举后，南非收到579项针对其选举委员会的异议，而美国在2023年和2024年共记录756起与选举有关的案件，其中大多数涉及选前规则。她承认，这些数据涵盖不同类型的争议，不能直接比较。“这些数据衡量的不是司法质量。它们衡量的是信任，而从这一指标来看，尼日利亚的选举进程严重缺乏信任。”她说。阿德福佩-奥科吉女士以肯尼亚选举请愿减少为例，说明强化选举机构和建立有效的争议解决机制可以减轻法院的负担。她敦促尼日利亚改进党内以及选举委员会层面的争议处理，使更多分歧能够在提交选举法庭之前得到解决。政策与法律倡导中心（PLAC）发布的报告《从选票到法院：尼日利亚2023年大选选举请愿诉讼分析》也对争议处理结果进行了考察。PLAC分析了1,503份法院记录，包括895份选举请愿法庭判决、588份上诉法院判决和20份最高法院判决。在请愿法庭阶段，99份请愿获得支持，794份被驳回。上诉法院准予115起上诉，驳回446起。PLAC还确定了43起请愿人在请愿法庭和上诉阶段均胜诉的案件。另有42名请愿人在请愿法庭败诉后在上诉阶段胜诉，另有30人最初在请愿法庭胜诉，但上诉后败诉。该机构表示，在所分析的请愿中，4.8%在请愿法庭阶段胜诉，并在上诉阶段维持了胜诉结果。调查发现，请愿人能否凭借可信且可采信的证据证实其主张，决定了约73%的受审查请愿的结果。未满足强制性程序要求占14.7%，缺乏管辖权占8.5%，缺乏法律诉讼资格占3.7%。阿德福佩-奥科吉女士说，政党不能援引内部自治原则，为违反其章程或选举法的行为辩护。她援引了最高法院在PDP诉Alhaji Sule Lamido案中于2026年4月30日作出的判决，案号为Appeal No. SC/CV/164/2026。该案源于拉米多先生试图取得提名表，以参加人民民主党2025年全国代表大会全国主席职位的竞选。最高法院以3比2的分裂裁决认定，虽然法院通常避免干涉政党内部事务，但当政党违反章程或作出违法行为时，法院可以介入。阿德福佩-奥科吉女士支持多数意见，认为法院不应仅仅因为涉嫌违法行为涉及政党内部事务便拒绝审理。她还列举了Zamfara APC诉Marafa案、涉及人民民主党和Degi-Eremienyo的巴耶尔萨州长争议，以及高原州选举争议，作为非法政党决定和提名程序所造成后果的实例。根据2026年《选举法》，这一问题尤其重要。该法于2月18日签署生效，并废止了2022年《选举法》。第83(5)条禁止就政党内部事务提起诉讼，第88(2)条则允许候选人在政党遴选或提名候选人时未遵守该法或其提名指引的情况下，向联邦高等法院起诉。第85条还限制了政党遴选候选人时可以采用的标准。这位退休法官提出实现选举正义的四种路径：纠正性、保护性、替代性和放弃性。她解释道，纠正性正义涉及恢复合法投票或纠正选举错误；保护性正义可能要求重新举行选举，因为原有程序无法产生可靠结果。当法院宣布一名未获得选民授权的候选人为胜者时，就出现了替代性正义。与此同时，因程序或证据障碍而拒绝审查可信的不当行为指控时，便产生放弃性正义。“今后不应再让选票未投给某人的选举结果得到维持。相关事项必须交回选民，由他们自行选择。不得以不配获胜的候选人取代选民所选择的人。”她说，如果候选人的资格存在缺陷，而合法选票无法确定实际胜者，那么重新举行选举可能比宣布亚军为胜者更加适当。“衡量一项好的选举判决是否正确，不仅要看它是否正确适用法律，还要看最终任职的人是否是合法选票所选择的人；如果无法确定，则要看选择是否已经交还给选民。”她说。她援引了肯尼亚2017年Raila Odinga诉IEBC案判决，其中最高法院撤销了总统选举结果，并命令在60天内重新投票。她还提及了马拉维的Mutharika诉Chilima和Chakwera案，该案导致2019年总统选举被撤销并重新举行。加纳、南非、印度、美国和英国的其他案例也说明，不同司法辖区的法院如何处理选举争议。阿德福佩-奥科吉女士说，证明选举不当行为仍然十分困难，是请愿人面临的主要障碍。她指出，请愿人往往必须逐一证明各投票站点的违规行为，并证明所称违法行为对选举结果产生了实质性影响。全国约有176,000个投票站点，要满足这一要求可能十分困难。她援引了2024年选举后人民民主党的Asue Ighodalo针对全进步大会党的Monday Okpebholo提起的埃多州州长选举请愿。请愿法庭以所提交证据存在缺陷为由驳回了该请愿。该裁决随后得到上诉法院和最高法院维持。这位退休法官对书面证据的处理方式提出质疑，尤其是要求请愿人传唤证人以确定公共文件内容的规定。她援引了《证据法》第102至105条，这些条款规定公共文件，包括经核证副本，均可作为证据采纳。她还援引了2026年《选举法》附表一第46(4)段，该段允许提交书面证据并将其视为已宣读，由律师就其内容向法庭陈述。她敦促法官适当考虑可采信的书面证据，不应仅仅因为提交或核证文件的人未被传唤作证就予以排除。她还指出，请愿人在促使选举官员出庭作证方面面临困难。她说，由于独立国家选举委员会经常是选举请愿中的被申请人，其官员可能不愿在法庭强迫下出庭对该委员会作证。她呼吁修订《选举法》附表一第4(5)和4(6)段，以豁免收到传票的证人预先提交证人陈述的要求。她进一步敦促明确电子证据规则，特别是Bimodal Voter Accreditation System（BVAS）和INEC Result Viewing Portal（IReV）的使用。她说，“通信故障”一词缺乏明确定义，可能给涉及结果电子传输的争议带来不确定性，并削弱人们对选举进程的信心。随着2027年大选临近，司法机关正在为新一轮选举争议作准备。总统选举和国民议会选举定于2027年1月16日举行，州长和州议会选举将于2月6日举行。11月10日与选举法庭法官会面时，尼日利亚首席大法官库迪拉特·凯克雷-埃库恩和联邦总检察长Lateef Fagbemi告诫司法人员不得受到政治干预、恐吓或诱骗。上诉法院院长莫妮卡·东班-门塞姆表示，已有375名司法人员获任命在选举请愿法庭任职，其中237名为新成员，138名为留任成员。INEC主席乔阿什·阿穆皮坦还指出，选后围绕结果电子传输、BVAS、IReV、党内初选和候选人提名产生的争议，可能成为诉讼来源。2023年选举给司法机关带来了相当大的压力。2023年9月，东班-门塞姆女士表示，处理投票后提交的1,209份请愿需要98个合议庭。阿德福佩-奥科吉女士敦促尼日利亚首席大法官、上诉法院院长和其他法院负责人，任命经证实具有诚信和政治中立性的法官出任选举法庭成员。“宪法将主权赋予人民，并使法院成为主权的守护者，而非主权的持有者。”她说。

https://www.myjoyonline.com/new-presiden.summary: Minister of State in charge of Government Communications, Felix Kwakye Ofosu, has rejected suggestions that the purchase of the new presidential jet was justified by an improvement in the country's economic circumstances. According to him, the decision to procure a new presidential aircraft was driven by concerns over the cost of maintaining the existing Falcon 900 and the expense of chartering private jets, not an improvement in the economy.
https://www.myjoyonline.com/new-presiden.summary_zh: 负责政府通信事务的国务部长费利克斯·夸克耶·奥福苏否定了有关购买新总统专机是因为该国经济状况有所改善的说法。他认为，采购新总统飞机的决定主要考虑到维护现有“猎鹰900”机型的成本，以及包租私人飞机的开支，并非出于经济状况改善的原因。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/new-presiden.body: Minister of State in charge of Government Communications, Felix Kwakye Ofosu, has rejected suggestions that the purchase of the new presidential jet was justified by an improvement in the country's economic circumstances. According to him, the decision to procure a new presidential aircraft was driven by concerns over the cost of maintaining the existing Falcon 900 and the expense of chartering private jets, not an improvement in the economy. Speaking in an interview on Joy FM’s Top Story on Tuesday, November 17, he said the Ghana Air Force had made an urgent request to government for new aircraft following the August 6 disaster, citing frequent breakdowns of its fleet and difficulties obtaining spare parts. Mr Kwakye Ofosu said the Air Force had presented a Cabinet memorandum recommending the purchase of four military transport helicopters and two executive jets. He said the Falcon 900 had become economically unsustainable as the primary aircraft for presidential travel because of its frequent breakdowns and high maintenance costs. Mr Kwakye Ofosu argued that when the cost of maintaining the aircraft and chartering private jets was considered, it exceeded the cost of procuring a replacement. He said government decided to purchase the four military helicopters and only one executive jet, rather than the two recommended by the Air Force. “The government took the decision that we will purchase the four military helicopters and then one executive jet, which is the smaller one they recommended,” he said. Mr Kwakye Ofosu said Parliament approved the procurement on December 4, 2025, after the then Acting Minister of Defence and the Minister of Finance presented the request. He disclosed that the first military helicopter had arrived earlier in the year, while the new Falcon 6X arrived on Monday, November 16. According to him, a second military helicopter was expected within the following two weeks, with two more to complete the Air Force’s requested fleet. While rejecting suggestions that the purchase was justified by an improvement in the country's economic circumstances, he, however, pointed to changes in the country's debt position, saying the previous government had declared that Ghana was unable to meet its debt obligations and had left bondholders without coupon payments for several months. He said the current government was now making bond payments ahead of schedule, which he cited as evidence of an improvement in the economy. His comments follow criticism from the Minority over the government's decision to acquire a new presidential aircraft, with members questioning the need for the purchase amid the country's economic challenges. The debate has also revived comments by the Foreign Affairs Minister Samuel Okudzeto Ablakwa, who, while the NDC was in opposition, argued that Ghana could not afford a new presidential jet given the country's economic circumstances
https://www.myjoyonline.com/new-presiden.title_zh: 购买新总统专机是出于成本考虑，而非经济状况改善
https://www.myjoyonline.com/new-presiden.body_zh: 负责政府传播事务的国务部长费利克斯·夸克维·奥福苏否定了有关购买新总统专机是因为该国经济状况有所改善才合乎情理的说法。据他表示，决定采购新总统飞机是出于维护现有“猎鹰900”飞机的成本以及租用私人飞机的开支，并非因为经济状况改善。周二11月17日，他接受Joy FM《头条故事》节目采访时说，8月6日事故发生后，加纳空军紧急向政府请求购置新飞机，理由是机队经常发生故障，而且难以获得备件。夸克维·奥福苏先生说，空军向内阁提交了一份备忘录，建议购买4架军用运输直升机和2架行政专机。他说，由于“猎鹰900”经常发生故障且维护费用高昂，作为总统出行主要飞机已经难以在经济上持续运营。夸克维·奥福苏先生认为，计入维护飞机和租用私人飞机的成本后，相关支出超过了采购替代飞机的成本。他说，政府决定购买4架军用直升机和1架行政专机，而不是采纳空军建议的2架。他表示：“政府决定购买4架军用直升机，再购买1架行政专机，也就是他们建议的较小那一架。”夸克维·奥福苏先生说，时任代理国防部长和财政部长提交采购请求后，议会于2025年12月4日批准了这项采购。他透露，第一架军用直升机已于今年早些时候抵达，新的“猎鹰6X”则于11月16日星期一运抵。据他表示，第二架军用直升机预计在接下来的两周内抵达，另有两架也将运抵，以完成空军所请求的机队配置。在否定购买新飞机是因为国家经济状况改善才合乎情理的说法的同时，他仍指出该国债务状况发生了变化，称上一届政府曾宣布加纳无力履行债务义务，并连续数月未向债券持有人支付票息。他说，现届政府目前正提前支付债券款项，并以此作为经济状况改善的证据。此前，少数派批评政府购买新总统专机的决定，议员们质疑该国面临经济挑战时是否有必要进行这项采购。这场争论也再次引发外交事务部长塞缪尔·奥库德佐·阿布瓦卡的评论；国家民主大会党在野时，他曾认为，鉴于加纳的经济状况，该国无力购买新的总统专机

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.summary: Former Lagos State Governor, Babatunde Fashola, has urged Nigerians to weigh opposition parties’ proposals before rejecting President Bola Tinubu’s reforms, saying the country should not “abort this journey mid-term” without considering the alternatives. Fashola, a former Minister of Works, spoke on Channels Television, where he said voters should be helped to make informed choices ahead of the 2027 general election.
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.summary_zh: 前拉各斯州州长巴巴通德·法什拉呼吁尼日利亚民众在否决总统博拉·蒂努布的改革之前，认真权衡反对党提出的方案。他表示，国家不应在不考虑替代方案的情况下“中途终止这一进程”。前工程部长法什拉在Channels Television接受采访时说，应帮助选民在2027年大选前作出明智选择。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.body: Former Lagos State Governor, Babatunde Fashola, has urged Nigerians to weigh opposition parties’ proposals before rejecting President Bola Tinubu’s reforms, saying the country should not “abort this journey mid-term” without considering the alternatives. Fashola, a former Minister of Works, spoke on Channels Television, where he said voters should be helped to make informed choices ahead of the 2027 general election. “What are the other parties offering that is different, that is better, that is compelling as a reason to interrupt the process of reform and restructuring that is already underway?” he asked. He acknowledged the hardship many Nigerians face but said the cost-of-living crisis was not unique to Nigeria. “Anybody who is right-thinking will concede that the cost-of-living challenge is now a global challenge,” he said, citing the effects of the COVID-19 pandemic and conflicts that disrupted energy and food supplies. On the removal of petrol subsidy, he said a return to the policy would have consequences for government revenue and the funds available to states and local governments. “Subsidy is not just about ‘I said it, I did not say it’. It has to be paid for somewhere. One of the things that suffered because of that was the monthly receipts into the federation account.” Fashola challenged politicians proposing a return to subsidy to explain how they would fund it and what they would do differently. “I want to see rigour, I want to see detail, I want to see numbers,” he said, adding that Nigeria also needed to explain where the crude oil for subsidised supply would come from, given constraints on production. Fashola said the government deserved credit for maintaining the subsidy removal, despite the hardship it had caused. “What this government deserves commendation for is not falling over on the sword and saying because the people like it, let’s bring it back,” he said. He cited the introduction of compressed natural gas, or CNG, as one of the measures aimed at reducing living costs. Defending the Lagos-Calabar Coastal Highway, Fashola said it had reduced travel time to the Lekki Port. “It took me 40 minutes from Ikoyi to get to that port. Traditionally, when I went to visit that site when I was governor, it used to take me all of one and a half hours. A 90-minute journey is now 40 minutes. “Go and calculate the fuel savings in that corridor, and the relief to people’s disposable income,” he said. Fashola also pointed to jobs created by construction activity along the route, saying: “I wish that somebody will commission a survey about how many people are earning a daily living from the construction activity that is going on there.” Asked about the project’s cost, Fashola said the Bureau of Public Procurement was responsible for reviewing contract prices and issuing certificates of no objection. On questions about Tinubu’s fitness to govern, he said: “Nothing suggests to me that he’s not fit.” He described the president as “much more mature” than when they first worked together and said Tinubu was still reading, giving directives and managing government affairs. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.title_zh: 2027年：在否决蒂努布的改革前权衡其他选择
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.body_zh: 拉各斯州前州长巴巴通德·法绍拉敦促尼日利亚人在拒绝总统博拉·蒂努布的改革之前，权衡反对党提出的方案，称国家不应在未考虑替代方案的情况下“半途终止这段进程”。法绍拉曾任工程部长。他在Channels Television接受采访时表示，应帮助选民在2027年大选前作出明智选择。他问道：“其他政党提出了什么不同的、更好的方案，有什么足以 compelling 的理由中断已经开展的改革和重组进程？”他承认许多尼日利亚人正面临困难，但表示生活成本危机并非尼日利亚独有。“任何思维正确的人都会承认，生活成本挑战如今已成为全球性挑战。”他说，并列举了新冠疫情以及扰乱能源和食品供应的冲突所造成的影响。谈到取消汽油补贴时，他说恢复该政策将影响政府收入以及各州和地方政府可用的资金。他说：“补贴不只是‘我说了，我没说’的问题。这笔钱总得找地方出。由于这一点而受到影响的事情之一，就是联邦账户每月收到的款项。”法绍拉要求主张恢复补贴的政治人士说明将如何筹措补贴资金，以及他们会采取哪些不同的做法。“我希望看到严谨的态度、具体的细节和确凿的数据，”他说，并补充说，鉴于原油生产受到限制，尼日利亚还需要说明用于补贴供应的原油将从哪里来。法绍拉表示，政府维持取消补贴的做法值得肯定，尽管这一做法造成了困难。“本届政府值得称赞之处，是没有因为人们喜欢这项政策，就自行倒下并说让我们把它恢复回来，”他说。他列举了推广压缩天然气（CNG）作为降低生活成本的措施之一。 defends为拉各斯—卡拉巴尔沿海公路辩护时，法绍拉表示，该公路缩短了前往莱基港的出行时间。“我从伊科伊到那座港口用了40分钟。过去我担任州长、前往考察该地点时，通常要花整整一个半小时。现在90分钟的路程只需40分钟。“你们算算这条线路节省了多少燃油，也算算它给人们可支配收入带来了多大缓解。”他说。法绍拉还提到公路沿线施工活动创造的就业机会，并表示：“我希望有人委托开展一项调查，了解有多少人依靠当地正在进行的施工活动维持日常生计。”当被问及该项目的成本时，法绍拉说，公共采购局负责审查合同价格并出具无异议证明。关于蒂努布是否适合执政的问题，他说：“在我看来，没有任何迹象表明他不适合。”他形容这位总统比两人最初共事时“成熟得多”，并表示蒂努布仍在不断学习、发出指示和管理政府事务。本文所述评论不代表Vanguard报及其任何员工的意见

https://www.myjoyonline.com/falcon-6x-bo.summary_zh: 议会外交事务委员会首席议员 Samuel Abu Jinapor 驳回了政府的解释，即新购入的 Falcon 6X 行政专机是加纳空军更全面装备更新计划的一部分。据他表示，这架飞机是为约翰·马哈马总统使用而专门购置的总统专机，不应被说成主要是为空军购买的资产。所以，我们购置了一架供加纳总统使用的专机，而目前的总统正是马哈马总统。
https://www.myjoyonline.com/falcon-6x-bo.body: Ranking Member on Parliament’s Foreign Affairs committee, Samuel Abu Jinapor, has rejected the government's explanation that the newly acquired Falcon 6X executive jet is part of a broader retooling programme for the Ghana Air Force. According to him, the aircraft is a presidential jet acquired specifically for the use of President John Mahama, and should not be presented as an asset purchased primarily for the Air Force. "This government has bought helicopters for the use of the President, which have been housed by the Ghana Air Force, a luxurious helicopter, which has cost the taxpayer a fortune for the Ghana Air Force to operate for the use of the President. "This government has bought a 60 million United States dollars, 720 million Ghana cedis aircraft for the use of the President and is going to be maintained and operated by the Ghana Air Force. It is not a new retooling of the Ghana Air Force," he said. Speaking on JoyNews’ The Pulse on Tuesday, November 17, Mr Jinapor disputed claims that the existing presidential aircraft was old and no longer fit for purpose. He also challenged the suggestion that because presidential aircraft are maintained and operated by the Ghana Air Force, their acquisition should be regarded as part of the military's retooling programme. He explained that successive governments, from the administrations of Ghana's first President, Dr Kwame Nkrumah, through those of General Ignatius Kutu Acheampong and former President Jerry John Rawlings, had relied on the Ghana Air Force to house, maintain and operate presidential aircraft. According to him, this arrangement does not change the primary purpose of the aircraft or make it a general-purpose asset of the Air Force. "The presidential jet is for the use of the President. So we bought a jet for the use of the President of Ghana, who today is President Mahama. If there's another President after him, he will use it. So it is not for any Ghana Air Force, so that the impression is created that the Ghana Air Force has some plane which is being used for all manner of things and the President too can use it. https://www.myjoyonline.com/falcon-6x-bo.body_zh: 议会外交事务委员会排名成员Samuel Abu Jinapor驳斥了政府的说法，即新购置的Falcon 6X行政专机是加纳空军全面更新装备计划的一部分。据他表示，这架飞机是专门为总统John Mahama使用而购置的总统专机，不应被说成主要供空军使用的资产。他说：“本届政府购置了供总统使用的直升机，这些直升机由加纳空军提供保障，包括一架豪华直升机；加纳空军为总统使用这架直升机承担了巨额运营费用。本届政府购置了一架价值6,000万美元、7.2亿加纳塞地的飞机，供总统使用，并将由加纳空军维护和运营。这并非加纳空军更新装备。”他周二（11月17日）在JoyNews的The Pulse节目中表示，Jinapor先生否定了现有总统专机老旧、已不适合使用的说法。他还反驳了另一种说法，即由于总统专机由加纳空军维护和运营，因此购置这些飞机应被视为军队更新装备计划的一部分。他解释道，从加纳首任总统Kwame Nkrumah博士的政府，到Ignatius Kutu Acheampong将军和前总统Jerry John Rawlings的历届政府，均依靠加纳空军提供总统专机的存放、维护和运营服务。据他表示，这一安排不会改变飞机的主要用途，也不会使其成为空军的通用资产。他说：“总统专机供总统使用。因此，我们购置了一架供加纳总统使用的飞机，也就是供现任总统Mahama使用。如果他之后另有总统继任，新总统也会使用它。因此，这并不是加纳空军的飞机；不能让人产生加纳空军拥有某种飞机、用于各种用途，总统也能使用的印象。这架飞机是专门购置供总统使用的。如果其他人也要使用，必须得到总统许可。”他补充道

Unlock these with Subscription Global leaders, business executives, and celebrities called for greater investment in environmental innovations and collective action against climate change as they gathered on the green carpet ahead of the Earthshot Prize Awards in Mumbai on Tuesday (November 17, 2026). Among those attending were former New Zealand Prime Minister Jacinda Ardern, Serum Institute of India CEO Adar Poonawalla, filmmaker Karan Johar, and Maharashtra Environment Minister Pankaja Mund. Speaking to reporters, Mr. Poonawalla emphasised the importance of supporting environmental innovations and helping them attract investment. “Prevention is better than cure—that’s what we believe at Serum Institute,” he said, explaining the company’s partnership with the Earthshot Prize. He added that the initiative would help innovators connect with investors and scale up technologies capable of addressing environmental challenges. Ms. Ardern welcomed the awards to Mumbai, highlighting India’s record of producing the highest number of Earthshot finalists and winners. “The Earthshot Prize is showcasing responses to that crisis to demonstrate that things are happening and innovation is available, we just need to scale it up with speed,” she said, referring to the climate crisis. Coral Pasisi, president of Tofia, Niue, highlighted Indigenous-led ocean conservation efforts. “We’re protecting one of the largest areas of ocean on the planet. And we developed a sustainable financing mechanism that’s driven by Indigenous people,” she said, stressing the need for international support. Maharashtra Environment and Climate Change Minister Pankaja Munde called for global cooperation to protect the planet for future generations. She expressed concern that rapid urbanisation and industrialisation had drowned out natural sounds, including birdsong and flowing water, and urged people to protect forests and biodiversity. Filmmaker Karan Johar praised Prince William’s environmental commitment, describing him as a “climate warrior” who empowered innovators through the Earthshot Prize. Actor Sonam Kapoor emphasised that environmental responsibility extended beyond public statements. Speaking about her children, she said individuals and governments needed to take concrete steps to protect the environment for future generations. Former Indian football captain Sunil Chhetri, attending with Football for Peace for its “Rehydrate the Earth” campaign, stressed the importance of awareness and collective efforts to minimise environmental risks. Founded by Prince William, the Earthshot Prize recognises innovative solutions to environmental challenges, including climate change, pollution, biodiversity loss and ocean conservation. https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/e.body_zh: 订阅可享受独家报道、评论、观点等更多权益。订阅全球领导、企业高管和名人在2026年11月17日星期二于孟买举行的地球奖颁奖典礼前铺设的绿色红毯上，呼吁加大对环境创新的投资，并采取集体行动应对气候变化。出席者包括新西兰前总理杰辛达·阿德恩、印度血清研究所首席执行官阿达尔·普纳瓦拉、电影导演卡兰·乔哈拉，以及马哈拉施特拉邦环境部长潘贾·蒙德。普纳瓦拉先生接受记者采访时强调，支持环境创新并帮助其吸引投资至关重要。他说：“预防胜于治疗——这是我们在印度血清研究所的信念。”他解释了公司与地球奖的合作关系。他补充称，该倡议将帮助创新者对接投资者，并推广能够应对环境挑战的技术。阿德恩女士对奖项落地孟买表示欢迎，并强调印度产生了数量最多的地球奖决赛入围者和获奖者。她说：“地球奖正在展示应对这场危机的举措，以证明行动正在发生，创新也已具备，我们只需要迅速扩大规模。”她所说的危机是指气候危机。纽埃Tofia主席科拉尔·帕西西介绍了原住民主导的海洋保护工作。她说：“我们正在保护地球上最大的海域之一。我们还建立了一套由原住民主导的可持续融资机制。”她强调需要国际社会提供支持。马哈拉施特拉邦环境与气候变化部长潘贾·蒙德呼吁全球合作，为子孙后代保护地球。她担忧快速的城市化和工业化已经淹没了包括鸟鸣和流水声在内的自然声响，并敦促人们保护森林和生物多样性。电影导演卡兰·乔哈拉称赞威廉王子对环境的投入，称他是通过地球奖为创新者提供力量的“气候斗士”。演员索南·卡普尔强调，环境保护责任不应止于公开表态。她谈到自己的孩子时说，个人和政府都需要采取切实行动，为子孙后代保护环境。印度前足球队长苏尼尔·切特里携Football for Peace参加其“让地球重新 hydrated”宣传活动，强调提高认识、开展集体行动以尽量降低环境风险的重要性。地球奖由威廉王子创立，旨在表彰应对环境挑战的创新解决方案，包括气候变化、污染、生物多样性丧失和海洋保护。该奖项每年选出5名获奖者，每人将获得100万英镑，以帮助推广其解决方案。评论必须使用英文，并以完整句子表述。评论不得包含辱骂性内容或针对个人的攻击。请遵守我们的社区评论准则。我们已迁移至新的评论平台。如果你已是《The Hindu》注册用户并已登录，可以继续参与我们的文章互动。如果你没有账户，请注册并登录后发表评论。用户可以登录自己的Vuukle账户，查看过去的评论

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111800.body: (로마=연합뉴스) 민경락 특파원 = 볼로디미르 젤렌스키 우크라이나 대통령이 이틀 연속 러시아에 공급되는 북한의 탄도미사일을 비판하며 동맹국의 지원을 호소했다. 17일(현지시간) 우크라이나 대통령실에 따르면 젤렌스키 대통령은 이날 저녁 대국민 연설에서 "러시아가 계속해서 북한 탄도미사일에 의존한다면 유럽·미국 파트너들이 균형을 위해 무기·기술을 지원하는 것은 정당한 일"이라고 밝혔다. 그러면서 지원 대상으로 유럽이 보유한 미사일과 러시아의 탄도미사일 발사대를 타격할 수 있는 미국의 기술을 지목했다. 젤렌스키 대통령은 전날에도 "러시아가 북한으로부터 더 많은 탄도 미사일을 공급받고 있다"며 러시아가 북한의 지원을 받는 것처럼 우크라이나도 유럽·미국의 지원이 필요하다고 역설했다. 러시아가 북한의 무기 지원을 받아 전쟁을 하고 있는 점을 부각해 동맹국 지원이 정당하다는 점을 강조한 것으로 풀이된다. 젤렌스키 대통령의 발언이 오는 19일 열리는 미·중·러 정상회담과 개최 가능성이 거론되는 북미 정상회담을 염두에 둔 것이라는 관측도 나온다. 러시아와 북한이 사실상 전쟁 공범이라고 국제사회에 환기하겠다는 의도라는 것이다. 젤렌스키 대통령은 이날 크림대교 공격에 우크라이나가 직접 생산한 무기들이 사용된 점을 강조하며 군과 무기제조업체에 감사의 뜻을 표했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/18 04:47 송고 2026년11월18일 04시47분 송고

https://www.myjoyonline.com/money-over-m.body: Vote-buying in Ghana is increasingly becoming a major threat to democratic accountability and national development. What should be a process of electing leaders based on competence, integrity, experience and vision is gradually being influenced by money, gifts and other material inducements. Unfortunately, some Ghanaians have come to accept the distribution of money to delegates and voters as a normal part of political competition. This raises serious concerns about the quality of leadership the country is producing. One of the most worrying consequences is that capable individuals who genuinely have the knowledge, experience and commitment to deliver are increasingly at risk of being overlooked because they cannot compete financially. While some candidates believe their track records, achievements and ideas should speak for them, others rely on distributing money to delegates and voters

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/maki.summary: Layer 1 The Makinde-Daura Presidential Campaign Organisation (MDPCO) has criticised President Bola Tinubu over the Federal Government’s decision to impose an embargo on federal employment, describing the policy as insensitive to the plight of Nigerians, particularly youths seeking jobs.

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/maki.body: Layer 1 The Makinde-Daura Presidential Campaign Organisation (MDPCO) has criticised President Bola Tinubu over the Federal Government’s decision to impose an embargo on federal employment, describing the policy as insensitive to the plight of Nigerians, particularly youths seeking jobs. The organisation said the decision contradicted the All Progressives Congress (APC)’s promises on job creation and raised concerns about the government’s commitment to addressing unemployment. In a press statement dated November 17, 2026, and signed by its Director of Strategic Communications, Richard Nnanna Ihediwa, the campaign organisation described the recruitment freeze as an indication of what it called the shortcomings of the Tinubu administration’s economic policies. It also expressed concern that the embargo could precede possible mass retrenchment in the public service under the guise of fiscal discipline, particularly if Tinubu secured re-election in 2027. The organisation cited World Bank estimates that approximately 3.5 million Nigerians enter the labour market annually, arguing that restricting federal recruitment would further limit employment opportunities for young people. The MDPCO also rejected the Presidency’s explanation that the embargo was intended to consolidate public service reforms and enable the government to properly determine personnel requirements for the 2027 budget. It argued that the government should instead focus on expanding the economy, harnessing the country’s human and natural resources, and creating employment opportunities. The campaign organisation further faulted comments attributed to the Director-General of the APC Presidential Campaign Council, Senator Abdulaziz Yari, describing Nigerians complaining about hunger and hardship as lazy. According to the statement, the 2027 general election would provide Nigerians an opportunity to assess the economic direction of the country and decide on the leadership they want. It contrasted the Federal Government’s recruitment policy with what it described as employment-generating initiatives under Oyo State Governor, Seyi Makinde. The organisation said Makinde’s administration had expanded economic opportunities in Oyo State through public and private sector initiatives, particularly in agriculture, infrastructure, education, transportation and other critical sectors. It specifically highlighted the establishment of the Oyo State Agribusiness Development Agency (OYSADA), which it said had transformed traditional farm settlements into modern agro-industrial hubs. Other initiatives cited included investments in power generation, aviation, road infrastructure, water resources, revenue reforms and improvements in the public workforce. The campaign organisation said Makinde’s proposed RESET Nigeria Agenda was anchored on expanding economic opportunities, reducing waste without weakening public institutions, maintaining fiscal discipline without restricting employment, and pursuing economic stability without undermining citizens’ livelihoods. It said the agenda offered an alternative economic direction ahead of the 2027 presidential election. The organisation urged Nigerians to consider Makinde, who is the presidential candidate of the Allied Peoples Movement (APM), for the 2027 election, arguing that his administration’s development approach in Oyo State could be replicated at the national level. Comments expressed here do not reflect the opinions of Vanguard newspapers or any employee thereof
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/maki.title_zh: 马金德竞选团队就联邦招聘禁令指责蒂努布
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/maki.body_zh:
第一层 马金德－达乌拉总统竞选组织（MDPCO）批评总统博拉·蒂努布，指责联邦政府决定禁止联邦政府机构招聘，称该政策对尼日利亚人的困境缺乏体谅，尤其是对正在寻找工作的年轻人。该组织表示，这项决定与进步大会党（APC）关于创造就业岗位的承诺相悖，并引发人们对政府解决失业问题承诺的担忧。

在一份日期为2026年11月17日、由其战略传播主任理查德·恩南纳·伊赫迪瓦签署的新闻声明中，该竞选组织称冻结招聘凸显了其所称的蒂努布政府经济政策的缺陷。它还担忧，这项禁令可能先于公共部门可能发生的大规模裁员，而裁员将以财政纪律为名，尤其是在蒂努布于2027年成功连任的情况下。该组织援引世界银行的估算称，每年约有350万名尼日利亚人进入劳动力市场，并认为限制联邦招聘将进一步减少年轻人的就业机会。

MDPCO还驳斥了总统府关于实施招聘禁令旨在巩固公共服务改革、使政府能够妥善确定2027年预算人员需求的解释。它认为，政府转而应当专注于扩大经济，开发国家的人力和自然资源，并创造就业机会。

该竞选组织还批评了据称出自APC总统竞选委员会主任、阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·亚里参议员的言论，称他把抱怨饥饿和困苦的尼日利亚人描述为懒惰。

声明表示，2027年大选将为尼日利亚人提供一次机会，以评估国家经济的发展方向，并决定他们希望由谁领导。该组织将联邦政府的招聘政策与其所称的奥约州州长塞伊·马金德推行的就业创造举措进行了对比。该组织说，马金德政府通过公共和私营部门的举措扩大了奥约州的经济机会，尤其是在农业、基础设施、教育、交通运输及其他关键领域。

该组织特别提到成立奥约州农业综合发展局（OYSADA），并称该机构已把传统农庄转变为现代农工业中心。列举的其他举措包括对发电、航空、道路基础设施、水资源、税收改革和公共 workforce 改善的投资。

该竞选组织表示，马金德提出的“重置尼日利亚议程”以扩大经济机会、在不削弱公共机构的情况下减少浪费、在不限制就业的情况下维持财政纪律，以及在不损害公民生计的情况下追求经济稳定为基础。它称，在2027年总统选举前夕，该议程提供了一条替代性的经济发展道路。

该组织敦促尼日利亚人在2027年大选中考虑马金德。他是联盟人民运动（APM）的总统候选人。该组织认为，他在奥约州采用的发展方式可以在全国范围内复制。

The searches were conducted on Monday under Section 105 of the Customs Act, 1962. In a regulatory filing under Regulation 30 of the SEBI Listing Regulations, Cipla said the proceedings were related to the classification or exemption of the imported pharmaceutical product. The company confirmed that it had extended full cooperation and assistance to the authorities during the searches. Cipla said the proceedings would have no material impact on its financials, operations or other activities. The filing did not provide further details about the product or the specific classification issue under examination. Cipla shares were trading at ₹1,390.70 on the BSE, down 0.24 per cent. Unlock these with Subscription Reliance Industries plans to invest around ₹150 billion ($1.6 billion) to establish approximately 100 compressed biogas (CBG) plants by 2030, as it expands its renewable energy operations. The conglomerate aims to produce around five million cubic metres of gas daily using agricultural residue, Vikas Rathi, chief financial officer of its Bio Energy Business, said at an industry event. The company currently operates 45 biogas plants, producing around 350,000 metric tonnes per day, though the facilities are running below capacity. Reliance plans to add 10 more plants by the end of March 2027, taking its overall output to 1.1 million metric tonnes, equivalent to around 1.5 million to two million cubic metres per day. Reliance currently has compressed biogas plants in 10 states and plans to expand wherever agricultural residue is available. “Wherever agro-residue is available, we will set up the plants,” Rathi told reporters. The company sells biogas to distribution companies that supply gas to households and small industries. The expansion comes as India seeks to increase the share of natural gas in its energy mix to 15 per cent by 2030, from around 6.2 per cent currently. Reliance’s planned investment and capacity expansion are aimed at increasing the availability of compressed biogas using agricultural waste as feedstock. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/ecow.body: The President of the Community Court of Justice of the Economic Community of West African States, ECOWAS, Justice Charlyne Brumskine, has called for stronger institutional collaboration, harmonised judicial practices and improved justice delivery across the West African sub-region. Brumskine made the call while declaring open the Court’s 2026 Judicial Retreat in Niger State, Nigeria. She described the five-day retreat as an important opportunity for judges and judicial support staff to review existing practices, address emerging institutional challenges and develop strategies for improving the administration of justice. The ECOWAS Court president said the retreat was taking place at a critical stage in the institution’s development, following the adoption of a harmonised legal framework under Supplementary Act SA.1/12/25, the deployment of the Electronic Case Management System, ECMS, and the commencement of the implementation of the Court’s Strategic Plan 2026–2030. She noted that the first strategic goal of the plan was to guarantee timely and impartial justice. According to her, the developments require clear and harmonised institutional standards to ensure that the Court’s legal framework, technological infrastructure and judicial practices work together effectively. “Our task this week is to build on that foundation, consolidate the best practices and experiences, and improve upon the standards where needed,” she said. Brumskine stressed the importance of collaboration among the Judges’ Chambers, the Registry, the Research and Documentation Department and other support departments, noting that effective judicial administration depended on the collective efforts of all units. “It is our collective responsibility to build a Court whose standards, systems and procedures consistently support judicial independence, efficiency, accountability and public confidence,” she added. Earlier, the acting Deputy Chief Registrar of the Court, Mrs. Marie Saine, outlined the objectives and expected outcomes of the retreat. She said the overall objective was to adopt harmonised standards, guidelines and working procedures to promote the effective and efficient administration of justice. Saine identified the adoption of standardised judgment templates, a judgment-drafting style guide and quality-assurance procedures, as well as the establishment of an Editorial Committee, among the key objectives. Others include strengthening legal research support and collaboration between the Judges’ Chambers and the Research and Documentation Department. She said the retreat would also consider the 2027 judicial calendar, external court sessions, guidelines for virtual sittings and priorities for further development of the Electronic Case Management System. The review and determination of Instructions to the Chief Registrar and Practice Directions are also expected to form part of the deliberations. Saine added that participants would develop an implementation framework with clearly assigned responsibilities to ensure that recommendations from the retreat were effectively executed. Expected outcomes include harmonised judgment templates and drafting standards, a quality-assurance framework, improved legal research support and stronger institutional collaboration. The retreat is also expected to produce an agreed 2027 judicial calendar, guidelines for external and virtual court sessions, recommendations on procedural instruments and measures to improve the utilisation of the electronic case management system. The 2026 Judicial Retreat is aligned with the ECOWAS Court’s Strategic Plan 2026–2030, which seeks to strengthen judicial efficiency, expand access to justice, promote regional integration and reinforce the rule of law and protection of human rights across West Africa.
