https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: Second Vice Foreign Minister Kim Jina has met with a senior U.S. State Department official and discussed cooperation in artificial intelligence (AI) and broader bilateral economic ties, Seoul's foreign ministry said Tuesday. The talks between Kim and U.S. Under Secretary of State for Economic Affairs Jacob Helberg took place in San Francisco on Monday (local time), according to the ministry. Kim emphasized South Korea's broad capabilities across the AI value chain and its readiness to work with the United States and other partner countries. She also explained the objectives of South Korea's AI Basic Act and outlined plans for major projects involving semiconductors, data centers and physical AI, including efforts to match companies for cooperation. Helberg asked about Seoul's AI policy direction and plans for major projects, and proposed encouraging greater collaboration between companies from the two countries. The two sides agreed to strengthen cooperation in AI and other advanced industries and encourage business collaboration in various areas, including semiconductors, data centers and physical AI, the ministry said. The officials also discussed ways to promote bilateral trade and investment, as well as deepen cooperation in strategic industries, and agreed to continue consultations on ways to advance bilateral economic cooperation. Kim called for Washington's support for the successful implementation of South Korea's investment projects in the U.S., announced last month, and stressed the importance of ensuring stable visits by Korean businesspeople to facilitate the investments, calling for working-level discussions on ways to improve investment conditions. Separately, Kim attended the Pax Silica Retreat in San Francisco on Sunday, where she took part in government-level discussions and public-private exchanges on AI and economic security. Kim also signed the San Francisco Declaration on the Secure Foundations of Enduring Prosperity, which calls for cooperation to protect sensitive technologies and critical infrastructure and promote super intelligence-led growth. The retreat brought together representatives from 13 countries and the European Union, while 10 of them signed the San Francisco Declaration, including South Korea, the U.S., Japan, Australia, India and Britain. Launched in December 2025, Pax Silica is a consultative platform among like-minded countries aimed at promoting cooperation in AI and economic security
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 韩国与美国高级外交官讨论人工智能合作及战略投资
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 韩国第二外次官金智娜会见了美国国务院高级官员，讨论人工智能合作以及更广泛的双边经济关系。韩国外交部周二表示，金智娜与美国负责经济事务的常务副国务卿雅各布·赫尔伯格于周一当地时间在旧金山举行会谈。金智娜强调，韩国在人工智能价值链各环节均具备广泛能力，并愿与美国及其他伙伴国开展合作。她还介绍了韩国《人工智能基本法》的目标，并阐述了半导体、数据中心和实体人工智能等重大项目的规划，包括撮合企业开展合作的努力。赫尔伯格询问了首尔人工智能政策的走向及重大项目的规划，并提议加强两国企业之间的合作。外交部称，双方同意加强人工智能及其他先进产业合作，鼓励两国在半导体、数据中心和实体人工智能等多个领域开展商业合作。两位官员还讨论了促进双边贸易和投资、加深战略产业合作的办法，并同意继续磋商推进双边经济合作的方式。金智娜呼吁华盛顿支持韩国上月宣布的在美投资项目顺利实施，并强调确保韩国商界人士稳定赴美访问、以便利投资的重要性，呼吁举行工作层会议讨论改善投资条件的办法。另据报道，金智娜周日在旧金山出席了Pax Silica Retreat活动，在政府层面围绕人工智能和经济安全展开讨论，并参加公私交流。她还签署了《旧金山持久繁荣安全基础宣言》，呼吁合作保护敏感技术和关键基础设施，推动超级智能引领的增长。此次 Retreat活动汇集了13个国家和欧盟的代表，其中韩国、美国、日本、澳大利亚、印度和英国等10方签署了《旧金山宣言》。Pax Silica于2025年12月启动，是持相同理念的国家开展咨询合作的平台，旨在推动人工智能和经济安全领域的合作

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111707.summary: (서울=연합뉴스) 김지헌 민선희 윤보람 기자 = 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 아시아 순방길에 오르며 또다시 김정은 북한 국무위원장에게 대화 러브콜을 던지면서 꺼져 가던 북미대화의 불씨를 되살리기 위해 힘쓰고 있다. 중간선거 참패로 국내정치 동력의 상당 부분을 상실한 상태에서 대통령의 권한이 큰 국제 무대에서의 영향력을 과시, 존재감을 각인시키려는 의도라는 분석이 나온다. 17일 외신에 따르면 트럼프 대통령은 아세안 정상회의와 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의 참석차 필리핀과 중국으로 순방을 떠나기 전 취재진에 "김 위원장과 만날 수도 있다"고 말했다.
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111707.summary_zh: （首尔=韩联社）记者金智宪、闵善熙、尹宝兰报道称，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在亚洲巡访期间再次向朝鲜国务委员会委员金正恩抛出对话“爱心电话”，正努力重燃一度熄火的朝美对话火种。有分析认为，特朗普在中期选举惨败、失去大部分国内政治动力的情况下，意图在总统权力较大的国际舞台上展示影响力、彰显存在感。据外联社17日报道，特朗普总统在前往菲律宾和中国出席东盟峰会和亚太经合组织（APEC）峰会之前，对记者表示，“也可能与金委员长会面”。
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111707.body: (서울=연합뉴스) 김지헌 민선희 윤보람 기자 = 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령이 아시아 순방길에 오르며 또다시 김정은 북한 국무위원장에게 대화 러브콜을 던지면서 꺼져 가던 북미대화의 불씨를 되살리기 위해 힘쓰고 있다. 중간선거 참패로 국내정치 동력의 상당 부분을 상실한 상태에서 대통령의 권한이 큰 국제 무대에서의 영향력을 과시, 존재감을 각인시키려는 의도라는 분석이 나온다. 17일 외신에 따르면 트럼프 대통령은 아세안 정상회의와 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의 참석차 필리핀과 중국으로 순방을 떠나기 전 취재진에 "김 위원장과 만날 수도 있다"고 말했다. 그는 만남의 장소로 "중국"이라며 "김정은이 (중국에) 올 수 있다. 그건 시진핑 주석에게 달려 있다"고 덧붙였다. 이는 트럼프 대통령이 올해 안에 김정은과 만나고 싶다는 뜻을 소셜미디어 등에서 공개적으로 여러 차례 밝혀온 것과 같은 선상에 있는 행동으로 보인다. 이에 더해 시 주석이 적극적인 중재·가교 역할을 해줘야 만남이 이뤄질 수 있을 것이라는 조건을 추가한 것으로 풀이된다. 트럼프 대통령이 북미대화 가능성을 언급할 때마다 가장 유력한 계기로 북한의 우방 중국 선전에서 열리는 이번 APEC 정상회의가 꼽혔는데, 마침 APEC으로 향하는 길에 트럼프 대통령이 재차 말을 꺼내면서 중국의 역할까지 주문한 것이다. 최근 정부 각급 외교·안보 당국자들은 미측으로부터 북미 접촉 동향이 없다는 설명을 들었다고 전한 바 있는 가운데 트럼프 대통령이 다시금 운을 띄우면서 혹시 모를 상황 급변에 대비해야 할 필요는 있다는 분위기도 정부 당국에서 감지된다. 또한 마코 루비오 미 국무부 장관도 지난 13일 김정은이 "팽창주의자가 아니다"라는 발언을 꺼내 북한을 향한 일종의 유화 제스처를 던진 것 아니냐는 우려마저 나온 상황이다. 이와 맞물려 김정은 위원장은 북중 접경지역인 백두산 인근 관광지를 15∼16일에 방문한 일정이 공개됐다. 김정은 위원장의 결심에 따라 단시간에 중국으로 이동할 수 있는 조건도 갖춰진 셈이다. 정부 당국자는 김 위원장의 이번 접경지 방문을 두고 취재진에 "이 시점에 갔다는 점에서 지켜봐야 할 부분"이라면서도 김 위원장의 이동 여부와 관련해선 "아직 특별한 동향은 없는 상황"이라고 전했다. 그러나 트럼프 대통령 특유의 화법이나 언행을 고려할 때 이번 발언의 진정성과 북미 만남 성사 가능성 역시 적절히 해석해야 한다는 목소리가 나온다. 2018, 2019년의 실패를 기억하는 김정은이 섣불리 트럼프 대통령의 말만 듣고 전격적으로 중국행에 나설 가능성은 크지 않다는 점, 다자외교 무대의 주인공으로 서고자 하는 중국이 북미대화의 판을 깔아주는 조연 역할은 마뜩잖게 여길 것이라는 점 등이 그 근거다. 박원곤 이화여대 북한학과 교수는 "북한은 과거와 달리 자신들이 원하는 요구조건이 충족됐을 때 만나려고 할 것이고, (트럼프 대통령의) 이 정도의 표현과 말로는 만날 수 없는 것"이라고 봤다. 루비오 장관이 김정은은 팽창주의를 추구하지 않는다며 "그는 정권을 유지하며 살아남기를 원할 뿐"이라고 한 발언 역시 북한에 대한 대화 손짓이라기보다는 중동 전쟁 정당화를 위해 '군사적으로 압박해야 하는 이란'에 대비시켜 말한 맥락에 지나지 않는다는 해석이 있다. 예측할 수 없는 트럼프 대통령의 만남 제의와 무관하게 미국 행정부 내부에서는 북한과의 실무적 접촉 움직임이나 기류 변화가 감지되지 않기에 북미 접촉의 가능성을 완전히 배제하지는 않더라도 과도한 의미를 부여하지는 않아도 된다는 것이다. 트럼프 대통령 또한 북한과 중국의 계산을 염두에 뒀을 것이라고 본다면, 그는 대화를 제시하는 지도자 이미지를 구축하는 동시에 성사의 책임은 북중에 넘기는 모양새를 구상했을 가능성이 있다는 분석이 제기된다. 북미대화를 향한 트럼프 대통령의 적극적인 뜻은 여전하나 북측으로부터 뚜렷한 답을 받지 못한 상황이고, 이에 중국의 중재 역할을 재차 강조했을 수 있다는 의견도 있다. 정부 관계자는 "트럼프 대통령은 일단 의지를 내비쳤고, 공은 북한과 중국에 넘어가 있는 것으로 보인다"고 말했다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/17 11:44 송고 2026년11월17일 11시44분 송고 (서울=연합뉴스) 김정은 북한 국무위원장이 지난 29일 '무인항공기술발전-2026' 전시회장에서 군 https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111707.title_zh: 特朗普越过朝鲜、中国，将北美对话主导权交给中国……金正恩处境艰难
https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111707.body_zh: （首尔=韩联社）金志贤、闵善熙、尹宝拉记者=唐纳德·特朗普美国总统踏上亚洲巡访之旅，再次向朝鲜国务委员长金正恩抛出对话橄榄枝，努力重燃一度熄火的朝美对话。有分析认为，他在中期选举惨败、国内政治动力丧失相当一部分之际，此举意在总统权力较大的国际舞台上展示影响力、确立存在感。据外交通部17日，特朗普总统在前往参加东盟峰会和亚太经合组织（APEC）领导人非正式会议、途经菲律宾和中国前对记者表示：“也可能与金委员长会面。”他称会面地点是“中国”，并补充说：“金正恩可以（到中国）来。这取决于习近平主席。”这与特朗普总统今年已多次通过社交媒体等公开表示希望在年内与金正恩会面的做法一脉相承。更进一步看，这番表态似乎还附带了一个条件，即需要习近平主席积极发挥斡旋和牵线搭桥的作用，会面才有可能实现。每当特朗普总统提及朝美对话的可能性时，最有可能促成接触的契机总被认为是此次在中国举行的APEC领导人非正式会议，而特朗普总统恰在前往APEC途中再次提及此事，并对中国应发挥的作用提出要求。最近，政府各级外交和安保部门人士称，已从美方获悉没有与朝鲜接触的动向；与此同时，特朗普总统再次放话，政府当局内部也察觉到有必要为可能出现的突发情况做好应对准备。此外，美国国务卿马可·卢比奥13日称金正恩“不是扩张主义者”，甚至引发担忧，认为这是否是在向朝鲜释放某种安抚姿态。与此同时，金正恩委员长公开了15日至16日访问朝鲜与中国接壤地区的白头山附近旅游区的行程。随着金正恩委员长下定决心，他也具备了短时间前往中国的条件。政府当局人士就金委员长此次接壤地区之行对记者表示：“从其此时前往这一点看，有需要继续观察的部分。”但就金委员长是否出行的动向，他表示：“目前还没有特别的动向。”然而，鉴于特朗普总统一贯的言行风格，也有人认为，应恰当地解读此次表态的诚意以及朝美会面能否实现。理由包括：仍记得2018年和2019年失败经历的金正恩不大可能仅凭特朗普总统的一句话就贸然动身赴华；以及希望站在多边外交舞台主角位置的中国，可能乐于充当为朝美对话铺路的配角。梨花女子大学朝鲜学系教授朴元坤表示：“与过去不同，朝鲜会在他们所要求的条件得到满足时才会见面，（特朗普总统）这样的表态和说法还不足以促成会面。”另有解读认为，卢比奥国务卿宣称金正恩不追求扩张主义，并表示“他只想维持政权并生存下来”，与其说是对朝鲜释放对话姿态，不如说是在“为中东战争寻找正当理由而必须从军事上施压的伊朗”的背景下所说的。撇开特朗普总统难以预测的会面提议不谈，美国行政当局内部并未察觉与朝鲜进行实务接触的动向或气流变化，因此即使不能完全排除朝美接触的可能性，也不必赋予其过度的意义。也有分析提出，如果认为特朗普总统考虑到了朝鲜和中国的利害关系，那么他可能设想通过塑造主动提出对话的领导者形象，同时将促成会面的责任推给朝中双方。特朗普总统积极推动朝美对话的意图依然明显，但尚未收到朝方明确的答复，因此他也有可能再次强调中国的斡旋作用。政府负责人表示：“特朗普总统目前已表明意愿，看来球已踢给朝鲜和中国。”报道：KakaoTalk okjebo <版权所有(c) 韩联社，禁止擅自转载和再分发，禁止用于AI学习及使用> 2026/11/17 11:44发稿 2026年11月17日11时44分发稿（首尔=韩联社）朝鲜国务委员长金正恩29日在“无人机技术发展－2026”展览会场与军队干部一起观看装配了导弹的武装无人机的机翼下方，并笑着用手触摸其前部。[朝鲜中央电视台画面] 2026.10.30 [仅限韩国国内使用，禁止再分发。For Use Only in the Republic of Korea. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.body: ABUJA — Chairman of the Senate Committee on Petroleum (Downstream), Senator Kawu Sumaila Suleiman (APC, Kano South), has warned the leadership of the All Progressives Congress (APC) that displays of opulence, celebrations and merrymaking at presidential campaign rallies are deepening the pains and anger of Nigerians. The senator, who is the APC senatorial candidate for the January 16, 2027 election, said there was a growing disconnect and misunderstanding between ordinary people in the North and the political elite. In a statement addressed to party leaders and members on Monday, his second intervention on the matter, Suleiman called for a change in the party’s approach and strategy ahead of the 2027 general elections. He urged the APC leadership and Presidential Campaign Council (PCC) to prioritise effective communication of President Bola Tinubu’s policies and ongoing reforms to Nigerians at the grassroots. The lawmaker also called on the party to identify and empower credible individuals and stakeholders with genuine grassroots influence in their respective constituencies rather than relying on what he described as “Abuja politicians” and entitled individuals disconnected from the people. In the statement titled, “A Clarion Call for Self-Reflection, Humility, and Grassroots Reconnection”, Suleiman said the party’s message was still not reaching ordinary Nigerians. He said: “Following my earlier message, we must once again be completely honest with ourselves: our message is still not reaching the grassroots. We need to acknowledge and accept that there is a growing disconnect and misunderstanding between the common people in the North and the political elites. We must change our approach and strategy. The senator warned that the celebratory atmosphere at campaign rallies was insensitive to the hardship and insecurity confronting many Nigerians, particularly in the North. He urged party leaders to remember victims of terrorism, thousands of Nigerians displaced from their communities and those forced to flee across the border into the Niger Republic. “The current displays of celebration, opulence, and pomp-dancing and merrymaking during presidential campaign rallies are only deepening the pains and anger of the citizens. “We must remember the countless people currently trapped in the hands of terrorists, the thousands suffering in internally displaced persons (IDP) camps, and those who have been forced to flee across the border into the Niger Republic,” he said. Suleiman called for deep reflection among APC leaders, reminding them of the responsibility entrusted to them by Tinubu. “It is time for deep self-reflection. President Bola Ahmed Tinubu has entrusted us with a sacred responsibility (Amana), and we must protect and honour it,” he said. Acknowledging that his message might offend some party leaders, the senator said genuine loyalty required speaking honestly about issues affecting the party’s collective interest. He also cautioned against sycophancy and selfish political ambitions, urging party members to place the country’s stability and the party’s success above personal interests. Suleiman prayed for Tinubu’s continued success, victory for APC candidates in the forthcoming elections and lasting peace and security across Nigeria. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.title_zh: 2027年：APC 集会加剧尼日利亚人的愤怒，卡乌警告党内领导人
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.body_zh: 阿布贾——参议院石油委员会（下游）主席、参议员卡武·苏迈拉·苏莱曼（APC，卡诺南）已警告全进步大会党（APC）领导层，总统竞选集会上的奢华展示、庆祝活动寻欢作乐正在加深尼日利亚民众的痛苦与愤怒。这位参议员是APC参加2027年1月16日选举的参议员候选人。他说，北方普通民众与政治精英之间的脱节和误解日益加剧。周一发布的一份面向党内领导人和成员的声明中，这是苏莱曼第二次就此问题发声，他呼吁该党在2027年大选前改变做法和战略。他敦促APC领导层和总统竞选委员会（PCC）优先向尼日利亚基层民众有效传播博拉·蒂努巴总统的政策及正在推进的改革。这位议员还呼吁该党在其各自选区物色并扶持具有真实基层影响力的可信人士和利益相关者，而不是依赖他所称的“阿布贾政客”和自认为有资格却与民众脱节的人士。在题为《呼吁自我反省、谦逊和重新联系基层》的声明中，苏莱曼表示，该党的信息仍未传到普通尼日利亚民众耳中。他说：“在我此前发出信息之后，我们必须再次完全坦诚地面对自己：我们的信息仍未传到基层。我们必须承认并接受，北方普通民众与政治精英之间的脱节和误解日益加剧。我们必须改变做法和战略。”参议员警告说，竞选集会上的庆祝氛围对许多尼日利亚民众所面临的困境和不安全局势缺乏敏感性，尤其是北方地区。他敦促党内领导人铭记恐怖主义受害者、数以千计因故离开家园的尼日利亚流离失所者，以及被迫越境逃入尼日尔共和国的人。“目前总统竞选集会上的庆祝、奢华展示、盛大舞会和寻欢作乐，只会加深公民的痛苦与愤怒。‘我们必须铭记目前仍被恐怖分子控制的无数人、在国内流离失所者（IDP）营地中受苦的数千人，以及被迫越境逃入尼日尔共和国的人。’他说。苏莱曼呼吁APC领导层深入反省，并提醒他们肩负着蒂努巴交付的责任。他说：“现在是深入自我反省的时候了。博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努巴总统赋予我们一项神圣责任（Amana），我们必须维护并践行这份责任。”苏莱曼承认，他的信息可能会冒犯一些党内领导人，但他表示，真正忠诚就要求就影响该党集体利益的问题坦诚发声。他还警告不要阿谀奉承、不要追逐私利政治野心，敦促党内成员把国家稳定和本党成功置于个人利益之上。苏莱曼祈祷蒂努巴继续取得成功，APC候选人在即将举行的选举中获胜，并祈愿尼日利亚各地实现持久和平与安全。本文所载评论不代表Vanguard报纸或其任何员工的观点

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: WASHINGTON — President Donald Trump departed for Asia on Monday, turning his focus to economic deals and historic three-way nuclear talks with Russia and China as his administration adjusts to a new political reality in Washington. He said he may meet with Kim Jong Un while in China as the U.S. looks to reengage North Korea on its nuclear program. Trump also said he plans to talk about Russia’s nearly 5-year-old war in Ukraine during the highly anticipated meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian leader Vladimir Putin in China. “We’ll talk about, my favorite subject, Ukraine. Ukraine’s losing Ukraine,” Trump told reporters at the White House on Monday morning before departing for his visit to Asia. “Russia is losing 25,000 soldiers in the month. So we’ll be talking about that.” Trump suggested he’ll talk with the leaders about the war even after his administration officials on Friday told reporters that he would discuss nuclear disarmament and the Iran war with his Chinese and Russian counterparts but steer clear of Russia’s war with Ukraine. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy had expressed concern as Trump pushed for the meeting with Putin and Xi about the potential of the three leaders using the moment to redraw global spheres of influence. Planning for the summit has drawn comparisons to the Yalta Conference, the 1945 gathering at which the leaders of the U.S., Britain and the Soviet Union agreed to divide Germany and Berlin into four military occupation zones and finalized plans for establishing the United Nations. “We really don’t want this to turn into ‘Yalta 2, 3, 4’ with a redistribution of influence,” Zelenskyy said last month. Trump’s departure comes after the often-omnipresent president had remained largely out of public sight for the past several days, even as a nationwide ground stop snarled air traffic and his Republican administration faced tough questions on its handling of the situation. Trump said he was was kept up-to-date on Friday about the ground stop by Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy and Homeland Security Secretary Markwayne Mullin, who held a briefing on Friday evening to address the American public. Trump defended his decision to delegate to the Cabinet officials to inform the public about the matter. “I didn’t think there was any reason for me to do it," Trump said. He added, “I thought they did a very good job.” His trip to Asia, which begins in Manila and then continues to the Chinese tech hub of Shenzhen, gives him the opportunity to change the narrative from his domestic woes, including the air travel problems and fallout from the November midterm election where his party lost both chambers of Congress. The Trump administration’s actions on Nvidia are scrutinized The controversy over tech powerhouse and chipmaker Nvidia is also certain to hang over Trump’s visit to China, despite efforts by administration officials to downplay the president’s close ties to Jensen Huang, who resigned as CEO last week after admitting to an affair with an alleged Chinese government agent. Beijing has said it was not involved. Trump had no plans to raise the issue with Xi when the two leaders meet, said U.S. officials who briefed reporters anonymously about the president’s Asia trip under ground rules set by the White House. But the president came to Huang's defense, asserting he hasn't been told by officials that it's been determined that the executive from Megaspeed, a Singapore-based cloud computing and AI infrastructure provider who Huang had an affair with, is in fact a Chinese agent. Trump added he'd like to see Huang reinstated as Nvidia's CEO. “Well I don’t know that she’s a spy at all. Nobody’s proven that. He probably shouldn’t have been doing on a personal basis what he did," Trump said. “That’s a different story.” Huang accompanied Trump on Air Force One during the president’s last trip to China in May, and he has been a sporadic presence around Trump at the White House while speaking to him frequently. Trump has argued that America needs to preserve its leadership on artificial intelligence, and warned of dire consequences if China wins that competition. Scrutiny of the Trump administration’s actions as they relate to Nvidia has been growing, including on the Commerce Department’s delay in placing restrictions on Nvidia chip exports to Megaspeed. Asked about the matter in an interview that aired Sunday with Fox News Channel anchor Larry Kudlow, Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent said he will “leave the internal workings of the Commerce Department to the Commerce Department" but that it was crucial “to examine whether Nvidia had a culture of compliance around the U.S. export restrictions.” Trump acknowledged tension between Treasury and Commerce on the matter. He suggested that Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick may have delayed placing the export restrictions to avoid a “blow up” in the fragile U.S.-China relationship. “We’re having a very good relationship with China right now, and I understand both sides of it, and I’ll make a decision, but I understand very well both sides,” Trump said. Regarding North Korea, Trump met with Kim on three occasions during his first term but has not been able to get him to meaningfully engage since his return to the White House. Trump has sought to set the groundwork for further talks with Kim. In August, he ordered the Pentagon to scale back joint military exercises with South Korea. Among the travelers on the Asia trip with Trump will be Elon Musk, the head of SpaceX and Tesla, who is shaping up to be a top investigative target of the incoming Democratic majority in Congress. In the Philippines, Trump will meet with Southeast Asian leaders who look to the United States for help countering Beijing’s aggression in the region. He plans to sign a trade deal with Thailand while in Manila, the White House said. Then he heads to China for the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit — and at the end of the trip, the first-ever three-way talks with China's Xi and Russia's Putin to discuss nuclear stockpiles. The three-way meeting will also put in the spotlight the ongoing U.S. war with Iran, a country which has often allied with China and Russia. The war has been widely blamed for the Republican Party’s steep losses in the midterms, and while Trump has tried to play down the chances he will order a resumption of major strikes against Iran, he also has said he does not see the need for talks. China’s Foreign Ministry spokesperson Mao Ning said Monday that the trilateral talks would be of “groundbreaking significance” and that China aimed to have in-depth exchanges about safeguarding world peace and promoting stability. “Under the current circumstances, the three countries shoulder an important responsibility to work together in addressing global challenges,” she said in a regular briefing in Beijing. Kremlin foreign affairs adviser Yuri Ushakov also indicated that a one-on-one meeting between Trump and Putin during the Shenzhen summit was being arranged. “I can say with 100% certainty that since both Putin and Donald Trump will be in Shenzhen, they will undoubtedly meet,” Ushakov said. “We are currently discussing the character and location of the meeting.”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 华盛顿——唐纳德·特朗普总统周一启程前往亚洲，将注意力转向经济协议以及与俄罗斯和中国举行的历史性三方核谈判，而其政府正在适应华盛顿新的政治现实。他说，在美国试图重新就核计划与朝鲜接触之际，他可能会在中国会见金正恩。特朗普还表示，在预计备受瞩目、于中国举行的中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯领导人弗拉基米尔·普京会晤中，他计划讨论俄罗斯在乌克兰已持续近5年的战争。周一早晨启程访问亚洲前，特朗普在白宫对记者说：“我们会谈论我最喜欢的话题——乌克兰。乌克兰正在失去乌克兰。”“俄罗斯一个月损失25,000名士兵。所以我们会谈论这件事。”特朗普暗示，即使其政府官员周五告诉记者，他将在与中俄 counterparts 的会谈中讨论核裁军和伊朗战争，但避开俄罗斯对乌克兰的战争，他仍会与各国领导人讨论这场战争。乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基此前表达了担忧；特朗普推动与普京和习近平会面，担心中方三位领导人可能利用这一时刻重新划分全球势力范围。峰会的筹备令人联想到雅尔塔会议。那是1945年举行的一次会议，美国、英国和苏联领导人在会上同意将德国和柏林划分为4个军事占领区，并敲定建立联合国的计划。泽连斯基上月说：“我们真的不希望这变成重新分配影响力的‘雅尔塔2、3、4’。”特朗普此次出发前，这位经常无处不在的总统过去数日基本未公开露面；与此同时，全国范围内的大面积停飞导致空中交通陷入混乱，其共和党政府在如何处理局势的问题上面临严峻质疑。周五，交通部长肖恩·达菲和国土安全部长马克韦恩·马林向特朗普汇报了停飞情况，两人于周五晚间举行简报会，向美国公众说明此事。特朗普为将向公众通报此事的决定交给内阁官员辩护。他说：“我不认为我有任何理由亲自去做这件事。”他补充道：“我认为他们做得非常好。”特朗普的亚洲之行从马尼拉开始，随后前往中国科技中心深圳，这让他有机会改变舆论叙事，摆脱包括航空出行问题以及11月中期选举余波在内的国内困境；在那次选举中，他所在的政党失去了国会两院的控制权。特朗普政府针对 Nvidia 的行动受到审查。尽管政府官员试图淡化总统与 Jensen Huang 的密切关系，围绕科技巨头和芯片制造商 Nvidia 的争议仍必将在特朗普访华期间笼罩行程。Jensen Huang 上周辞去首席执行官职务，并承认与一名据称是中国政府特工的人有婚外情；北京方面表示此事与其无关。美国官员在白宫制定的规则下匿名向记者介绍总统亚洲之行时表示，特朗普与习近平会面时没有计划提出这一问题。但这位总统为 Huang 辩护，称没有官员告诉他，已经认定 Megaspeed 这家总部位于新加坡的云计算和人工智能基础设施提供商的高管——Huang 与其有婚外情——实际上是中国特工。特朗普补充说，他希望看到 Huang 重新担任 Nvidia 首席执行官。他说：“好吧，我根本不知道她是不是间谍。没有人证明这一点。他可能不该在私人层面做他做过的事。”特朗普说：“那是另一回事。”今年5月特朗普上次访问中国时，Huang 曾搭乘空军一号随行；此后 Huang 经常出现在白宫特朗普身边，并频繁与其交谈。特朗普一直主张，美国需要保持人工智能领域的领导地位，并警告称，如果中国赢得这场竞争，将带来灾难性后果。围绕特朗普政府与 Nvidia 有关行动的审查日益加剧，包括商务部推迟对 Nvidia 向 Megaspeed 出口芯片实施限制一事。周日播出的 Fox News Channel 主持人 Larry Kudlow 采访中问及此事时，财政部长 Scott Bessent 表示，他将“把商务部内部运作留给商务部处理”，但审查“Nvidia 是否形成了遵守美国出口限制的企业文化”至关重要。特朗普承认财政部与商务部在此事上存在紧张关系。他暗示，商务部长 Howard Lutnick 可能推迟实施出口限制，以避免美中这一脆弱关系“爆裂”。他说：“我们目前与中国的关系非常好，我理解其中的两面，我会作出决定，但我非常清楚两面。”在朝鲜问题上，特朗普在第一任期曾3次会见金正恩，但自重返白宫以来，一直未能让金正恩实质性地参与对话。特朗普一直试图为进一步与金正恩会谈奠定基础。今年8月，他命令五角大楼缩减与韩国的联合军事演习。随特朗普赴亚洲的出行人员中包括 SpaceX 和 Tesla 负责人 Elon Musk；他正成为即将在国会占多数席位的民主党人的重点调查对象。在菲律宾，特朗普将会见东南亚领导人，这些领导人希望美国帮助应对北京在该地区的侵略行为。白宫称，他计划在马尼拉期间与泰国签署贸易协议。随后他将前往中国参加亚太经合组织峰会；行程结束前，他将与习近平和普京举行史上首次三方会谈，讨论核武储备。这场三方会谈还将使美国对伊朗的持续战争成为焦点；伊朗经常与中国和俄罗斯结盟。这场战争被广泛认为是共和党在中期选举中惨败的原因之一。尽管特朗普试图淡化他下令恢复对伊朗大规模打击的可能性，但他也表示看不出有谈判的必要。中国外交部发言人毛宁周一表示，三方会谈将具有“开创性意义”，中国希望就维护世界和平、促进稳定进行深入交流。她在北京举行的例行记者会上说：“在当前形势下，三国肩负着携手应对全球挑战的重要责任。”克里姆林宫外交顾问 Yuri Ushakov 也表示，正在安排特朗普与普京在深圳峰会期间举行单独会晤。Ushakov 说：“我可以100%确定，由于普京和唐纳德·特朗普都将身处深圳，他们必然会见面。”“我们目前正在讨论会晤的形式和地点。”

https://www.channelstv.com/2026/11/16/ba.summary_zh: 涉嫌武装劫匪在包奇州伏击并杀害了一名在 Zurfi Mining Company 工作的37岁中国籍男子王廷健，以及其警察护送人员、隶属贡贝州 MOPOL 34 的阿巴·亚乌督察。周一，警方公共关系官（PPRO）纳菲乌·哈比卜警司在电话采访中向 Channels Television 证实了此事。他说，这名中国矿工当时正在一处采矿点开展勘测工作，他和护送人员随后遭涉嫌持枪歹徒袭击。
https://www.channelstv.com/2026/11/16/ba.body: Suspected bandits have killed a 37-year-old Chinese national, Wang Tingjian, who worked with Zurfi Mining Company, and his police escort, Inspector Abba Ya’u, attached to MOPOL 34, Gombe State, in an ambush in Bauchi State. The incident occurred on Saturday at about 1:30 p.m. in Ruga Village, Gwana District, Alkaleri Local Government Area of the state. Confirming the incident to Channels Television in a telephone interview on Monday, the Police Public Relations Officer (PPRO), SP Nafiu Habib, said the Chinese miner was conducting a survey at a mining site when he and his escort were attacked by suspected gunmen. He explained that the attack triggered an exchange of gunfire between the security operatives and the assailants. “During the survey, they were ambushed by unknown gunmen. The Chinese national had even run towards the vehicle conveying them for safety, but they were overwhelmed,” Habib said. According to the PPRO, the victims were rushed to the Federal Teaching Hospital, Gombe, where they were confirmed dead and their bodies deposited in the hospital’s mortuary. Habib further disclosed that the anti-kidnapping unit and the Violent Crime Response Unit, in collaboration with the military and local vigilantes, were conducting a manhunt for the attackers. He added that security agencies were also working to unravel the circumstances surrounding the incident. https://www.channelstv.com/2026/11/16/ba.title_zh: 包奇州匪徒杀害一名37岁中国矿工和一名警察督察
https://www.channelstv.com/2026/11/16/ba.body_zh: 疑似武装分子在包奇州伏击了 Zurfi Mining Company 员工、37岁的中国籍男子王廷剑及其警察护送人员。护送人员是贡贝州 MOPOL 34 的阿巴·亚乌（Abba Ya’u）警监。事件发生于星期六下午约1时30分，地点是该州阿尔卡莱里地方政府辖区格瓦纳区鲁加村。警方公共关系官（PPRO）、纳菲乌·哈比卜（SP Nafiu Habib）星期一接受Channels Television电话采访时确认了此事。他说，这名中国矿工当时正在一处矿场进行勘测，他与护送人员遭到疑似持枪分子袭击。他解释道，袭击引发了安全人员与袭击者之间的交火。哈比卜说：“勘测期间，他们遭到不明持枪分子伏击。这名中国公民甚至跑向接送他们的车辆寻求安全，但他们仍被压制。”据PPRO介绍，遇害者被紧急送往贡贝联邦教学医院，经确认已经死亡，遗体被送往医院太平间。哈比卜进一步透露，反绑架小组和暴力犯罪应对小组正与军方及当地民防人员合作，追捕袭击者。他补充说，安全机构也在努力查清事件背后的具体情况。持续了解 NAIJA CONNECT 每周发现国内进展和世界卓越成就的故事

https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/16/l.title: Listed Oil & Gas Firms Declare N11.8tn Revenue Amid Hike in Oil Price
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/16/l.summary: Following the increase in global oil prices, Aradel Holdings Plc and five other oil & Gas companies listed on the Nigeria Exchange Limited (NGX) declared an estimated N11.8trillion revenue in nine months ended September 30, 2026. While upstream producers such as Seplat and Aradel Holdings benefit directly from improved crude oil price realisations and production, downstream marketers remain exposed to the cost of petroleum products, distribution expenses, financing charges and changes in market prices.
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/16/l.summary_zh: 随着全球油价上涨，Aradel Holdings Plc及另外五家在尼日利亚证券交易所（NGX）上市的石油和天然气公司宣布，截至2026年9月30日的九个月合计预估收入为11.8万亿尼日利亚奈拉。Seplat和Aradel Holdings等上游生产商直接受益于原油实现价格和产量的提高，而下游销售商仍面临石油产品成本、分销费用、融资费用以及市场价格变化的冲击。
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/16/l.body: Following the increase in global oil prices, Aradel Holdings Plc and five other oil & Gas companies listed on the Nigeria Exchange Limited (NGX) declared an estimated N11.8trillion revenue in nine months ended September 30, 2026. This represents 58.7 per cent increase when compared to N7.44 trillion reported in in the corresponding period of 2025. In the period under review, the six companies posted N2.06 trillion profit before tax, about 72.7 per cent increase over N1.19 trillion reported in the corresponding period of 2025. The earnings trend, however, showed that the benefits of higher oil prices are not uniform across the industry. While upstream producers such as Seplat and Aradel Holdings benefit directly from improved crude oil price realisations and production, downstream marketers remain exposed to the cost of petroleum products, distribution expenses, financing charges and changes in market prices. The breakdown of revenue revealed that Aradel Holdings posted revenue of N3.94trillion nine months ended September 30, 2026, about 633 per cent increase from N538.8 billion reported in nine months ended September 30, 2025. The company said the growth in revenue reflected the consolidation of ND Western and Renaissance, higher production and a firmer commodity price environment (average realised prices of $97.5/bbl and $2.64/mscf vs nine months of 2025: US$75.6/bbl and US$1.64/mscf). Aradel Holdings added that crude oil contributed 69per cent of revenue, gas 26per cent and refined products five per cent. With the significant increase in revenue, Aradel Holdings posted a profit before tax of N764.7 billion in nine months of 2026, about 154.3per cent increase from N300.7 billion reported in nine months of 2025. The Board, thus approved an interim dividend of N7.00 per share for the nine-month period ended 2026 (nine months of 2025: N10.00 per share), amounting to approximately N30.4 billion. Chief Executive Officer, Aradel Holdings’ Adegbite Falade, said: “The first nine months of 2026 demonstrated what our enlarged portfolio can deliver. Group production ran above our full-year guidance range, with strong growth in both crude oil and gas output. This drove a step-change in revenue and EBITDA, alongside improved margins.” The company raised its full-year 2026 production guidance to an average 140,000–150,000 barrels of oil equivalent per day, from the previous range of 110,000–140,000, following stronger-than-expected production during the nine-month period. Similarly, Seplat Energy announced N3.78 trillion revenue in nine months of 2026, about 12.5 per cent growth from N3.36 trillion reported in nine months of 2025, while Oando posted N2.8trillion revenue, a 9.2 per cent increase over N2.54 trillion recorded in 2025. On its part, Totalenergies Marketing Nigeria announced N661.92billion revenue, a growth of 12.6 per cent from N587.6 billion in 2025 . Eterna Plc reported N365.6 billion revenue, representing an increase of 72 per cent over N212.8 billion in nine months of 2025. Eterna benefited from higher sales and improved gross profit, which rose to N23.33 billion from N9.94 billion. In addition, Conoil declared N280.12 billion revenue , about 37.4 per cent increase when compared to N203.8 billion reported in nine months of 2025. The results also showed that the companies recorded varying levels of growth, with Seplat accounting for the largest share of the combined profit and revenue, while Eterna recorded the highest percentage increase in profit after tax. Operators noted that the performance of the companies reflected different factors across the oil and gas value chain. Seplat’s improved earnings were supported by higher production and improved oil price realisations, while Conoil benefited from growth in its white petroleum products business. Commenting on the performance of listed oil and gas companies, analysts at Zedcrest Investment Managers noted that stronger crude oil prices played a major role in supporting the sector’s earnings, although the improvement in production volumes had been less significant across some operators. They identified stable foreign exchange conditions and expectations of improved oil production as factors that could support the sector’s performance in the final quarter of the year. https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/16/l.title_zh: 随着油价上涨，上市油气企业公布收入达11.8万亿尼日利亚奈拉
https://www.thisdaylive.com/2026/11/16/l.body_zh: 在全球油价上涨后，Aradel Holdings Plc及另外5家在Nigeria Exchange Limited（NGX）上市的石油与天然气公司宣布，截至2026年9月30日的9个月估算收入为11.8万亿尼日利亚奈拉。与2025年同期报告的7.44万亿尼日利亚奈拉相比，增长了58.7%。在报告期，这6家公司实现税前利润2.06万亿尼日利亚奈拉，较2025年同期报告的1.19万亿尼日利亚奈拉增长约72.7%。然而，盈利走势显示，高油价带来的收益并未在整个行业均匀分布。Seplat和Aradel Holdings等上游生产商直接受益于原油实现价格和产量的改善，而下游销售商仍面临石油产品成本、分销费用、融资成本以及市场价格变化的冲击。收入明细显示，Aradel Holdings截至2026年9月30日的9个月实现收入3.94万亿尼日利亚奈拉，较截至2025年9月30日的9个月报告的5388亿尼日利亚奈拉增长约633%。公司表示，收入增长反映了ND Western与Renaissance合并、产量提高以及大宗商品价格环境走强（平均实现价格为每桶97.5美元、每千标准立方英尺2.64美元，而2025年前9个月分别为每桶75.6美元和每千标准立方英尺1.64美元）。Aradel Holdings补充称，原油贡献收入的69%，天然气占26%，成品油占5%。随着收入大幅增长，Aradel Holdings在2026年前9个月实现税前利润7647亿尼日利亚奈拉，较2025年前9个月报告的3007亿尼日利亚奈拉增长约154.3%。因此，董事会批准截至2026年的9个月期间派发每股7.00尼日利亚奈拉的中期股息（2025年前9个月为每股10.00尼日利亚奈拉），总额约304亿尼日利亚奈拉。Aradel Holdings首席执行官Adegbite Falade表示：“2026年前9个月展示了我们扩大后的资产组合所能创造的成果。集团产量高于全年指引区间，原油和天然气产量均实现强劲增长。这推动收入和EBITDA实现跃升，同时利润率也有所改善。”在9个月期间产量强于预期后，公司将2026年全年产量指引从此前的每日11万至14万桶油当量上调至平均每日14万至15万桶油当量。同样，Seplat Energy宣布2026年前9个月收入为3.78万亿尼日利亚奈拉，较2025年前9个月报告的3.36万亿尼日利亚奈拉增长约12.5%；Oando实现收入2.8万亿尼日利亚奈拉，较2025年录得的2.54万亿尼日利亚奈拉增长9.2%。Totalenergies Marketing Nigeria宣布收入为6619.2亿尼日利亚奈拉，较2025年的5876亿尼日利亚奈拉增长12.6%。Eterna Plc报告收入为3656亿尼日利亚奈拉，较2025年前9个月的2128亿尼日利亚奈拉增长72%。Eterna受益于销量提高和毛利润改善，毛利润从99.4亿尼日利亚奈拉升至233.3亿尼日利亚奈拉。此外，Conoil宣布收入为2801.2亿尼日利亚奈拉，较2025年前9个月报告的2038亿尼日利亚奈拉增长约37.4%。业绩还显示，各公司的增长水平不一，Seplat占合计利润和收入的最大份额，而Eterna的税后利润增幅最高。运营商指出，这些公司的业绩反映了石油与天然气价值链中不同因素的影响。Seplat盈利改善得益于产量提高和油价实现水平提升，而Conoil则受益于白色石油产品业务增长。Zedcrest Investment Managers分析师在评论上市石油与天然气公司的业绩时表示，原油价格走强在支撑该行业盈利方面发挥了重要作用，尽管部分运营商的产量增幅相对有限。他们认为，汇率环境稳定以及对石油产量改善的预期，可能支撑该行业在本年最后一个季度的表现。THISDAY于1995年1月22日创办，由THISDAY NEWSPAPERS LTD.出版，地址为尼日利亚拉各斯阿帕帕Creek Road 35号，在尼日利亚36个州、联邦首都辖区以及世界各地设有办事处。它是尼日利亚面向政治、商业、专业和外交精英及更广泛中产阶级、在所有平台上均可获取的最具权威性的新闻媒体，同时为有志之士和千禧一代提供新思想、文化与技术的交汇点。该报是公共信托媒体，专注于追求真相与理性，报道范围涵盖突发新闻、政治、商业、市场、艺术、体育和社区，以及人与社会的交叉议题。您可以发送邮件至hello@thisdaylive.com或访问我们的联系我们页面

https://leadership.ng/bandits-kill-chine.summary_zh: 事件发生于2026年11月14日星期六，地点是Gwana区的Ruga村。据报道，这名中国籍男子当时正从事岩芯钻探活动，作为矿区勘察的一部分。包奇州警察司令部证实了此次袭击，称安保人员护送该外籍人士时，载有他的公司车辆遭疑似土匪伏击。
https://leadership.ng/bandits-kill-chine.body: The incident occurred on Saturday, November 14, 2026, at Ruga Village in Gwana District, where the Chinese national was reportedly engaged in core drilling activities as part of a mining site survey. The Bauchi State Police Command confirmed the attack, saying the company vehicle conveying the expatriate was ambushed by suspected bandits while security personnel were escorting him. The Police Public Relations Officer (PPRO), SP Nafiu Habib, while confirming the incident in a telephone conversation with LEADERSHIP on Monday, explaining that the attack resulted in an exchange of gunfire between the security operatives and the assailants. “Yes, it is true that the incident occurred on Saturday. The team was ambushed, and following an exchange of gunfire between the security personnel escorting the miner and the assailants, the miner and one police officer lost their lives,” he said. Habib disclosed that the incident took place in Gwana District while the mining team was in the area to conduct a survey at a mining site. The police inspector, identified as Yau Abba, was attached to the Mobile Police Force (MOPOL) 34 and deployed to provide security for the Chinese national. According to the report, efforts were ongoing to track down and arrest those responsible for the attack, while security agencies were working to establish the circumstances surrounding the incident. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/zamf.body: The Minister of State for Defence, Dr Bello Matawalle, has received the former Zamfara State Deputy Governorship aspirant of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP), Hon. Umar Abubakar Gwashi, and six other politicians who defected to the All Progressives Congress (APC). The defectors, who are members of the Tanimu Turaki-led faction of the PDP, comprise two National Assembly aspirants and four State House of Assembly aspirants. They were received by Matawalle at his residence in Maradun, Zamfara State. According to a statement issued by the Publicity Secretary of the Matawalle Political Standing Committee (MPSC), Malam Yusuf Idris Gusau, the other defectors are Hon. Abubakar Abdullahi Makama, PDP aspirant for Gummi/Bukkuyum Federal Constituency, and Hon. Lukman M. Shehu, who contested for the party’s ticket for Kaura Namoda/Birnin Magaji Federal Constituency. The four State Assembly aspirants are Hon. Ibrahim Abdullahi, Maradun II State Constituency; Hon. Sani Garba Danjibga, Tsafe West State Constituency; Hon. Usman Abdullahi, Talata Mafara South State Constituency; and Hon. Umar Mande Falale, Gummi East State Constituency. Receiving the defectors, Matawalle expressed delight over their decision to join the APC, saying their defection had further strengthened the party’s political base in Zamfara State ahead of the 2027 general election. He described Gwashi as an experienced politician who had been active in politics since the old Sokoto State, where he served as a member of the House of Assembly, before holding various elective positions in Zamfara State. The minister said Gwashi remained a respected political figure in his constituency and across the state. Matawalle urged the new APC members to intensify grassroots mobilisation for President Bola Tinubu and other candidates of the party ahead of the 2027 elections. He also assured them of equal opportunities in the party’s activities, while commending their decision to join the APC. Speaking on behalf of the defectors, Gwashi said they chose to join the APC through Matawalle because of what he described as the minister’s honesty, reliability and commitment to political relationships. He attributed their decision to leave the PDP to the party’s lingering internal crisis, which he said had undermined the political ambitions and future of many members, including those seeking elective positions. Gwashi also commended Matawalle for his efforts in mobilising support for President Tinubu and the APC across the country. He pledged that the defectors would mobilise support for Tinubu at the grassroots to ensure his re-election in 2027. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/zamf.title_zh: Zamfara州PDP副州長候選人及其他人轉投APC
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/zamf.body_zh: 国防部长办公室常任国务部长贝洛·马塔瓦勒博士接见了人民民主党（PDP）前扎姆法拉州副州长竞选人、尊敬的乌马尔·阿布巴卡尔·瓜希，以及另外六名转投全进步大会党（APC）的政治人物。这些脱离者均属于由塔尼穆·图拉基领导的PDP派系，包括两名国民议会竞选人和四名州议会竞选人。马塔瓦勒在扎姆法拉州马拉敦的住所接见了他们。马塔瓦勒政治常设委员会（MPSC）宣传秘书马利姆·尤素福·伊德里斯·古萨乌发表声明称，其他脱离者还包括古米/布库尤姆联邦选区PDP竞选人尊敬的阿布巴卡尔·阿卜杜拉希·马卡马，以及曾竞选该党考拉纳莫达/比尔宁马加吉联邦选区党籍的尊敬的卢克曼·M.谢胡。四名州议会竞选人分别是马拉敦第二州选区的尊敬的易卜拉欣·阿卜杜拉希、扎费西州选区的尊敬的萨尼·加尔巴·丹吉布加、塔拉塔马法拉南州选区的尊敬的乌斯曼·阿卜杜拉希，以及古米东州选区的尊敬的乌马尔·曼德·法拉莱。接见这些脱离者时，马塔瓦勒对他们的决定加入APC表示欢迎，称他们的倒戈进一步巩固了该党在扎姆法拉州的政治基础，为迎接2027年大选做好了准备。他形容瓜希是一位经验丰富的政治人物，自旧索科托州时期便活跃于政坛，曾担任州议会议员，之后在扎姆法拉州担任过多个民选职位。这位部长表示，瓜希在其选区乃至全州仍是一位备受尊重的政治人物。马塔瓦勒敦促这些新加入APC的人士，在2027年选举前加强基层动员，为总统博拉·蒂努布及其他该党候选人争取支持。他还保证，他们将获得参与党内活动的平等机会，同时赞扬他们加入APC的决定。瓜希代表脱离者发言称，他们通过马塔瓦勒转投APC，是因为他所说的这位部长诚实、可靠，并致力于维护政治关系。他把离开PDP的决定归因于该党长期未消的内部危机，称这场危机削弱了许多成员，包括那些寻求民选职位人士的政治抱负和未来。瓜希还赞扬马塔瓦勒为总统蒂努布和APC在全国各地动员支持所做的努力。他承诺，这些脱离者将在基层动员对蒂努布的支持，以确保他在2027年再次当选。本文所载评论不代表Vanguard报纸或其任何员工的意见

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.summary_zh: 联邦首都领地（FCT）部长Nyesom Wike已指示博拉·蒂努巴总统在联邦首都领地的竞选委员会，在1月16日总统选举期间阻止反对党在该领地获得25%的选票。Wike先生于周一日为联邦首都领地466人全体进步大会（APC）总统竞选委员会和彩虹联盟揭幕时下达了这一指示。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body: The Minister of the Federal Capital Territory (FCT), Nyesom Wike, has directed President Bola Tinubu’s campaign council in FCT to block opposition parties from securing 25 per cent of votes in the territory during the 16 January presidential election. Mr Wike gave the charge while inaugurating the 466-member All Progressives Congress (APC) Presidential Campaign Council and Rainbow Coalition in FCT on Monday. The minister specifically named the opposition parties as the African Democratic Congress (ADC) and the Nigeria Democratic Congress (NDC). He said the campaign team’s mandate goes beyond a simple victory to achieving an overwhelming margin for President Tinubu and APC National Assembly candidates. “We’re not talking about winning; we’re talking about winning overwhelmingly. “We must not allow them to go with 25 per cent. They don’t deserve to get 25 per cent,” Mr Wike told the gathering, which included council members, party supporters, and members of the Peoples Democratic Party (PDP). Addressing claims by opposition figures regarding political dominance ahead of the 2027 polls, the minister dismissed assertions that the ADC held sway in northern states or stood a chance in the nation’s capital. He singled out the ADC’s presidential candidate, Atiku Abubakar, noting his tenure as vice president from 1999 to 2007, and argued that past administrations failed to deliver foundational policy reforms for the FCT. Mr Wike also challenged former Rivers governor, Rotimi Amaechi, whom he referenced in connection with opposition remarks about an APC rally in Port Harcourt, to test his party’s popularity in Rivers State. “The FCT is for no other party other than the APC,” Wike, a member of the PDP, declared, warning council members that they would be held directly accountable for the election outcome in the territory. To persuade voters, the minister urged the council to campaign on the current administration’s governance reforms and infrastructure record rather than mere promises. According to him, the Tinubu administration has introduced historic structural changes since 2023, including appointing an FCT representative to the Federal Executive Council (FEC) for the first time since Abuja’s creation in 1976 and establishing dedicated Mandate Secretariats for Women and Youth. He noted that the administration also created the FCT Civil Service Commission, appointed the first Head of Service for the FCT, and enabled career civil servants to rise to the rank of permanent secretary. He added that traditional rulers had been elevated, while road networks, police stations, and educational projects, such as the proposed University of Science and Technology in Abaji, were expanded across satellite towns and rural communities. Wike commended the leadership of the APC and PDP in the FCT for setting aside party rivalries to form the Rainbow Coalition in support of the president’s re-election and National Assembly candidates. He identified the candidates as Philip Aduda, seeking election to represent the FCT in the Senate, John Gabaya for AMAC/Bwari Federal Constituency and Danladi Chiya for Abuja South Federal Constituency. He urged other states to emulate the alliance model practised in the FCT, Rivers and Akwa Ibom. He instructed the council to establish local campaign committees across all FCT area councils and take their message directly to markets, suburbs, traditional rulers, indigenes, and non-indigene associations while maintaining peace and adherence to electoral laws. In his remarks, the FCT Chairman of the APC, Ishaku Yamawo, commended the party leadership for fostering unity across political divides and specifically recognised members of the “Rambo Coalition,” a cross-party political structure associated with the FCT minister. Mr Yamawo said the coalition’s willingness to work alongside the APC demonstrated that the party’s strength lay in building partnerships and pursuing a common political objective, adding that the developmental projects executed under Tinubu’s “Renewed Hope” agenda served as the party’s primary campaign message. “The people can see the transformation taking place,” Mr Yamawo said. He added that Mr Wike’s appointment as the coordinator of the FCT Presidential Campaign Council was a strategic decision based on his capacity for grassroots mobilisation. He pledged that the territory’s party structure was fully mobilised to deliver votes for President Tinubu and all APC National Assembly candidates, urging members to remain disciplined and sustain the prevailing atmosphere of political cooperation across all wards and polling units. Also speaking, the FCT Chairman of the PDP, Mohammed Dogara, praised Mr Wike for what he described as unbiased leadership that has united rival political camps in the capital territory. Using a local proverb, Mr Dogara commended the minister for “bringing the cat and the rat to build the house and live in the house without any issues,” noting that such collaboration between APC and PDP leaders in the FCT was unprecedented. Mr Dogara assured the minister that local council chairmen and grassroots leaders in the territory were fully capable of mobilising voters even in his absence. He expressed optimism that the coalition’s efforts would secure victory at the polls on 16 January 2027, naming Messrs. Aduda, Gabaya and Chiya as beneficiaries of the unified political front. “Come 17th of January, we are going to rejoice and celebrate the resounding victory,” he said
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.title_zh: 2027年：Wike责成竞选委员会，不得让Atiku和Obi在联邦首都 territory 获得25%的选票
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/news/top-.body_zh: 联邦首都领地（FCT）部长Nyesom Wike已指示总统Bola Tinubu竞选委员会在联邦首都领地阻挠反对党在1月16日总统选举中取得25%的选票。Wike先生周一在联邦首都领地主持由466人组成的全进步大会党（APC）总统竞选委员会和彩虹联盟成立仪式时下达了这一要求。部长明确点名反对党为非洲民主大会（ADC）和尼日利亚民主大会（NDC）。他说，竞选团队的使命不只是赢得胜利，而是要为Tinubu总统和APC国家议会候选人取得压倒性优势。“我们说的不是获胜，而是压倒性获胜。‘我们绝不能让他们拿到25%。他们不配得到25%，’”Wike先生对与会者说。出席者包括委员会成员、党内支持者以及人民民主党（PDP）成员。针对反对派人士在2027年选举前关于政治主导地位的言论，部长驳斥了ADC在北部州份占据主导地位或有可能在首都胜出的说法。他特别提到ADC总统候选人Atiku Abubakar，指出其于1999年至2007年担任副总统，并称历届政府未能为联邦首都领地实施基础性政策改革。Wike先生还向前 Rivers州州长Rotimi Amaechi提出挑战，称对方曾就反对派在Port Harcourt举行的APC集会发表言论，如今应检验其政党在Rivers州的人气。“联邦首都领地除了APC，不属于任何其他政党。”身为PDP成员的Wike宣称，并警告委员会成员，他们将直接对联邦首都领地的选举结果负责。为说服选民，部长敦促委员会围绕现任政府的治理改革和基础设施成就开展宣传，而非仅仅作出承诺。据他介绍，Tinubu政府自2023年以来推行了历史性的结构性变革，包括自1976年Abuja设立以来首次任命一名联邦首都领地代表进入联邦执行委员会（FEC），并设立专门的妇女和青年授权秘书处。他指出，该政府还设立了联邦首都领地公务员委员会，任命了联邦首都领地首任政府事务主管，并使职业公务员得以晋升至常任秘书一级。他补充说，传统统治者地位得到提升，卫星城和农村社区的道路网络、警察局以及Abaji拟建科技大学等教育项目均得到扩展。Wike赞扬联邦首都领地APC和PDP的领导层搁置党派竞争，组建彩虹联盟，以支持总统连任和国家议会候选人。他列出的候选人为争取代表联邦首都领地进入参议院的Philip Aduda、AMAC/Bwari联邦选区的John Gabaya，以及Abuja South联邦选区的Danladi Chiya。他敦促其他州仿效联邦首都领地、Rivers州和Akwa Ibom州实行的联盟模式。他指示委员会在联邦首都领地所有地方议会设立竞选委员会，将信息直接传达给市场、郊区、传统统治者、本地居民和非本地居民协会，同时维护和平并遵守选举法律。在发言中，联邦首都领地APC主席Ishaku Yamawo赞扬该党领导层推动跨越政治分歧的团结，并特别表彰了与联邦首都领地部长有关的跨党派政治组织“兰博联盟”成员。Yamawo先生说，该联盟愿意与APC合作，证明该党的力量在于建立伙伴关系并追求共同政治目标；此外，在Tinubu“恢复希望”议程下实施的发展项目，构成了该党的首要竞选信息。“人民看得见正在发生的转变。”Yamawo先生说。他补充称，任命Wike先生担任联邦首都领地总统竞选委员会协调员，是基于其基层动员能力作出的战略决定。他保证，该领地内的党组织已全面动员，将为Tinubu总统和所有APC国家议会候选人争取选票，同时敦促成员保持纪律，持续维护所有选区和投票站之间现有的政治合作氛围。联邦首都领地PDP主席Mohammed Dogara也发表讲话，称赞Wike先生实行了他所描述的不偏不倚的领导，促成了首都领地内相互对立的政治阵营团结。他引用一则当地谚语，赞扬这位部长“把猫和老鼠带到一起建房子，并让他们住进房子里而毫无矛盾”，并指出联邦首都领地APC和PDP领导人之间这种合作史无前例。Dogara先生向部长保证，即使部长不在场，地方议会主席和基层领导人也完全有能力动员选民。他乐观地表示，联盟的努力将在2027年1月16日的选举中取得胜利，并称Aduda、Gabaya和Chiya三位先生将成为统一政治阵线的受益者。“到了1月17日，我们将欢庆并庆祝这场大胜。”他说。

https://www.france24.com/en/russia-s-war.body: Delano D'Souza is pleased to welcome Grégoire Roos, Director of the Europe and Russia and Eurasia Programmes at Chatham House. As European countries prepare to take part in the next round of Ukraine peace talks, Roos questions whether having five European representatives could weaken their negotiating position. "The other option is to realize that it dilutes the negotiating power of Europe. And I would lean towards that," he says, proposing Finnish President Alexander Stubb as a possible representative. Roos also points to differences between Washington and European governments over negotiations with Russia. While "the Americans do absolutely want to have a deal whatever the cost for both Ukraine and Europe," he argues that European governments have little choice but to maintain pressure on Moscow, which has yet to abandon its "maximalist demands."

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111618.body: (워싱턴=연합뉴스) 박성민 특파원 = 도널드 트럼프 미국 대통령은 16일(현지시간) 오는 18∼19일 중국 선전에서 열리는 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의 참석 계기에 김정은 북한 국무위원장을 만날 수도 있다고 밝혔다. 트럼프 대통령은 이날 필리핀과 중국 등 아시아 순방을 떠나기 전 백악관에서 기자들과 만나 중국에서 "시진핑 중국 국가주석을 만날 예정"이라며 "(러시아 블라디미르) 푸틴 대통령과 만날 예정이며, 김 위원장과 만날 수도 있다"고 말했다. 트럼프 대통령이 김 위원장과의 재회 가능성을 언급한 것은 취재진이 질의를 시작하기 전 이번 순방 일정을 간략히 설명하는 과정에서 선제적으로 밝힌 것이다. 이는 지난주 금요일인 13일 백악관 당국자가 언론에 트럼프 대통령의 이번 순방에서 김 위원장과의 만남은 계획돼 있지 않다고 밝힌 것과는 달라진 것이다. 이에 따라 14∼15일 주말을 거치면서 상황이 변하면서 이번 APEC 정상회의를 계기로 북미 정상회담을 개최할 가능성이 좀 더 커진 것 아니냐는 관측도 나온다. 아니면 달라진 상황이 없는 데도 트럼프 대통령이 재차 김 위원장에게 이번 기회에 북미 회담을 해보자는 메시지를 던졌을 가능성도 있다. 트럼프 대통령은 김 위원장과 중국에서 만날 가능성을 얘기했지만, APEC 정상회의 개최지인 선전인지, 최근 김 위원장이 깜짝 방문했던 단둥인지 등 구체적인 장소를 밝히지 않았다. 아울러 김 위원장 방중 여부가 APEC 정상회의 주최국이자 북미회담 주선 역할을 할 수 있는 중국에 달려 있다며 공을 넘긴 것으로 미뤄볼 때 방중 기간 북미 회담 가능성을 계속 타진하며 불씨를 살려놓을 것으로 예상된다. 트럼프 대통령이 김 위원장과 다시 만난다면 2019년 6월 판문점에서 당시 문재인 대통령과 함께 회동한 이후 7년 5개월만에 북미회담이 이뤄지는 것이다. 트럼프 대통령은 그간 북한을 핵보유국으로 인정하는 듯한 발언을 내놓으면서 올해 안에 김 위원장과 만나고 싶다는 뜻을 공개적으로 피력해왔다. 트럼프 대통령이 이날 다시 김 위원장과의 재회 가능성을 띄운 것은 여당인 공화당이 미국 중간선거에서 참패하면서 남은 임기 2년간 급속한 레임덕에 빠지는 정치적 위기에 놓인 상황에서 내치보다는 외교를 앞세워 집권 2기의 업적을 남기려는 포석으로도 풀이된다. 트럼프 대통령은 이날 필리핀 마닐라로 출발해 17∼18일 쿼드(Quad·미국, 일본, 호주, 인도의 안보협의체) 정상회의 및 미·아세안(ASEAN) 정상회의에 참석한다. 그는 이어 중국 선전으로 이동, 18∼19일 아시아태평양경제협력체(APEC) 정상회의에 참석하며, 이 기간 미·중·러 3자 정상회담도 열린다. 제보는 카카오톡 okjebo <저작권자(c) 연합뉴스, 무단 전재-재배포, AI 학습 및 활용 금지> 2026/11/17 00:51 송고 2026년11월17일 00시51분 송고

https://www.yna.co.kr/view/akr2026111618.body_zh: （华盛顿＝韩联社）特派记者朴成敏报道，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普16日（当地时间）表示，在18日至19日于中国举行的亚太经济合作组织（APEC）领导人非正式会议期间，可能会见朝鲜国务委员金正恩。特朗普总统当天在前往菲律宾和中国等亚洲国家进行访问前，在白宫向记者表示，他“预计会见中国国家主席习近平”，“预计会见俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京，也可能会见金正恩委员长”。特朗普总统在记者开始提问前介绍此次访问行程时，主动提到了与金正恩委员长再次会面的可能性。这与白宫官员上周五13日向媒体表示，此次访问期间没有安排与金正恩委员长会面的说法有所不同。随着14日至15日周末局势发生变化，外界也开始推测，此次APEC领导人非正式会议期间举行美朝领导人会谈的可能性是否有所增加。也可能出现另一种情况，即即使局势没有变化，特朗普总统仍有意再次向金正恩委员长传达利用此次机会举行美朝会谈的信息。特朗普总统谈到可能在中国与金正恩委员长会面，但未透露具体地点，例如是APEC领导人非正式会议举办地山东，还是金正恩委员长近期突然访问过的丹东。他还表示，是否安排金正恩委员长出访中国，取决于作为APEC领导人非正式会议主办国、并可能斡旋美朝会谈的中国，因此可判断，他将继续探询访问期间举行美朝会谈的可能性，并维持这一议题的活力。如果特朗普总统再次与金正恩委员长会面将是2019年6月在板门店与当时的文在寅总统共同现身后，时隔7年5个月举行的美朝会谈。特朗普总统此前曾多次公开表示，希望在年内与金正恩委员长会面，并发表仿佛承认朝鲜为核武国家的言论。特朗普总统当天再次提出可能与金正恩委员长重逢之际，执政共和党在美国中期选举中惨败，面临在剩余两年任期内迅速陷入跛脚鸭困境的政治危机。也可将其解读为，特朗普总统没有采取守势，而是希望以外交优先，为第二个任期留下政绩。特朗普总统当天出发前往菲律宾马尼拉，将出席17日至18日举行的四方安全对话（Quad·美国、日本、澳大利亚和印度的安全磋商机制）领导人会议及美国—东盟（ASEAN）领导人会议。他随后将前往中国，出席18日至19日举行的亚太经济合作组织（APEC）领导人非正式会议，期间还将举行美中俄三国领导人会谈。报道可通过KakaoTalk发送给okjebo。版权所有(c) 韩联社，未经许可禁止转载、翻印及用于人工智能学习和应用。2026年11月17日00:51发布

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 总统办公室星期一表示，李在明总统已批准举行听证会，对法务部长候选人李勇哲和其提名的国税厅（NTS）厅长人选安德旭进行国会确认。两人的确认听证会预计将重点审议其资历，以及他们在起诉改革和税务管理等关键政府问题上的政策立场。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: President Lee Jae Myung has approved requests for parliamentary confirmation hearings for Justice Minister nominee Lee Yong-cheol and Ahn Duk-su, his pick to head the National Tax Service (NTS), the presidential office said Monday. Their confirmation hearings are expected to focus on their qualifications and policy positions on key government issues, including prosecution reform and tax administration. Lee Yong-cheol worked on prosecution reform while serving as senior presidential secretary for civil affairs and legal affairs under former President Roh Moo-hyun, who served from 2003 to 2008. Lee also served on the transition team after Lee Jae Myung was elected mayor of Seongnam, south of Seoul, in June 2010. Before his nomination, he headed the Defense Acquisition Program Administration (DAPA). Questions are expected to focus on allegations surrounding his role in the 2015 Daejang-dong development project, which was launched while Lee Jae Myung was mayor of Seongnam. Ahn is a career tax official with extensive experience in tax investigations and administration. He has headed the Seoul Regional Tax Office since July and previously oversaw investigations into companies suspected of tax evasion. As head of the NTS' Investigation Bureau, Ahn was recognized for cracking down on tax evasion involving stock market manipulation and other unfair trading practices that harmed retail investors. His hearing is expected to focus on his plans to promote tax fairness and strengthen efforts to combat tax evasion. The National Assembly is required to complete the hearings within 20 days of receiving the president's requests

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title: N. Korean nuclear issue unlikely to feature prominently at Trump-Xi-Putin summit: experts
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary: MANILA — North Korea's nuclear weapons program is unlikely to feature prominently at an unprecedented summit among the leaders of the United States, China and Russia set to be held this week, though the gathering could provide a limited opening for renewed diplomatic contact between Washington and Pyongyang, U.S. experts said Monday.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.summary_zh: 马尼拉——美国专家周一表示，尽管美国、中国和俄罗斯领导人本周将举行前所未有的峰会，但朝鲜的核武计划不太可能在会上成为突出议题。不过，这场聚会可能为华盛顿与平壤恢复外交接触提供有限机会。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body: MANILA — North Korea's nuclear weapons program is unlikely to feature prominently at an unprecedented summit among the leaders of the United States, China and Russia set to be held this week, though the gathering could provide a limited opening for renewed diplomatic contact between Washington and Pyongyang, U.S. experts said Monday. U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin are scheduled to hold their first-ever trilateral summit Thursday in Shenzhen, China, on the sidelines of the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation (APEC) summit, where nuclear arms reduction is expected to be discussed. Although Trump has previously expressed interest in meeting North Korean leader Kim Jong-un again, a U.S. administration official said last week that there are no plans for engagement with Pyongyang during the president's Asia trip. The White House has not responded to a Yonhap News Agency inquiry on whether North Korea will be discussed during the trilateral summit. Andrew Yeo, a senior fellow at the Brookings Institution, said North Korea's nuclear program is unlikely to be discussed at the summit, citing considerable differences between Washington and Moscow over Pyongyang's nuclear ambitions. "Any mention of nuclear arms reduction from the three leaders will be a generally worded and vague statement," Yeo told Yonhap News Agency. Ellen Kim, a senior fellow at the Korea Economic Institute of America (KEI), said the three leaders might briefly discuss North Korea behind closed doors, possibly at Trump's initiative, but other issues would likely take precedence. "However, nuclear arms control among the U.S., Russia and China, along with the war in Iran, will likely take priority at the meeting," she said. Scott Snyder, president and chief executive officer (CEO) of KEI, shared a similar assessment. "I doubt that North Korea's nuclear program will be accepted as a discussion topic among the three leaders," Snyder said. Despite the limited prospects for substantive discussions on North Korea, some suggest the summit could create an indirect opening for renewed diplomatic engagement between Trump and Kim. Yeo said the trilateral meeting itself would not have much bearing on a Trump-Kim meeting but noted that Kim may consider a future meeting with Trump if he views the trilateral gathering positively. Kim of KEI said the summit could, at best, help open diplomatic channels between Washington and Pyongyang, but is unlikely to lead directly to renewed engagement between Trump and the North Korean leader. "Xi and Putin could convey Trump's messages to Kim," she said. "But they may be reluctant to support U.S.-North Korea negotiations for fear of losing their influence over North Korea." Sydney Seiler, a former U.S. national intelligence officer for North Korea, suggested Xi and Putin could encourage Trump to continue reaching out to Pyongyang and consider incentives, including possible sanctions relief, without assuming a direct mediating role. "It is most unlikely that either Xi or Putin is interested in taking a more active role in mediating a U.S.-DPRK summit," Seiler said, referring to North Korea by its official name, the Democratic People's Republic of Korea. The experts generally dismissed comparisons between the upcoming summit and the 1945 Yalta Conference, where the U.S., Britain and the Soviet Union discussed the postwar international order without the participation of other countries directly affected by their decisions. Robert Rapson, a former acting U.S. ambassador to South Korea, described such comparisons as misleading and said major differences among the three countries would make meaningful agreements difficult. "Unlike Yalta, this meeting is not deciding the world order," Rapson said. "It's largely symbolic and performative, albeit not without some consequences." Despite expectations of limited substantive results, Rapson warned that U.S. allies, including South Korea, should closely monitor the discussions to ensure their security interests are not compromised. "As for allies and partners, including Seoul, they are somewhat out in the cold and will have to look to Trump's key senior advisers, to the extent possible, to keep them apprised of developments and to help ensure the president does not go off the rails with respect to their core interests," Rapson said
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.title_zh: 专家称，朝鲜核问题不太可能在特朗普、习近平和普京峰会上占据突出位置
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/foreignaffa.body_zh: 马尼拉消息：美国、中国和俄罗斯领导人定于本周举行的史无前例峰会不太可能重点讨论朝鲜核武计划，不过美国专家周一表示，这次会晤可能为华盛顿与平壤恢复外交接触提供有限机会。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京定于周四在中国深圳举行首次三方峰会，地点安排在亚太经济合作组织（APEC）峰会期间，届时预计将讨论削减核武的问题。尽管特朗普此前曾表示有兴趣再次会见朝鲜领导人金正恩，但美国政府官员上周表示，总统亚洲之行期间没有与平壤接触的计划。白宫尚未回应韩联社关于三方峰会是否会讨论朝鲜问题的询问。布鲁金斯学会高级研究员安德鲁·约表示，由于华盛顿与莫斯科对平壤核野心存在巨大分歧，朝鲜核计划不太可能在峰会上成为讨论议题。约对韩联社说：“三位领导人若提及削减核武，措辞通常会较为笼统和模糊。”美国韩国经济研究院（KEI）高级研究员艾伦·金表示，三位领导人可能会在闭门会议上简要讨论朝鲜问题，也可能是由特朗普主动提出，但其他议题很可能更受重视。她说：“不过，美国、俄罗斯和中国之间的核军备控制，以及伊朗战争，预计将在会议期间占据优先位置。”KEI总裁兼首席执行官斯科特·斯奈德也作出了类似评估。斯奈德说：“我怀疑朝鲜核计划会被列为三位领导人的讨论议题。”尽管就朝鲜问题展开实质性讨论的前景有限，但一些人认为，此次峰会可能为特朗普与金正恩恢复外交接触创造间接机会。约表示，三方会议本身不会对特朗普与金正恩会晤产生太大影响，但他指出，如果金正恩对三方峰会的评价积极，他可能会考虑未来与特朗普会面。KEI的金表示，峰会至多有助于打通华盛顿与平壤之间的外交渠道，但不太可能直接促成特朗普与朝鲜领导人恢复接触。她说：“习近平和普京可以向金正恩转达特朗普的信息。不过，他们可能不愿支持美朝谈判，因为他们担心会失去对朝鲜的影响力。”美国前朝鲜国家情报官员悉尼·塞勒认为，习近平和普京可以鼓励特朗普继续向平壤伸出手，并考虑提供激励措施，包括可能放松制裁，而无需承担直接斡旋的角色。塞勒在提及朝鲜官方名称“朝鲜民主主义人民共和国”时说：“习近平或普京都不太可能有意在促成美朝峰会方面扮演更积极的斡旋角色。”这些专家普遍否定将即将举行的峰会与1945年雅尔塔会议相提并论。在那次会议上，美国、英国和苏联讨论了战后国际秩序，而没有其他受其决定直接影响的国家参与。美国前驻韩国代办罗伯特·拉普森称，此类比较具有误导性，并表示三国之间的重大分歧将使达成有意义的协议十分困难。拉普森说：“与雅尔塔会议不同，这次会议并不是在决定世界秩序。它在很大程度上具有象征和表演性质，尽管并非毫无后果。”尽管预计实质成果有限，拉普森仍警告，美国的盟友和伙伴，包括韩国，应密切关注相关讨论，以确保自身安全利益不受损害。拉普森说：“至于包括首尔在内的盟友和伙伴，他们在某种程度上被冷落了，只能尽可能依靠特朗普的高级幕僚，让他们及时了解事态进展，并帮助确保总统不会在他们的核心利益方面偏离轨道。”

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title: Korea seeks to reconstruct aging embassy in US amid uncertainty over funding
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary: The foreign ministry said Monday that it has been seeking to reconstruct its aging embassy building in Washington in a project estimated to cost 264.6 billion won ($198 million), but its funding request has not yet been included in next year's government budget proposal.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 外交部周一表示，政府一直寻求重建其位于华盛顿的老旧使馆大楼，该项目预计耗资2646亿韩元（1.98亿美元），但相关资金申请尚未纳入明年的政府预算提案。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: The foreign ministry said Monday that it has been seeking to reconstruct its aging embassy building in Washington in a project estimated to cost 264.6 billion won ($198 million), but its funding request has not yet been included in next year's government budget proposal. The ministry made the request to rebuild the building, which was erected in 1954, in 2023, last year and this year due to safety issues, limits to performing diplomatic activities in the aging facilities and concerns about the impact on the national image, it said. The budget subcommittee of the National Assembly's finance, economy, planning and budget committee did not discuss the embassy reconstruction issue in a recent budget deliberation session, an official at the legislature's foreign affairs committee said, a sign that the project could again fail to move forward this year. Major reconstruction projects for overseas diplomatic missions are funded through the finance ministry's state property management fund rather than the foreign ministry's general account budget. Thus the reconstruction issue falls under the jurisdiction of the Assembly's finance committee. In 1990, Korea bought the current embassy building from another country that used it as its military attache's office
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 在资金不确定的情况下，韩国寻求重建美国境内老旧大使馆
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 外交部周一表示，该部一直寻求重建其位于华盛顿、年久失修的大使馆大楼，项目估算耗资264.6亿韩元（1.98亿美元），但其资金申请尚未列入明年的政府预算提案。该部表示，由于安全问题、陈旧设施限制外交活动以及担忧影响国家形象，于去年和今年再次提出重建这栋建于1954年的大楼。国民议会财政、经济、规划和预算委员会的预算小组委员会在最近一次预算审议会议上没有讨论大使馆重建问题。议会外交事务委员会的一名官员称，这表明该项目今年可能再次无法推进。驻外外交机构的大型重建项目通过财政部的国家财产管理基金而非外交部的一般账户预算提供资金。因此，大使馆重建问题属于国民议会财政委员会的管辖范围。1990年，韩国从曾将现有使馆大楼用作武官办公室的另一国家手中买下该建筑

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body: Korea's space industry seeks to turn its growing technological capabilities into international business opportunities as government officials and industry representatives from 18 countries gather in Seoul for a forum focused on commercial space cooperation. The Ministry of Foreign Affairs and Korea AeroSpace Administration jointly hosted the second Global New Space Forum at the Four Seasons Hotel Seoul on Monday, bringing together representatives of about 40 Korean companies and government officials from 18 countries and international organizations. The gathering aims to connect Korean space companies with overseas agencies and identify opportunities for joint research, technology demonstrations and commercial partnerships. The forum follows the successful fifth launch of Korea's Nuri rocket in October and builds on diplomatic efforts to expand the country's international space network, the organizers said. Kim Jin-a, second vice foreign minister, said in a video address that the growing role of private companies in space exploration had created new diplomatic challenges involving technology cooperation, market access, safety and sustainability. She highlighted three priorities for space diplomacy: creating practical cooperation opportunities between governments and businesses, contributing to the development of international space rules and helping Korean companies enter overseas markets through diplomatic missions and global networks. Kwon Hyun-joon, deputy administrator of the Korea AeroSpace Administration, said the private-sector-led space era had made space a new arena for international cooperation. He called for strengthening Korea's position as a responsible partner in the global space community, accelerating international space exploration projects and building commercial space supply chains with trusted partners. Ibrahim Al Qasim, deputy director-general of the United Arab Emirates Space Agency, delivered the keynote address on the role of governments in encouraging private sector innovation and international cooperation. Two panel discussions examined how geopolitical changes are affecting space partnerships and what policies are needed to expand commercial cooperation. More than 70 one-on-one business-to-government meetings were arranged between Korean companies and overseas officials, offering opportunities to discuss specific projects. The organizers said they would continue supporting Korean companies through overseas business delegations, including planned visits to Mexico and Brazil in December. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.title_zh: 韩国寻求全球太空合作伙伴关系，私营部门发挥主导作用
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/te.body_zh: 韩国正力图将其不断增强的技术能力转化为国际商业机遇。18个国家政府官员和业界代表齐聚首尔，参加一场聚焦商业航天合作的论坛。外交部与韩国宇宙航空厅于周一首尔四季酒店联合主办第二届全球新空间论坛，汇集韩国约40家企业的代表、18个国家政府官员以及国际组织代表。此次会议旨在为韩国航天企业牵线海外机构，并寻找联合研究、技术示范和商业合作机会。主办方表示，此次论坛承接韩国“阿里三号”火箭于10月成功完成第五次发射，并延续了扩大韩国国际航天网络的外交努力。外交部次官金振娥在视频致辞中表示，私营企业在航天探索中的作用日益增强，带来了涉及技术合作、市场准入、安全和可持续发展的新外交挑战。她提出航天外交的三项重点：创造政府与企业之间务实合作机会，推动国际空间规则制定，并通过外交使团和全球网络帮助韩国企业进入海外市场。韩国宇宙航空厅副厅长权贤俊表示，由私营部门主导的航天时代使太空成为国际合作的新舞台。他呼吁加强韩国作为全球航天共同体负责任伙伴的地位，加快国际航天探索项目，并与值得信赖的合作伙伴共同构建商业航天供应链。阿拉伯联合酋长国航天局副局长易卜拉欣·卡西姆发表主旨演讲，探讨政府如何鼓励私营部门创新与国际合作。两场专题讨论分析了地缘政治变化如何影响航天伙伴关系，以及扩大商业合作需要哪些政策。活动还安排了70多场韩国企业与海外官员之间的一对一会谈，为讨论具体项目提供机会。主办方表示，将继续通过海外商务代表团支持韩国企业，其中包括计划于12月组织赴墨西哥和巴西的访问。本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.summary_zh: 文化、体育和旅游部将于周二主办一场论坛，探讨人工智能（AI）在文化、体育和旅游领域的运用，以及这些行业应如何转向人工智能。该部周一表示，第四届文化、体育和旅游数字创新论坛将以“人工智能带来新文化”为主题，于首尔瑞草区L Tower举行。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/lifestyle/p.body: The Ministry of Culture, Sports and Tourism will host a forum Tuesday on how artificial intelligence (AI) is being used in culture, sports and tourism and on how these sectors should shift to AI. The ministry said Monday the fourth Culture, Sports and Tourism Digital Innovation Forum, themed “New Culture Through AI,” will be held at L Tower in Seoul’s Seocho District. About 400 people from government, public institutions and the private sector are expected to attend. State-affiliated bodies are co-organizing the event, including the Korea Culture Information Service Agency, Arts Council Korea, the Korea Sports Promotion Foundation, the Korea Tourism Organization and the Korea Creative Content Agency. The forum will open with an awards ceremony for 15 winners of an AI and cultural data contest. They were chosen in five categories across three fields: new technology, cultural data use and data analysis. Five winners will receive the culture minister’s award. Winning entries include an AI service that lets users talk with historical figures based on historical records and an AI service that rearranges music for people with cochlear implants. Another is a customized AI service for children based on traditional folk tales. A Sungkyunkwan University professor will give the keynote speech on how to live in a world being reshaped by AI. Four breakout sessions will follow on AI in culture and sports, the arts, tourism and content. Topics include responsible use of AI in artistic creation, robots and real-time translation in tourism and AI strategies for visual effects and gaming. At booths in the venue, visitors can try generative AI photo services, AI-based body shape analysis with personalized workout recommendations and real-time interpretation. “The ministry will continue to expand the use of cultural data and support the AI transition in the field to spread digital innovation that people can feel,” a ministry official said. The company said the approach is intended to give Korean employees convenient access to familiar meals while introducing American workers to the cuisine amid growing local interest in Korean food culture. Pulmuone Food & Culture plans to use the Arizona operation as a base for expanding into facilities run by other Korean companies in North America. https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.title: NNPC’s ₦210 trillion question: Not missing is not the same as accounted for, By Posi Olatubosun
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.summary: Reviewing NNPC’s audited financial statements from 2017 to 2023, the committee identified about ₦103 trillion recorded as accrued expenses and about ₦107 trillion recorded as sundry receivables. NNPC’s former Chief Financial Officer told the committee that the company’s total revenue between 2017 and 2023 was about ₦54.5 trillion. He offered this as proof that ₦210 trillion could not be missing.
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.summary_zh: 委员会审查了尼日利亚国家石油公司2017年至2023年的经审计财务报表，发现约₦103万亿被记作应计费用，约₦107万亿被记作其他应收款。尼日利亚国家石油公司前首席财务官向委员会表示，公司2017年至2023年的总收入约为₦54.5万亿。他以此为证，说明不可能有₦210万亿不翼而飞。
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.body: The facts are not in dispute. Reviewing NNPC’s audited financial statements from 2017 to 2023, the committee identified about ₦103 trillion recorded as accrued expenses and about ₦107 trillion recorded as sundry receivables. The accrued expenses, according to lawmakers, covered items such as retention fees, legal fees and audit fees without specific breakdowns, and NNPC linked part of them to joint venture cash calls. The committee rejected that explanation, noting that the cash call regime had been abolished with effect from January 2017. The receivables, NNPC said, were owed by defunct banks and other entities, yet no debtors or amounts were named. At about $117 billion, the receivables alone are larger than the economy of many African countries. To understand why both sides can claim to be right, we must be clear about what these accounting terms mean, and this is where the public debate has gone astray. Accrued expenses are liabilities: costs the company says it has incurred but not yet paid. Receivables are assets: amounts the company says others owe it. Neither represents cash that has left the company. In that narrow sense, the former officials are correct that ₦210 trillion has not “disappeared”. But the narrow sense is the wrong test. The real test in accounting is whether a balance is supported by evidence. A liability nobody can itemise and an asset nobody can identify are not bookkeeping details; they are red flags. Consider the scale. NNPC’s former Chief Financial Officer told the committee that the company’s total revenue between 2017 and 2023 was about ₦54.5 trillion. He offered this as proof that ₦210 trillion could not be missing. Yet the same figure raises a harder question. How can a company accrue unpaid expenses of ₦103 trillion, almost twice its total revenue over seven years? How can it claim receivables of ₦107 trillion from debtors it will not name? Either these balances include large items that are not what their labels suggest, or they reflect unreconciled entries that have accumulated, possibly on both sides of the balance sheet, over many years. Neither explanation inspires confidence. The first concern, therefore, is the quality of the accounts. Under the International Financial Reporting Standards that NNPC applies, receivables must be assessed for recoverability. A debt owed by a bank that no longer exists is, by definition, unlikely to be collected, and should be impaired. If ₦107 trillion of receivables cannot be traced to identifiable debtors, the asset side of NNPC’s balance sheet may be materially overstated. Equally, accrued liabilities must be supported by obligations the company can identify and measure. Unsupported accruals are not prudence; they are a failure of control. The second concern is the role of the external auditors. The committee chairman put the question bluntly: if reconciliation was not done, why did the auditors sign off on the financial statements? International Standards on Auditing require auditors to obtain sufficient, appropriate evidence for material balances, including confirmations for significant receivables and support for accounting estimates. Where they cannot, they are expected to modify their opinion. In July, the committee gave NNPC’s auditors one week to provide a complete schedule of every component of the receivables and payables, and rejected their claims of confidentiality. Auditors are paid to stand behind the figures they certify. Nigerians are entitled to know what evidence supported these balances and what opinion was given. The third concern is governance. The dispute has dragged on for months, with written explanations rejected, summonses ignored and, in June, a warrant of arrest issued against Mr Kyari after he failed to appear. Whatever the merits of each side’s arguments, a public company that cannot produce a schedule of its own receivables after months of parliamentary scrutiny has a governance problem. The committee has raised other queries too, including about ₦5 trillion charged as direct production costs between 2017 and 2021 and an alleged ₦3.8 trillion duplication of subsidy deductions. Each deserves a documented answer, not a press statement. The fourth concern is the market. NNPC has signalled its intention to list on the stock exchange. After the success of the Dangote refinery offer, Nigerians have shown real appetite for owning shares in national energy assets. But no serious investor will buy into a company whose balance sheet contains ₦210 trillion of unexplained entries. Credible accounts are not a favour to the Senate; they are the price of access to capital. What should happen now? Four steps are needed, and each addresses a distinct weakness this dispute has exposed. First, NNPC should publish a full reconciliation of both balances, itemised by counterparty, date and nature, with supporting evidence. This is the starting point because every other step depends on it. A reconciliation turns two aggregate numbers into a list of specific claims that can be checked: who owes NNPC money, whom NNPC owes, since when and for what. It would quickly separate genuine obligations, such as amounts due from joint venture partners or government agencies, from legacy entries that no longer have any basis. Publication matters as much as preparation. NNPC manages the nation’s oil wealth on behalf of all Nigerians, so its accountability runs not only to the Senate but to the public. Months of written explanations exchanged behind closed doors have not settled the matter; open disclosure would. Second, an independent forensic audit, by a firm with no prior relationship with NNPC, should verify that reconciliation. A reconciliation prepared by management is only as credible as those who prepare it, and the same institution produced the balances now in question. A statutory audit tests whether financial statements are fairly presented; a forensic audit goes further, tracing transactions to their source documents and establishing whether any loss, error or misconduct occurred. Independence is essential. Firms that audited or advised NNPC during the affected years cannot credibly review their own work. Only an investigator with no stake in the outcome can produce an answer the public will accept. Third, the Financial Reporting Council of Nigeria should review the conduct of the audits for the affected years and act where standards were not met. Audit exists to give users of accounts reasonable assurance that material balances are supported by evidence. If auditors certified ₦210 trillion of balances without sufficient evidence, the failure is not only NNPC’s; it is a failure of the assurance system on which investors, lenders and citizens rely. The Council is the regulator charged with overseeing audit quality. Holding auditors to account in a case of this prominence would send a clear signal to the profession and strengthen confidence in every audited account in Nigeria, not just NNPC’s. Fourth, any receivables that cannot be substantiated should be impaired and any unsupported accruals reversed, with the effect on past results disclosed transparently. Financial statements must reflect economic reality. Carrying uncollectable receivables overstates assets and equity, while unsupported accruals distort liabilities and past profits. Both give a misleading picture of the company’s financial health and of what it should be remitting to the Federation Account. Correcting the balances under the relevant standards, including restating prior periods under IAS 8 where the errors are material, would give NNPC a clean starting point. Disclosing the effect openly would show that the company is prepared to confront its past rather than bury it, which is the minimum any future investor will expect. Ultimately, the issue is not whether ₦210 trillion was stolen; it is whether the national oil company’s accounts can be trusted at all. An entity that manages the country’s most valuable resource on behalf of every Nigerian must meet the highest standard of financial reporting, not the lowest. “Bookkeeping issues” on this scale are not a technicality to be explained away. They are a failure of accountability that must be fixed, transparently and in full, before NNPC asks Nigerians to trust it with their savings. Posi Olatubosun is a UK-based academic faculty member in accounting and finance
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.title_zh: 尼日利亚国家石油公司的210万亿奈拉之问：未失踪并不等于已有交代，作者：波西·奥拉图博松
https://www.premiumtimesng.com/opinion/9.body_zh:
事实并无争议。审查尼日利亚国家石油公司2017年至2023年的经审计财务报表后，委员会发现约₦103万亿被记为应计费用，约₦107万亿被记为其他应收款。据议员称，这些应计费用包括保留费、律师费和审计费等项目，但没有具体明细；尼日利亚国家石油公司则将其中一部分与合资项目资本催缴款挂钩。委员会驳斥了这一解释，指出资本催缴制度自2017年1月起已经废除。尼日利亚国家石油公司称，这些应收款是已倒闭银行及其他实体所欠，但既未列明债务人，也未列明金额。仅应收款一项就约合1170亿美元，超过许多非洲国家的经济规模。要理解双方为何都能声称自己正确，就必须弄清楚这些会计术语的含义，而公众辩论的偏差恰恰在于此。应计费用是负债，即公司声称已经发生但尚未支付的成本。应收款是资产，即公司声称他人欠付给自己的款项。两者均不代表已经离开公司的现金。从这个狭义角度看，前任官员的说法是正确的，即₦210万亿并没有“消失”。但狭义标准并非正确标准。会计领域的真正标准，是一项余额是否有证据支持。无人能够逐项列明的负债和无人能够确认的资产，并非无关紧要的记账细节，而是危险信号。

Consider the scale. 尼日利亚国家石油公司前首席财务官告诉委员会，公司2017年至2023年的总收入约为₦54.5万亿。他以此证明₦210万亿不可能不翼而飞。然而，同一个数字也提出了一个更难回答的问题。一家公司怎么可能计提₦103万亿的未付费用，这几乎相当于其七年总收入的两倍？它又怎么可能声称拥有₦107万亿的应收款，却拒绝透露债务人身份？这些余额要么包含与其标签所示含义不符的大额项目，要么反映了多年来累积、且可能同时出现在资产负债表两侧的未核对分录。两种解释都无法令人信服。

因此，第一项关切是账目的质量。根据尼日利亚国家石油公司采用的《国际财务报告准则》，应收款必须评估可收回性。一家已不复存在的银行所欠债务，按定义就不太可能收回，因此应当计提减值。如果₦107万亿的应收款无法追溯至可识别的债务人，那么尼日利亚国家石油公司资产负债表的资产端可能被严重高估。同样，应计负债必须由公司能够识别和计量的义务提供支持。缺乏依据的应计项目不是审慎，而是控制失效。

第二项关切是外部审计师的作用。委员会主席直截了当地提出问题：如果没有进行核对，审计师为何仍会在财务报表上签字？《国际审计准则》要求审计师为重大余额获取充分、适当的证据，包括对重大应收款实施函证，以及取得会计估计的支持证据。在无法取得这些证据时，审计师应当修改审计意见。7月，委员会要求尼日利亚国家石油公司的审计师在一周内提供应收款和应付款各项组成部分的完整明细表，并驳回了他们以保密为由提出的异议。审计师领取报酬，就应当为自己所认证的数字负责。尼日利亚人民有权知道，这些余额得到了哪些证据支持，以及审计师出具了何种意见。

第三项关切是治理。这场争端已持续数月，书面解释遭到驳回，传票无人理会；6月，Kyari先生因未出庭而被签发逮捕令。无论双方论据的实质如何，一家公众公司在接受议会数月审查后，仍无法提供自身应收款的明细表，就存在治理问题。委员会还提出了其他疑问，包括2017年至2021年计入直接生产成本的₦5万亿，以及据称重复计算补贴扣减的₦3.8万亿。每项疑问都应得到有文件依据的答复，而不是新闻声明。

第四项关切是市场。尼日利亚国家石油公司已表示有意在证券交易所上市。丹格特炼厂发行获得成功后，尼日利亚人民已表现出持有国家能源资产股票的强烈意愿。但任何认真的投资者都不会投资一家资产负债表含有₦210万亿无法解释分录的公司。可信的账目不是参议院的恩惠，而是获得资本的代价。

现在该怎么办？需要采取四个步骤，每一步都针对这场争端暴露出的不同弱点。第一，尼日利亚国家石油公司应公布对两项余额的完整核对结果，并按交易对手、日期和性质逐项列明，同时提供支持证据。这是起点，因为其他每一步都依赖于此。核对会把两个汇总数字转化为可核查的具体债权清单：谁欠尼日利亚国家石油公司钱，尼日利亚国家石油公司欠谁的钱，欠了多久，因何而产生。它能迅速将合资伙伴或政府机构应付的款项等真实义务，与已经毫无依据的历史遗留分录区分开来。公布与编制同样重要。尼日利亚国家石油公司代表全体尼日利亚人民管理国家石油财富，因此它不仅对参议院负责，也对公众负责。数月来在闭门情况下 exchanged 的书面解释未能解决争端；公开披露则可以。

第二，应由一家与尼日利亚国家石油公司此前没有任何关系的公司开展独立法证审计，核验上述核对结果。由管理层编制的核对结果，其可信度取决于编制者，而相关余额正是同一机构形成的。法定审计检验财务报表是否得到公允列报；法证审计则更进一步，将交易追溯至原始凭证，并确定是否发生了损失、差错或不当行为。独立性至关重要。在受影响年度为尼日利亚国家石油公司提供审计或咨询服务的公司，无法令人信服地审查自己的成果。只有对调查结果没有任何利害关系的调查者，才能给出公众接受的答案。

第三，尼日利亚财务报告委员会应审查受影响年度审计工作的执行情况，并在审计标准未得到遵守时采取行动。审计的存在，是为了向账目使用者合理保证重大余额有证据支持。如果审计师在没有充分证据的情况下认证了₦210万亿的余额，失责的就不仅是尼日利亚国家石油公司，也是投资者、贷款人和公民赖以信赖的审计保证体系的失败。委员会是负责监督审计质量的监管机构。在如此引人注目的案件中追究审计师责任，将向审计行业发出明确信号，并增强公众对尼日利亚所有经审计账目的信心，而不只是对尼日利亚国家石油公司账目的信心。

第四，任何无法得到证实的应收款都应计提减值，任何缺乏支持的应计项目都应予冲销，并透明披露其对以往业绩的影响。财务报表必须反映经济现实。结转无法收回的应收款会高估资产和权益，而缺乏支持的应计项目会扭曲负债和以往利润。两者都会对公司财务健康状况及其应向联邦账户上缴的款项作出误导性描绘。依据相关准则更正这些余额，包括在错误金额重大时依据《国际会计准则第8号》重述以前期间，将为尼日利亚国家石油公司提供一个干净的起点。公开披露相关影响，将表明公司愿意面对过去，而不是将其掩盖；这也是未来任何投资者都会提出的最低要求。

归根结底，问题不在于₦210万亿是否遭到盗用，而在于国家石油公司的账目究竟能否信赖。一家代表每一位尼日利亚人民管理国家最宝贵资源的实体，必须达到财务报告的最高标准，而不是最低标准。如此规模的“记账问题”不是可以用技术性理由搪塞过去的细节，而是必须透明、彻底予以修复的失责问题，然后尼日利亚国家石油公司才能要求人民继续信任它管理自己的积蓄。Posi Olatubosun是一名常驻英国的会计与金融学教师。
