MANILA, Philippines – Chinese Premier Li Qiang on Monday, November 16, hailed what he called “truly extraordinary” achievements of China and Southeast Asia in the face of global trade restrictions, expressing Beijing’s commitment to free trade at a summit ahead of US President Donald Trump’s arrival. In remarks to leaders of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations in Manila, Li said that at a time of growing unilateralism and protectionism and recurring geopolitical conflict, economic relations between China and ASEAN had only strengthened. “The past five years have been truly extraordinary, and the achievements we scored have not come easily,” he said, citing annual trade with the 11-member ASEAN last year of more than $1 trillion and cumulative two-way investment of more than $500 billion. “We remain firmly committed to safeguarding multilateralism and promoting free trade and endeavor to make the pie bigger,” he said. China is ASEAN’s biggest trading partner and a key source of investment, but the biggest economies of the bloc — which has a combined GDP of more than $3.9 trillion – are keen to expand ties with the United States amid trade and diplomatic uncertainty under the Trump administration. Trump is due to arrive in Manila on Tuesday, November 17, towards the end of the summit ahead of his trip to the Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation forum in Shenzhen, where a trilateral meeting with Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin is scheduled. Anti-Trump protests are expected when he arrives in Manila, after four days of demonstrations and the burning of Trump effigies by leftist groups, students, and workers demanding an end to the Middle East war and the scrapping of the US-led Pax Silica initiative. In Manila, Trump will meet ASEAN leaders and attend his first meeting of the Quad group of Indo-Pacific powers — the US, Japan, Australia, and India — the first such gathering in two years. His predecessor Joe Biden saw the Quad as a signature foreign policy achievement and stressed the importance of maintaining it during his six meetings with the group. The Quad is widely considered an attempt to counterbalance China’s influence in the region, including by Beijing, although its members have said the grouping is not directed against any one country. ASEAN held talks on Monday with the leaders of Australia, South Korea and the United Nations, whose Secretary-General Antonio Guterres reiterated calls for a ceasefire in Ukraine and for greater humanitarian access in war-torn Myanmar. Referring to trilateral talks planned in Shenzhen on Thursday, Guterres also said the UN was ready to fully engage on any denuclearization initiative between the United States, Russia and China, despite a lack of certainty about such an outcome. Trump has previously said he thought a denuclearization deal with Russia and China was possible. China’s Foreign Ministry on Monday said the trilateral talks would “promote world peace and stability”. “This is what we would like to see,” Guterres said about denuclearization. “It’s not yet guaranteed that we will get there.” South Korean President Lee Jae-myung on Monday proposed new initiatives on AI and creative industries to ASEAN and said negotiations to expand their free trade deal were progressing. “We must respond proactively to the changing global trade environment and move forward together towards an era of $300 billion in annual trade,” he said. The ASEAN leaders’ summit ended on Sunday without completing a protracted code of conduct with Beijing to try to manage disputes over the South China Sea, which ASEAN chair the Philippines had hoped could be wrapped up this year. ASEAN also resolved to continue its policy of excluding Myanmar’s leaders from its summits, but left the door open for a return if “sustained and concrete progress” on a peace plan agreed long ago with ASEAN can be demonstrated. The meeting also saw an apology from Indonesian President Prabowo Subianto to neighbouring Singapore and Malaysia over the impact of sustained transboundary haze from months of wildfires. – Rappler.com Loading Related Topics Discover more through topics that were hand-picked by our editors in relation to this article. https://www.rappler.com/philippines/chin.title_zh: 在Trump访问前，中国总理赞扬与东盟的“非凡”关系
https://www.rappler.com/philippines/chin.body_zh: 你于2026年11月16日晚上6:10（PHT）关注了此话题 路透社 你关注了这位作者 收听本文 升级即可收听 由Speechify提供支持 已经拥有Rappler+？登录以收听开创性新闻报道。 中国领导人在东盟峰会上。 在马尼拉举行的第29届东盟—中国峰会暨东南亚国家联盟（东盟）第49届峰会期间，中国总理李强向菲律宾总统费迪南德·马科斯 Jr. 示意，越南总理黎明兴和新加坡总理黄循财在一旁观看拍照环节。 中国总理李强赞扬中国与东盟之间牢固的经济联系，强调尽管全球贸易面临挑战，双方贸易额仍超过1万亿美元，投资额达到5000亿美元。 在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普准备抵达马尼拉之际，预计将有人抗议其政府的政策；与此同时，东盟领导人讨论区域合作以及推动无核化的工作。 本文由人工智能生成。 阅读文章以了解完整背景。报告错误。 马尼拉，菲律宾——中国总理李强于11月16日星期一赞扬了他所称中国与东南亚“真正非凡”的成就，表示尽管全球贸易限制不断增多，北京仍承诺推动自由贸易。 东盟峰会在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普抵达前举行。李强在马尼拉向东盟各国领导人发表讲话说，在单边主义和保护主义日益抬头、地缘政治冲突反复出现的情况下，中国与东盟之间的经济关系只会更加紧密。 “过去五年真正非同寻常，我们取得的成就来之不易，”他说。去年，他所在的11成员国东盟与中国的年贸易额超过1万亿美元，双向累计投资额超过5000亿美元。 “我们仍坚定致力于维护多边主义并促进自由贸易，努力把蛋糕做大，”他说。 中国是东盟最大的贸易伙伴和重要投资来源，但特朗普政府治下贸易与外交形势不确定，这个集团中最大的经济体都希望扩大与美国的关系。 特朗普预计于11月17日星期二抵达马尼拉，在峰会接近尾声时启程前往深圳参加亚太经济合作论坛；他将在那里参加与中国国家主席习近平、俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京举行的三方会议。 左翼团体、学生和工人持续进行了四天示威，并焚烧特朗普塑像，要求结束中东战争以及废弃美国主导的“Pax Silica”倡议，预计特朗普抵达马尼拉时将发生反特朗普抗议。 在马尼拉，特朗普将会见东盟领导人，并出席 Indo-Pacific 四大国集团——美国、日本、澳大利亚和印度——的首次会议，这是两年来该集团首次举行此类集会。 他的前任乔·拜登将四方安全对话视为其标志性外交政策成果，并强调在六次集团会议中维持这一机制的重要性。 外界普遍认为，四方安全对话是制衡中国在地区影响力的努力，包括对北京施加影响，不过其成员表示，该集团并非针对任何单一国家。 东盟星期一与澳大利亚、韩国和联合国的领导人举行会谈。 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯再次呼吁在乌克兰实现停火，并呼吁加强对战火破坏的缅甸的人道主义准入。 古特雷斯谈及计划于星期四在深圳举行的三方会谈时还说，尽管结果尚不确定，联合国仍准备全面参与美国、俄罗斯和中国之间的任何无核化倡议。 特朗普此前曾表示，他认为俄罗斯与中国达成无核化协议是可能的。 中国外交部星期一表示，三方会谈将“促进世界和平与稳定”。 谈及无核化，古特雷斯说：“这正是我们希望看到的。但目前还不能保证我们能够实现这一目标。” 韩国总统李在明星期一向东盟提出有关人工智能和创意产业的新倡议，并称扩大双方自由贸易协定的谈判正在取得进展。 “我们必须主动应对不断变化的全球贸易环境，共同迈向年贸易额3000亿美元的时代，”他说。 东盟领导人峰会于星期日结束，未能与北京完成旨在管控南海争端争议的长期行为准则。 担任东盟轮值主席国的菲律宾原本希望今年能够完成该准则。 东盟还决定继续将缅甸领导人排除在峰会之外，但表示，如果能够证明在东盟多年前达成一致的和平计划上取得“持续和具体进展”，仍为其重返峰会保留空间。 会议期间，印度尼西亚总统普拉博沃·苏比anto还就持续数月的野火造成的跨境烟霾影响，向邻近的新加坡和马来西亚道歉。 ——Rappler.com 加载 相关话题 通过我们的编辑为本文精选的相关主题，进一步发现更多内容。以上选择由人工智能生成。阅读文章以了解完整背景。报告错误。 通过我们的编辑为本文精选的相关主题，进一步发现更多内容。升级至Rappler+，获取独家内容和无限访问权限。

https://www.inquirer.net/495840/marcos-f.summary_zh: 菲律宾马尼拉——菲律宾总统费迪南德·马科斯 Jr. 应在中国举行的第33届亚太经合组织经济领导人会议上优先推动贸易、投资和区域经济一体化，超越地缘政治议题，以推进菲律宾利益。阅读：马科斯在亚太经合组织峰会上对企业首席执行官表示：“菲律宾开放、准备就绪并充满期待”。菲律宾于11月主办完东盟峰会及相关峰会后。
https://www.inquirer.net/495840/marcos-f.body: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. should prioritize trade, investment, and regional economic integration at the 33rd Apec Economic Leaders’ Meeting in China, moving beyond geopolitical issues to advance the Philippines’ interests. China is the world’s second-largest economy by nominal gross domestic product (GDP) and the largest by purchasing power parity. Hosting the Apec meeting will help set the tone for how member economies pursue economic growth and cooperation. READ: Marcos to CEOs at Apec Summit: ‘PH open, ready, and eager’ After concluding the Philippines’ hosting of the Association of Southeast Asian Nations Summits and Related Summits on Nov. 17 in Manila, Marcos will fly to China’s “Silicon Valley,” Shenzhen, on Nov. 18 to represent the nation at the economy-centered meeting. Apec serves as a regional economic forum that leverages the growing interdependence of the Asia-Pacific. It aims to ensure that goods, services, investment, and people move easily across borders. In November 1989, the Philippines and 11 other founding countries—Australia, Brunei Darussalam, Canada, Indonesia, Japan, South Korea, Malaysia, New Zealand, Singapore, Thailand, and the United States—established it in Canberra, Australia. Hong Kong, China, and Chinese Taipei joined in 1991, followed by Mexico and Papua New Guinea in 1993, and Chile in 1994. Four years later, Peru, Russia, and Viet Nam joined as well, bringing the full membership to 21. This year marks China’s third time hosting the meeting, following Shanghai in 2001 and Beijing in 2014. Apec chose Shenzhen, a major technology and manufacturing hub in South China, as its host city. What started as a humble fishing village has transformed into an economic and technology center. Now, it will showcase China’s economic modernization, technological prowess, and reform and opening-up policy. Under the theme “Building an Asia-Pacific Community to Prosper Together,” China set the core priorities: open trade, digital economy and AI growth, and regional connectivity and inclusion. At the 37th Apec Ministerial Meeting in Beijing, Chinese Foreign Minister Wang Yi said China is ready to collaborate with member economies to build a progressive Asia-Pacific community. READ: China, ASEAN make progress on SCS pact but can’t finish talks this year The 21 Apec member economies account for around 61 to 62 percent of the global gross domestic product. In this context, Wang called on members to uphold the multilateral trading system under the World Trade Organization. He also underscored the importance of collective efforts to build an innovation ecosystem, accelerate digital and intelligent transformation, and open up new areas for cooperation. For his part, Commerce Minister Wang Wentao said member economies should pursue the Free Trade Area of the Asia-Pacific and eliminate trade and investment obstacles. Additionally, he said member economies should explore a trust-based partnership in the digital and AI economies. China, along with the United States, is a leading country in AI, and its roadmap for the years ahead will be a main topic at the leaders’ meeting. Various meetings have already occurred ahead of the leaders’ meeting on November 18 to 19. These include the 2026 APEC Finance Ministers’ Meeting held in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region and the 12th Apec Transport Ministers’ Meeting in Beijing. The 4th Apec Business Advisory Council Meeting runs from November 14 to 16, followed by the Apec Ministerial Meeting on November 16 and 17 and the APEC CEO Summit on November 17 and 18. READ: AFP to VP: Defending PH rights isn’t ‘picking a fight with China’ Like Marcos, US President Donald Trump will head to Shenzhen after the 49th Asean Summit for potential bilateral talks with Chinese President Xi Jinping. Similarly, Russian President Vladimir Putin, Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi, and South Korean President Lee Jae-myung will also reportedly attend the event. While details of Marcos’ agenda on the sidelines of the Apec Leaders’ Meeting have yet to be provided, the public is watching for the possibility of bilateral meetings with Xi and Trump, although these remain long shots. To recall, Marcos met with the host country’s leader, Lee, during the 32nd Apec meeting in Gyeongju, South Korea, in 2025. Also, Marcos will likely use the economy-focused Apec CEO Summit to woo investors to the Philippines amid global turbulence. Member economies will release an Apec Leaders’ Declaration, a document that outlines their collective agreements, commitments, and strategic goals. They will also announce their commitments on regional trade and investment while updating the public on the agreements reached regarding AI and digital trade. Meanwhile, the public eagerly anticipates hearing about the concerns Filipino businesses raise regarding regional economic integration and whether Marcos will address maritime issues during his meetings. /pai
https://www.inquirer.net/495840/marcos-f.title_zh: 马科斯在中国举行的亚太经合组织峰会上面临平衡各方关系 challenge
https://www.inquirer.net/495840/marcos-f.body_zh: 马尼拉，菲律宾——菲律宾总统费迪南德·马科斯 Jr. 应在中国举行的第33届亚太经合组织经济领导人会议上优先推动贸易、投资和区域经济一体化，超越地缘政治问题，以促进菲律宾利益。中国按名义国内生产总值计算是世界第二大经济体，按购买力平价计算则位居第一。主办此次亚太经合组织会议将有助于为各成员经济体追求经济增长与合作确立方向。阅读：马科斯在亚太经合组织峰会上对首席执行官们表示：“菲律宾开放、准备就绪，充满期待”。菲律宾于11月17日在马尼拉结束东南亚国家联盟峰会及相关峰会的承办工作后，马科斯将于11月18日飞往中国“硅谷”深圳，代表国家出席这场以经济为中心的会议。亚太经合组织是一个区域经济论坛，利用亚太地区日益增强的相互依存关系。其目标是确保货物、服务、投资和人员跨境自由流动。1989年11月，菲律宾与另外11个创始国——澳大利亚、文莱达鲁萨兰、加拿大、印度尼西亚、日本、韩国、马来西亚、新西兰、新加坡、泰国和美国——在澳大利亚堪培拉共同创立了该组织。1991年，中国香港和中华台北加入，随后墨西哥和巴布亚新几内亚于1993年加入，智利于1994年加入。四年后，秘鲁、俄罗斯和越南也加入，使正式成员数量增至21个。今年是中国第三次主办该会议，此前曾于2001年和2014年分别在上海和北京举行。亚太经合组织选择中国南方重要的技术和制造业中心深圳作为主办城市。这个曾经不起眼的渔村如今已转型为经济和科技中心。现在，深圳将展示中国的经济现代化、技术实力以及改革开放政策。中国以“建设亚太共同体，促进共同繁荣”为主题，确定了核心优先事项：推进贸易开放、数字经济和人工智能增长，以及加强区域互联互通与包容。在北京举行的第37届亚太经合组织部长级会议上，中国外交部长王毅表示，中国愿与各成员经济体合作，建设开放进步的亚太共同体。阅读：中国与东盟在南海行为准则问题上取得进展，但今年无法完成谈判。亚太经合组织21个成员经济体约占全球国内生产总值的61%至62%。在此背景下，王毅呼吁成员维护世界贸易组织框架下的多边贸易体系。他还强调，要通过集体努力建设创新生态系统、加快数字化和智能化转型，并开辟新的合作领域。商务部长王文涛则表示，各成员经济体应推进亚太自由贸易区建设，消除贸易和投资障碍。他还表示，各成员经济体应探索建立数字经济和人工智能经济中的互信伙伴关系。中国与美国是人工智能领域的领先国家，未来数年的发展路线图将是领导人会议的主要议题之一。在11月18日至19日的领导人会议之前，各场会议已陆续举行，其中包括在香港特别行政区举行的2026年亚太经合组织财长会议，以及在北京举行的第12届亚太经合组织交通部长会议。第4届亚太经合组织工商咨询理事会会议于11月14日至16日举行，随后是11月16日至17日的亚太经合组织部长级会议，以及11月17日至18日的亚太经合组织首席执行官峰会。阅读：法新社致菲律宾副总统：捍卫菲律宾权利并非“与中国发生冲突”。与马科斯一样，美国总统唐纳德·特朗普将在第49届东盟峰会后前往深圳，可能与中国国家主席习近平举行双边会谈。据报道，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京、日本首相高市早苗和韩国总统李在明也将出席该活动。尽管亚太经合组织领导人会议边会活动的安排尚未公布，但公众仍在关注马科斯是否可能与习近平和特朗普举行双边会谈，尽管这种可能性仍然不大。回顾一下，2025年亚太经合组织会议在韩国庆州举行时，马科斯曾与东道国领导人李在明会面。此外，在全球经济动荡之际，马科斯很可能利用以经济为重点的亚太经合组织首席执行官峰会吸引投资者赴菲律宾。各成员经济体将发布《亚太经合组织领导人宣言》，概述各方共同达成的协议、承诺和战略目标。各方还将宣布在区域贸易和投资方面的承诺，并就人工智能和数字贸易达成的协议向公众通报。与此同时，公众也热切期待了解菲律宾企业对区域经济一体化的关切，以及马科斯是否会在会议期间处理海上问题。 /pai

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.summary_zh: 统一部周一表示，正在密切关注朝鲜高级官员对莫斯科的访问。此次访问发生在美国、中国和俄罗斯领导人计划举行峰会前几天。统一部发言人尹民浩周一在例行记者会上说：“这是本周计划举行的峰会前，朝鲜与俄罗斯之间进行的高级别交流。”
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body: The unification ministry said Monday it is closely watching a senior North Korean official's trip to Moscow, which comes just days before a planned summit of the leaders of the United States, China and Russia. Jo Yong-won, a secretary of the Central Committee of the ruling Workers' Party of Korea (WPK), has been visiting Moscow since Saturday as the head of a party and government delegation, according to the Korean Central News Agency (KCNA). He is known as a close aide to North Korean leader Kim Jong-un. The KCNA said the visit comes as the "militant friendship" and "relations of alliance" between Pyongyang and Moscow grow stronger "with each passing day." The purpose and schedule of the trip have not been disclosed. "It is a high-level exchange between North Korea and Russia right before this week's planned summit," ministry spokesperson Yoon Min-ho said at a regular briefing Monday. "We will watch closely what Jo's role would be as head of both a party and a government delegation," he said, drawing a contrast with Kim Song-nam, a member of the WPK's Political Bureau and party secretary, who traveled to China earlier this month on a party-to-party visit. Jo's trip comes days before U.S. President Donald Trump, Chinese President Xi Jinping and Russian President Vladimir Putin are due to meet on the sidelines of an Asia-Pacific Economic Cooperation summit in Shenzhen, China, on Thursday. It is the latest in a run of high-level overtures from Pyongyang to China and Russia. It has fueled speculation that the North is seeking to build diplomatic leverage ahead of any talks with Washington

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/world/20261.body_zh: 朝鲜统一部周一表示，正密切关注朝鲜劳动党中央委员会秘书赵容元（Jo Yong-won）访问莫斯科的行程；此次访问发生在美国总统、中国和俄罗斯领导人计划举行峰会前几天。据朝鲜中央通讯社（KCNA）报道，统治朝鲜的劳动党（WPK）中央委员会秘书赵容元自周六起以党和政府代表团团长的身份访问莫斯科。他是朝鲜领导人金正恩的亲密助手。朝鲜中央通讯社称，平壤与莫斯科之间的“战斗友谊”和“联盟关系”正“日益加强”，此次访问正是在这一背景下进行的。此次访问的目的和日程尚未公布。统一部发言人尹民浩周一在例行记者会上说：“这是本周计划举行的峰会前夕，朝鲜与俄罗斯之间的一次高层交流。”他说：“我们会密切关注赵容元以党和政府代表团双重身份出访所发挥的作用。”他同时将此次访问与劳动党政治局委员、党中央秘书金松南早些时候本月对中国的党际访问作比较。赵容元的行程安排在美国总统唐纳德·特朗普、中国国家主席习近平和俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京计划于周四在中国深圳出席亚太经济合作组织峰会期间会晤前几天。这是平壤近期一系列对华和对俄高层接触活动中的最新一次。它引发了外界猜测：朝鲜可能正寻求在与华盛顿举行任何会谈之前积累外交筹码

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary: HD Hyundai, a Korean shipbuilding, heavy machinery and energy conglomerate, will showcase its latest solar power, energy storage and power grid technologies at North America’s largest clean energy exhibition this week, as the industrial group seeks to expand its presence in the rapidly growing U.S. energy market.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.summary_zh: HD现代是韩国一家涵盖造船、重型机械和能源业务的大型企业集团。本周，该集团将在北美最大的清洁能源展览会上展示其最新光伏发电、储能和电网技术，同时寻求扩大自身在快速增长的美国能源市场中的影响力。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: HD Hyundai, a Korean shipbuilding, heavy machinery and energy conglomerate, will showcase its latest solar power, energy storage and power grid technologies at North America’s largest clean energy exhibition this week, as the industrial group seeks to expand its presence in the rapidly growing U.S. energy market. HD Hyundai Energy Solutions and HD Hyundai Electric will jointly participate in RE+ 2026, which runs from Tuesday through Thursday at Las Vegas Convention Center, company officials said Monday. The two affiliates will present technologies spanning solar power generation, energy storage and conversion, and electricity transmission and distribution, highlighting their integrated capabilities across energy infrastructure. HD Hyundai Energy Solutions will unveil its G12R TOPCon Multi-Cut solar module in North America for first time, featuring technology that divides large-area solar cells into smaller sections to reduce power losses during current transmission. The technology enables module efficiency of 24.4 percent by increasing power density, with company planning to gradually introduce advanced Multi-Cut technology across its production lines. HD Hyundai Electric will showcase battery energy storage systems (BESS) and technologies designed to stabilize power grids, including its 96-megawatt Anjwa Island project in Korea’s Sinan County and 100-megawatt Rutile project in Texas. It will also introduce grid-forming technology, which actively controls grid voltage and frequency to improve electricity supply stability, alongside power equipment targeting North American electricity networks and data centers. “Technical capabilities of products, as well as stable supply capacity and project execution capabilities, are emerging as key competitive factors in North American market,” an HD Hyundai official said. “Through this exhibition, we will expand cooperation with local customers and partners and identify tangible business opportunities,” the official said. HD Hyundai Electric is expanding its North American manufacturing operations and BESS business through its Texas subsidiary, while HD Hyundai Energy Solutions is leveraging its integrated domestic solar cell and module production system to address changing U.S. supply chain regulations, including foreign entity of concern requirements. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body: LS Electric said Monday it has won a $93.83 million (130 billion won) order to supply power distribution equipment for a hyperscale artificial intelligence (AI) data center. The center is being built by a U.S. Big Tech company, and the order adds to LS Electric’s run of contracts in North America. Under the deal, the Korean power equipment maker will deliver 38-kilovolt high-voltage switchgear and low-voltage switchgear in stages. Switchgear takes in electricity, distributes it among circuits and cuts off faulty lines, which makes it a core part of a data center’s power network. Hyperscale data centers are very large facilities that technology companies run to handle cloud and AI workloads. The company did not name the client. It said it has supplied high-voltage switchgear to the customer’s project from its first phase through the current expansion. LS Electric said “time to power,” the time it takes for a data center to secure electricity and start operating, has become a key competitive factor as AI grows rapidly. It credited the repeat orders to its product quality and its ability to meet tight delivery schedules. The company pointed to its production network: a smart factory in Cheongju, North Chungcheong Province, LS Electric Utah and the Bastrop Campus in Texas. LS Electric also aims to grow beyond the alternating current systems that dominate the market and into direct current distribution, which it sees as a next-generation technology. It runs a factory in Cheonan, South Chungcheong Province, which it says is the world’s first manufacturing plant to operate commercially on direct current power. The site tests solid-state transformers, solid-state circuit breakers and energy storage systems for future grids and data centers. “This order once again recognizes the quality of our power equipment and our project capabilities in the North American market,” a company official said, noting that LS Electric recently signed a long-term supply deal with another Big Tech firm. https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.title_zh: LS Electric赢得9400万美元订单，为美国人工智能数据中心供应电力设备
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/business/co.body_zh: LS Electric周一表示，公司获得了一份价值9383万美元（1300亿韩元）的订单，将为一座超大规模人工智能数据中心供应配电设备。该中心由一家美国大型科技公司建设，此次订单进一步增加了LS Electric在北美市场的连续中标记录。根据协议，这家韩国电力设备制造商将分阶段交付38千伏高压开关设备和低压开关设备。开关设备用于接入电力、将电力分配至各条线路并切断故障线路，因此是数据中心电力网络的核心组成部分。超大规模数据中心是科技公司运营的超大型设施，用于处理云计算和人工智能工作负载。LS Electric没有透露客户名称，但表示已从客户项目的一期工程开始，持续为其当前扩建项目供应高压开关设备。LS Electric表示，随着人工智能迅速发展，数据中心获得供电并开始运营所需的“供电准备时间”已成为一项关键竞争因素。公司将连续获得订单归功于其产品质量以及按严格交付周期完成供货的能力。公司还介绍了其生产网络，包括位于忠清北道清州的智能工厂、LS Electric Utah以及位于得克萨斯州的Bastrop园区。LS Electric还希望拓展业务，突破目前占据市场主导地位的交流电系统，进入其视为下一代技术的直流配电领域。公司在忠清南道天安运营一座工厂，并称该厂是全球首家采用直流电进行商业化运营的制造工厂。该场地测试固态变压器、固态断路器和储能系统，为未来电网和数据中心提供技术支撑。公司一名官员表示：“这项订单再次印证了我们的电力设备质量以及我们在北美市场的项目能力。”他还指出，LS Electric近期与另一家大型科技公司签署了长期供应协议。本文在生成式人工智能协助下完成，并由《韩国时报》编辑。

https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.summary_zh: 据题为《国际教育交流开放之门报告》的报告称，最近的下降主要是因为攻读研究生课程的印度学生人数大幅减少34%，从2024—2025年的177,892人降至116,609人。不过，参与OPT的印度学生人数增加了27%，达到182,201人。OPT允许国际毕业生在完成学位后赴美国积累工作经验。
https://www.hindustantimes.com/india-new.body: It was released to the public on Monday. HT was given early access to a copy of the report. According to the report, titled Open Doors Report on International Educational Exchange, the latest decline was driven largely by a 34% drop in Indian students pursuing graduate programmes, whose numbers fell from 177,892 in 2024–25 to 116,609. Undergraduate enrolments also dipped marginally to 39,711 from 40,135. However, the number of Indian students participating in OPT, which allows international graduates to gain work experience in the US after completing their degrees, rose 27% to 182,201. Across all academic levels, 57% of international students were enrolled in science, technology, engineering and mathematics (STEM) fields. Mathematics and computer science, with 286,168 students, and engineering, with 214,193, were the most popular fields. Meanwhile, OPT participation among international students rose 14% to 335,785. The number of new international students — those enrolling at a US institution for the first time — fell 18% to 228,123. The report’s fall 2026 snapshot, based on responses from more than 800 US higher education institutions, points to a further slowdown. Overall international student numbers declined 9%, with new enrolments falling 15%. Graduate enrolments dropped 15%, undergraduate numbers 3% and OPT participation 6%. The decline comes amid tightening US immigration measures and visa-related uncertainties. HT reported on October 23 that arrivals of Indian students in the US on F and M category visas had plunged 39% year-on-year to 25,321 in August 2026. Experts and study-abroad consultants cited stricter visa screening, delays in appointments and processing, higher rejection rates and uncertainty over post-study employment opportunities, including OPT, as factors affecting student mobility

https://www.myjoyonline.com/aetc-ministr.body: The engagement reaffirmed AETC’s commitment to working alongside government and key stakeholders to equip young people with the skills, opportunities and support systems required to become drivers of Africa’s energy transition and economic transformation. The delegation was received by the George Opare Addo, Minister for Youth Development and Empowerment, who welcomed AETC’s vision and acknowledged the important role that indigenous Pan-African institutions can play in supporting Ghana’s development priorities. The meeting provided an opportunity for AETC to share the Centre’s strategic initiatives while exploring areas of collaboration that align with the Ministry’s vision of empowering young people through innovation, entrepreneurship, leadership development and sustainable job creation. She emphasised that empowering young people must remain central to Africa’s long-term development strategy, particularly as the continent seeks to accelerate industrialisation, innovation and inclusive economic growth. Ms. Akumah also highlighted the vision of the Youth Energy Entrepreneurship & Incubation Programme (YEEIP), one of AETC’s flagship initiatives designed to nurture the next generation of African entrepreneurs, innovators and business leaders. She explained that the programme seeks to provide young people with technical capacity building, entrepreneurship training, mentorship, business incubation and strategic industry partnerships that will enable them to develop innovative solutions while creating sustainable employment opportunities within the energy and technology sectors. She further noted that the programme closely aligns with the Ministry’s mandate to empower young people through innovation, entrepreneurship and leadership development. Building on this, Ms. Akumah introduced the Africa Building on this, Ms. Akumah introduced the Africa Energy Youth Forum (AEYF), an initiative of the YEEIP that gives young people a voice of their own in the energy, oil and gas and technology sectors. She explained that the Forum provides a dedicated platform for young professionals, students, entrepreneurs and innovators to engage directly with policymakers, industry leaders and investors, to share their perspectives on the issues shaping these sectors, and to contribute ideas and solutions for Africa’s energy future. Through the AEYF, AETC seeks to ensure that young Africans are not only beneficiaries of the continent’s energy transition, but active participants in shaping the policies, investments and innovations that will define it. The Minister commended AETC for its strategic vision and expressed appreciation for the Centre’s growing contribution towards youth development and innovation. He underscored the importance of creating sustainable pathways that enable young Ghanaians to develop practical skills, build successful enterprises and actively contribute to the country’s socio-economic development. He further encouraged stronger collaboration between government and indigenous institutions whose programmes complement national development priorities and create meaningful opportunities for young people. A key outcome of the engagement was the mutual commitment to commence the development of a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Ministry of Youth Development and Empowerment and the Africa Energy Technology Centre. The proposed framework is expected to establish a long-term strategic partnership that will provide a structured platform for implementing practical, measurable and sustainable interventions aimed at advancing youth empowerment across Ghana. implementation roadmap and facilitate effective coordination between the Ministry and AETC. Both parties reaffirmed their commitment to maintaining close engagement as technical teams work towards formalising the proposed partnership framework. https://www.inquirer.net/495812/ridon-we.summary_zh: 里登在一份声明中说：“随着东盟［东南亚国家联盟］峰会今天开幕，有必要澄清：西菲律宾海属于菲律宾。”在东盟成员国再次会晤、讨论包括地区安全关切在内的多项事务之际，里登发表了这份声明，尤其是因为多个国家声称拥有南海不同区域的主权。
https://www.inquirer.net/495812/ridon-we.body: In a statement, Ridon said: “With the opening of the Asean [Association of Southeast Asian Nations] Summit today, it is important to clarify: The West Philippine Sea belongs to the Philippines. The West Philippine Sea is for the Filipinos.” “Although we have relations with China in different aspects, from diplomatic, economic, trade, cultural, and other areas, there is a red line in discussions about the WPS,” he added. Ridon issued the statement as Asean member states meet again to discuss several matters, including security concerns over the region, especially since several nations have claimed ownership of different portions of the South China Sea. “Ang sovereign rights of the WPS, the use of resources under the seabed, islands, and waters of the WPS are for the Philippines only. These are for Filipinos only,” he noted. The Philippines is hosting the 49th Asean Summit and Related Summits from Nov. 15 to 17, for regional leaders to discuss key political, security, and economic issues. The main events will be held at the Philippine International Convention Center in Pasay City. Chinese President Xi Jingping will not attend, but Premier Li Qiang will be in Manila for the summit. Li’s attendance, however, comes as Manila and Beijing’s ties were strained due to tensions over the disputed portions of the South China Sea, and the Chinese Embassy in the Philippines’ dispute with several local officials, including Philippine lawmakers. Last October, some members of the Philippine House of Representatives called out Chinese Ambassador to the Philippines Jing Quan for saying that while China can easily win in a military contest, it seeks a peaceful resolution to the dispute. READ: China can ‘easily win’ using force, but wants peace, says envoy to PH The envoy warned that the Philippines faced a greater risk of confrontation if it did not reestablish direct military-to-military communications, which have been suspended by Defense Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr. for about three years now. According to members of the House’s Young Guns bloc, true peace will not be attained if one side makes threats, saying that Jing’s statements carry a threat, not an assurance of peace. “Threat is not an assurance of peace,” Deputy Speaker Paolo Ortega V said last Oct. 16. “When a larger power tells a smaller nation that it could easily win if it chose force, it is not offering security. It is asserting dominance and expecting silence in return. That is the opposite of peace.” READ: Solons to Chinese envoy: No peace if one party uses threats Due to this squabble, former Surigao del Norte Rep. Robert Ace Barbers and Mamamayang Liberal Party-list Rep. Leila de Lima separately warned the Philippines about the possibility of China suddenly playing negotiator when Asean member-states convene for the 49th summit. Barbers said last Oct. 29 that Philippine authorities should be wary of the possible “double-talk” from China, noting that it cannot be a good negotiator if it cannot even peacefully settle differences over the WPS. The former lawmaker clarified that he is not prejudging China’s intentions. Rather, he would prefer authorities to be on guard, considering the said country’s aggressive actions over disputed waters. In 2016, the Permanent Court of Arbitration (PCA) ruled in its award that the Philippines has exclusive rights over its waters, including the WPS, as China’s nine-dash line claim lacks legal or historical basis. This means that the WPS, a body of water that forms part of the South China Sea, belongs to the Philippines as it sits inside the country’s exclusive economic zone. China has insisted, however, on ownership of many islands inside the WPS, despite the award. Philippine-Chinese ties recovered during the administration of President Rodrigo Duterte, who once called the PCA award a piece of paper that can be thrown in the waste bin. But since President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. assumed office in 2022, relations have been strained again, as his administration insists that the Philippines will not cede an inch of its territory to foreign powers. Several incidents between the two countries’ water assets have been well-documented: just this July, the Armed Forces of the Philippines reported that a Navy man was injured after members of the Chinese Coast Guard (CCG) assaulted him during a confrontation at Ayungin Shoal. https://www.inquirer.net/495812/ridon-we.body_zh: 在一份声明中，Ridon表示：“随着东盟[东南亚国家联盟]峰会今天开幕，有必要澄清：西菲律宾海属于菲律宾。西菲律宾海属于菲律宾人。”他补充说：“虽然我们与中国在外交、经济、贸易、文化及其他领域都有关系，但在有关西菲律宾海的讨论中有一条红线。”东盟成员国再次会晤，讨论包括地区安全关切在内的多项事务，尤其是因为多个国家声称南海不同部分的所有权。Ridon是在这一背景下发表声明的。他指出：“西菲律宾海的主权权利、海床下的资源以及西菲律宾海内的岛屿和海域，只属于菲律宾。这些只属于菲律宾人。”菲律宾正主办11月15日至17日举行的第49届东盟峰会及相关峰会，供地区领导人讨论重要的政治、安全和经济问题。主要活动将在帕赛市的菲律宾国际会议中心举行。中国国家主席习近平不会出席，但国务院总理李强将赴马尼拉参加峰会。然而，在马尼拉与北京因南海争议海域紧张局势而关系趋紧之际，中国驻菲律宾大使馆与包括菲律宾议员在内的多名地方官员发生争执，而李强的出席恰逢此时。去年10月，菲律宾众议院部分议员指责中国驻菲律宾大使景泉，称尽管中国在军事对抗中很容易获胜，但寻求和平解决争端。阅读：中国可用武力“轻易获胜”，但希望和平，该国驻菲律宾大使警告说 这位大使警告，如果菲律宾不恢复直接军事沟通，对抗风险将更大；菲律宾国防部长Gilberto Teodoro Jr.已经暂停这种沟通约三年。据众议院“青年枪手”集团成员称，如果一方发出威胁，真正的和平就无法实现；他们表示，景泉的言论是一种威胁，而不是和平保证。众议院副议长Paolo Ortega V于去年10月16日说：“威胁不是和平保证。当一个更大的强国告诉一个小国，如果它选择使用武力就很容易获胜时，它提供的不是安全，而是在宣示支配地位，并期待对方保持沉默。这与和平背道而驰。”阅读：议员向中国特使表示，一方使用威胁就不会有和平 由于这场纷争，前北苏里高省众议员Robert Ace Barbers和自由党-list众议员Leila de Lima分别警告菲律宾，在东盟成员国举行第49届峰会之际，要防范中国突然扮演谈判者的可能。Barbers于去年10月29日表示，菲律宾当局应当警惕中国可能发出的“两面话”，并指出，如果中国连西菲律宾海的分歧都不能以和平方式解决，就不可能成为合格的谈判者。这位前议员澄清，他并非预判中国的意图，而是希望当局保持警惕，因为该国在争议水域采取了强硬行动。2016年，常设仲裁法院（PCA）在其裁决中认定，菲律宾对其水域拥有专属权利，包括西菲律宾海，因为中国的“九段线”主张缺乏法律或历史依据。这意味着西菲律宾海作为南海的一部分，位于菲律宾专属经济区内，因此属于菲律宾。然而，尽管有该项裁决，中国仍坚称拥有西菲律宾海内许多岛屿的所有权。菲律宾总统Rodrigo Duterte执政期间，菲中关系有所恢复；他曾称PCA裁决不过是一张可以扔进垃圾桶的废纸。但自总统Ferdinand Marcos Jr.于2022年就任以来，两国关系再次紧张，因为其政府坚持菲律宾不会向外国力量让出任何领土。两国海上力量之间的数起事件已有充分记录：就在今年7月，菲律宾武装部队报告称，在Ayungin Shoal发生的一场冲突中，中国海警局（CCG）人员袭击了一名海军人员，导致其受伤。阅读：议员称，中国在水域问题上表现得像“并骑作案”的罪犯 2023年8月，中国海警局船只向菲律宾船只使用水炮，而菲律宾船只当时只是试图向BRP Sierra Madre上的士兵运送物资。您的订阅无法保存。请重试。您的订阅已成功。针对这一事件，中国声称，前一届政府曾承诺将BRP Sierra Madre撤出Ayungin，但该承诺尚未落实。Marcos随后表示，他本人没有达成这项协议；如果存在这样的协议，也已经终止。/atm 如需全面报道和深入分析，请访问我们关于西菲律宾海最新动态的专题页面。通过文章、视频和专家观点了解最新信息

Unlock these with Subscription India and the U.S. have already agreed that Indian goods in the American market will receive preferential market access compared to competitor nations, Commerce and Industry Minister Piyush Goyal said on Sunday (November 15, 2026). India and the U.S. finalised the framework for the first phase of the bilateral trade agreement in February. The deal was to be signed earlier, but changes in the U.S. tariff landscape have led to further negotiations on the agreement. “This was already agreed between the leaders — President [Donald] Trump and Prime Minister Narendra Modi — when they announced that we have both come to a broad framework agreement a few months ago and it has been acknowledged that India will get preferential trade access in the U.S. with lower duties than our competitor countries,” Mr. Goyal told reporters in Cairo. He is in Cairo on a two-day visit to discuss ways to boost trade and investment between India and Egypt. The Minister was replying to a question about the U.S. assurance that Indian goods will get preferential market access. An official has recently stated that the U.S. has assured India of a comparative tariff advantage over competing countries under the proposed bilateral trade agreement (BTA), with both sides working to conclude the first tranche by the end of the current financial year. “We will have to see how the tariff framework unfolds. We are working towards closing the first tranche by the end of this financial year. Talks are going for the first tranche and the broader BTA,” the official said last week. The extent of the advantage to Indian goods, however, will depend on the tariff framework eventually agreed upon. https://www.euronews.com/2026/11/15/aust.body: Share Comments Add Euronews on Google Share Facebook Twitter Flipboard Send Reddit Linkedin Messenger Telegram VK Bluesky Threads Whatsapp The Philippines is building closer military ties with Australia, Japan and the US as tensions with China continue in the South China Sea. The partnerships cover joint exercises, surveillance equipment and closer coordination between their forces. Australia and the Philippines signed a defence agreement on Sunday to make joint patrols, military exercises and disaster relief operations easier to organise, Philippine officials said. Philippine Defence Secretary Gilberto Teodoro Jr and Australian Ambassador Marc Innes-Brown signed the agreement in Manila, with Australian Prime Minister Anthony Albanese attending the ceremony during his visit for regional summits. The Defence Cooperation Arrangement updates a 1995 agreement. It builds on a separate visiting forces agreement, in force since 2012, which already allows troops from each country to train on the other’s territory. Teodoro said the new arrangement would simplify the procedures for carrying out joint activities. “Rather than 100 steps to do a single thing, it will just now take 10,” he told reporters, according to Reuters. He said closer cooperation between the countries’ naval, air and ground forces would help the Philippines deter threats, including in the South China Sea. Australia said the agreement covered information sharing, military planning and training, monitoring activity at sea and developing defence infrastructure. Asked whether the pact was intended to counter China, Albanese said: “This isn’t aimed at any one country. This is about supporting sovereignty of every country.” He said most Australian trade passed through the South China Sea and stressed the importance of keeping shipping routes open. Australia also announced additional funding for its Southeast Asia Maritime Partnerships programme. It will provide regional partners with aerial and surface drones, secure communications equipment and training to help detect and respond to threats at sea and cyberattacks. The announcement did not give a funding figure. The agreement follows several recent steps by the Philippines to strengthen military ties with its partners. On 9 November, Japan agreed to supply coastal radar and surveillance drones to the Philippine military under a 4.3 billion yen (€24 million) grant. The equipment is intended to help monitor ships in waters around the country. In a statement released on 10 November, Australia, Japan, the Philippines and the United States also committed to a joint military coordination centre in the Philippines. They agreed to coordinate defence investments and expand joint exercises. China’s claims in the South China Sea overlap with those of the Philippines and several other Southeast Asian countries. Beijing has previously criticised Manila’s joint military activities with its partners, saying they increase regional tensions. An international tribunal ruled in 2016 that China’s claims of historic rights to resources had no legal basis where they exceeded the rights granted by the UN Convention on the Law of the Sea. Beijing rejects the ruling

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.body: The Kaduna State Government has attributed Governor Uba Sani’s emergence as the 2026 recipient of The Sun Governor of the Year Award to his administration’s efforts in peace building, infrastructure development, healthcare, education and inclusive governance. The Commissioner for Information and Culture, Ahmed Maiyaki, disclosed this after receiving the award on behalf of Mr Sani at the Expo Convention Centre, Eko Hotels and Suites, Victoria Island, Lagos, over the weekend. Mr Maiyaki said the governor was recognised for what he described as people-centred leadership, efforts to restore public confidence in government institutions and commitment to improving the welfare of residents. He said since assuming office in May 2023, Mr Sani had pursued policies aimed at addressing longstanding development challenges, strengthening public accountability and extending government interventions to underserved communities. One of the administration’s major initiatives, according to the commissioner, is the Kaduna Peace Model, which combines security interventions with dialogue, community engagement and development programmes. Mr Maiyaki said the initiative had helped restore stability in previously troubled communities, allowing residents to return to farming and economic activities. He said more than 500,000 hectares of farmland had been recovered, while schools, healthcare facilities and markets previously affected by insecurity had reopened. The peacebuilding initiative is particularly significant for Kaduna, which has experienced years of banditry, kidnapping and communal violence, especially in parts of its southern and central districts. The restoration of security in rural communities is also important to agricultural production, as insecurity has repeatedly disrupted farming activities, displaced residents and threatened food supplies. On infrastructure, Mr Maiyaki said the administration had embarked on approximately 150 road projects covering about 1,400 kilometres across the state. He said the projects included interventions in 12 local government areas that had reportedly gone nearly 15 years without benefiting from road construction. The government has presented the road programme as part of its strategy to improve rural connectivity, facilitate the movement of agricultural produce and expand access to markets, schools and healthcare services. Mr Sani’s administration has also prioritised urban renewal and the expansion of infrastructure to support economic activities across Kaduna State. In the health sector, the commissioner listed the completion of the 300-bed Bola Ahmed Tinubu Specialist Hospital, the revitalisation of 17 general hospitals and the upgrading of 255 primary healthcare centres to Level 2 among the administration’s achievements. These interventions, according to him, are intended to improve access to medical services and reduce the pressure on major referral hospitals. Education is another major component of the administration’s development agenda. Mr Maiyaki said the government had sustained the allocation of 25 per cent of its annual budget to the sector, reflecting its commitment to improving educational access and infrastructure. The investment comes against the backdrop of longstanding challenges in Kaduna’s education sector, including out-of-school children, inadequate learning facilities and teacher shortages. The commissioner also said the state government had distributed 1,400 truckloads of fertiliser to 450,000 smallholder farmers to support agricultural production and improve food security. He said the intervention was part of efforts to strengthen rural livelihoods and support farmers facing rising production costs. In public transportation, Mr Maiyaki said the deployment of 100 compressed natural gas (CNG) buses had facilitated more than five million passenger trips within 15 months. He added that the initiative had generated estimated savings of N5.2 billion for commuters. The CNG transport programme is also part of the state’s efforts to provide more affordable transportation while reducing dependence on conventional petrol-powered vehicles. Beyond the projects highlighted by the commissioner, the Uba Sani administration has pursued social welfare and economic inclusion programmes, including interventions targeting vulnerable residents, pensioners, women and small businesses. The government has also promoted investment in agriculture, industrial development and renewable energy as part of its broader economic development strategy. Its social intervention programmes have included support for widows, housing initiatives and efforts to improve access to economic opportunities for disadvantaged communities. However, the scale and long-term impact of these programmes will ultimately depend on their sustainability, equitable distribution and measurable improvements in the living conditions of residents. Mr Maiyaki described The Sun award as an encouragement for the administration to intensify its development efforts and strengthen accountability. He said Mr Sani dedicated the recognition to the people of Kaduna State, whose support and cooperation, he added, had continued to inspire his government. The commissioner quoted the governor as pledging to consolidate achievements in peace and security, infrastructure, education, healthcare and other critical sectors. Mr Sani, a former senator representing Kaduna Central, assumed office as governor on 29 May 2023, succeeding Nasir El-Rufai. His administration has made inclusive governance, rural development and peacebuilding central themes of its policies, particularly in communities that have experienced prolonged insecurity and infrastructural neglect. The Sun Governor of the Year Award adds to the recognitions received by the governor since taking office, although the ultimate measure of his administration’s performance will remain the extent to which its policies translate into improved security, public services and living standards for Kaduna residents

https://www.premiumtimesng.com/promoted/.body_zh: 卡杜纳州政府将州长乌巴·萨尼获评《太阳报》2026年度州长奖归功于本届政府在和平建设、基础设施发展、医疗卫生、教育和包容性治理方面所做的努力。周末，信息与文化专员艾哈迈德·马亚基代表萨尼先生在拉各斯维多利亚岛Eko酒店及套房会展中心领奖后透露了上述情况。马亚基先生说，该州长因其所称的以人为本的领导方式、恢复公众对政府机构的信心以及致力于改善居民福祉而受到认可。他说，自2023年5月上任以来，萨尼先生一直推行旨在解决长期发展挑战、加强公众问责并将政府干预措施延伸至服务不足社区的政策。专员表示，本届政府的主要举措之一是“卡杜纳和平模式”，该模式将安全干预与对话、社区参与和发展项目相结合。马亚基先生说，这项举措帮助此前陷入动乱的社区恢复稳定，使居民得以重返农业和经济活动。他说，已有超过500,000公顷农田得到恢复，此前受不安全局势影响的学校、医疗设施和市场也已重新开放。和平建设举措对卡杜纳尤为重要，因为该州多年来一直遭受匪徒劫掠、绑架和宗族暴力，尤其是南部和中部一些地区。恢复农村社区的安全对农业生产同样重要，因为不安全局势屡次扰乱农业活动、迫使居民流离失所并威胁粮食供应。在基础设施方面，马亚基先生说，本届政府启动了约150个道路项目，涉及全州约1,400公里。 said the projects included interventions in 12 local government areas that had reportedly gone nearly 15 years without benefiting from road construction. 政府将这些道路项目作为改善农村交通连接、便利农产品运输以及扩大居民获取市场、学校和医疗服务机会战略的一部分。萨尼先生政府还将城市更新和扩大基础设施列为优先事项，以支持卡杜纳州各地的经济活动。在医疗卫生领域，专员将建成拥有300张床位的博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布专科医院、翻新17家综合医院以及将255家初级医疗中心升级至二级列为本届政府的成就。他说，这些措施旨在改善医疗服务可及性，并减轻大型转诊医院的压力。教育是本届政府发展议程的另一个主要组成部分。马亚基先生说，政府持续将该部门年度预算的25%拨给教育，体现出改善教育可及性和基础设施的决心。这项投入的背景是卡杜纳教育领域长期面临诸多挑战，包括失学儿童、学习设施不足和教师短缺。专员还说，州政府已向450,000名小农户分发1,400车化肥，以支持农业生产并改善粮食安全。他说，这项干预是加强农村生计、支持面临生产成本上涨压力的农民 efforts 的一部分。在公共交通方面，马亚基先生说，部署100辆压缩天然气（CNG）公交车在15个月内完成了超过500万人次出行。他补充称，该项目为通勤者节省了估计N5.2 billion。压缩天然气交通项目也是该州 efforts 提供更实惠交通并减少对传统汽油车依赖的一部分。除了专员重点介绍的项目外，乌巴·萨尼政府还推行了社会福利和经济包容项目，包括针对弱势居民、养老金领取者、妇女和小企业的干预措施。政府还推动对农业、工业发展和可再生能源的投资，作为其更广泛经济发展战略的一部分。其社会干预项目包括援助寡妇、实施住房计划，以及努力改善弱势社区获取经济机会的机会。然而，这些项目的规模和长期影响最终将取决于其可持续性、公平分配以及能否切实改善居民的生活条件。马亚基先生称，《太阳报》的奖项鼓励本届政府加强发展努力并强化问责。他说，萨尼先生将这项荣誉献给卡杜纳州人民，并表示他们的支持与合作持续激励着本届政府。专员援引州长的话称，他承诺巩固和平与安全、基础设施、教育、医疗卫生及其他关键领域的成果。萨尼先生曾任代表卡杜纳中区的参议员，于2023年5月29日就任州长，接替纳西尔·埃鲁法伊。他的政府将包容性治理、农村发展和和平建设作为政策的核心主题，尤其关注那些长期遭受不安全局势和基础设施忽视的地区。《太阳报》年度州长奖为萨尼先生任内所获诸多荣誉增添了又一项认可，不过，衡量其政府表现的最终标准，仍将是相关政策能在多大程度上改善卡杜纳居民的安全、公共服务和生活水平。

就社交媒体的不负责任使用提出关键问题
阿布贾——参议院领袖、埃基蒂中部选区全体进步大会党参议员奥佩耶米·巴米德莱披露，国民议会本周将把《州警察法案》提交给总统博拉·蒂努布签署批准。
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/stat.body: Layer 1 *Raises vital questions on the irresponsible use of social media ABUJA – LEADER of the Senate, Senator Opeyemi Bamidele, APC, Ekiti Central has disclosed that the National Assembly will this week the State Police Bill to President Bola Tinubu for assent. He said the National Assembly is expecting four State Houses of Assembly to turn in their reports on or before the National Assembly reconvenes on November 17, 2026, saying with this development, next week is going to be decisive and defining in the National Assembly. Bamidele said whether the remaining states turn in their reports or not, the National must move forward and fulfil the aspiration of the people. According to Bamidele, the principle of proactive lawmaking guided the resolve of the National Assembly to pass the State Police (Constitution Alteration) Bill, which, according to him, proposed the creation of a Federal Police Service and State Police Services. Bamidele spoke after he received “The Sun Senator of the Year” Award for efficiently managing the business of the parliament and for his proactive approach to lawmaking, which has guided all the undertakings of the Senate since its inauguration in June 2023. In a statement from his Media Directorate on Sunday, the Senate Leader further explained that the creation of the state police service had moved from rhetoric to reality after more than 15 years of unsuccessful attempts to reform the country’s police system. As shown in the records of the National Assembly, Bamidele revealed that no fewer than 32 State Houses of Assembly “have approved the State Police (Constitution Alteration) Bill, 2026. With this, we have successfully crossed the constitutional threshold under Section 9(2) of the Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria, 1999 (as amended). “We are now expecting four State Houses of Assembly to turn in their reports on or before the National Assembly reconvenes on November 17, 2026. This suggests that next week is going to be decisive and defining in the National Assembly. Whether the remaining states turn in their reports or not, we must move forward and fulfil the aspiration of our people. “We are now under obligation to transmit the State Police (Constitution Alteration) Bill, 2026 to the President and Commander-in-Chief of the Armed Forces, His Excellency Bola Ahmed Tinubu, GCFR, for assent. This is a responsibility we must consciously discharge on behalf of our constituents and in the interest of national peace, progress, and stability,” he explained further. Contrary to critics of the State Police bill, Bamidele clarified that the initiative was not designed to create ethnic or state armies, but was about establishing state-led, community-anchored policing within clear constitutional safeguards. The Senate leader said as the parliament of the people, the National Assembly had pursued, consciously and conscientiously, people-centred legislation that had direct bearing on the welfare of citizens. As at November 4th, the six states that were yet to Approve the bill for onward transmission to the National Assembly were Kano, Cross River, Abia, Niger, Benue and Oyo. The Senate however gave the six State Houses of Assembly yet to communicate their positions on the proposed constitutional amendment establishing State Police until November 15 to do so, warning that failure to respond by the deadline could be deemed as withholding approval. The remaining six states were expected to communicate their decisions before November 15, when the National Assembly intends to forward the proposed constitutional amendment to President Bola Tinubu for subsequent. The development brought the proposed restructuring of Nigeria’s policing system closer to the final stage of the constitutional amendment process, with presidential assent expected after the National Assembly completes the necessary procedures. Disclosing this penultimate week while updating lawmakers on the progress of consultations with the 36 state legislatures on the proposed amendment, the Senate Leader had said the number of approvals had exceeded the constitutionally required two-thirds of the 36 state legislatures. Bamidele then said, “Let me explain again, for the avoidance of doubt, three keywords are used in the Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria 1999, as amended. The first word is passage, the second word is approval and the third word is assent. “The reason the writers of our Constitution, our forefathers, put all these specific words is to ensure that no part of the Constitution of the Federal Republic of Nigeria can be easily amended without the buying in of all the critical stakeholders at all levels of governance. “The passage of the bill was the responsibility of the National Assembly, and that has been completed. Approval is required from at least two-thirds of the 36 State Houses of Assembly in the country, while assent must subsequently be given by the President to complete the constitutional amendment process. The Senate Leader explained that the constitutional requirements were deliberately designed to ensure that amendments to the nation’s supreme law enjoyed the participation and agreement of critical stakeholders across the different levels of government. Bamidele stressed that the 30 approvals already received were significantly above the constitutional requirement of 24 states, describing the development as evidence of widespread support for the proposed reform. “Two important points need to be emphasised. First, we needed the approval of at least two-thirds of the states for this constitutional amendment to proceed. “Two things that need to be emphasised here is that we needed two-thirds of the states at the very least for this to pass, and already two-thirds will be 24. So, as of yet, we already got 30 states, showing the popularity of this bill among Nigerians through the elected representatives in the State Houses of Assembly,” he said. The 30 states that as at that week approved the proposal are Adamawa, Akwa Ibom, Anambra, Bauchi, Bayelsa, Borno, Delta, Ebonyi, Edo, Ekiti, Enugu, Gombe, Imo, Jigawa, Kaduna, Katsina, Kebbi, Kogi, Kwara, Lagos, Nasarawa, Ogun, Ondo, Osun, Plateau, Rivers, Sokoto, Taraba, Yobe and Zamfara. He said. “We also championed the National Social Investment Programmes Act, 2023, which gave statutory backing, coordination, and accountability to our social protection system, for poverty reduction, economic inclusion, and social welfare for vulnerable Nigerians. “With the utmost sense of responsibility, we passed the Minimum Wage (Amendment) Act, 2024; Tax Reform Acts, 2025; Investments and Securities Act, 2025; Electoral Act, 2026; Nigerian Insurance Industry Reform Act, 2024; and Regional Development Commissions Acts, among others. Each of these laws has transformed our economy, strengthened public finance, and deepened electoral credibility,” Bamidele said as he rolled out the achievements of the parliament. While thanking the media for serving as formidable partners in deepening the country’s democracy, Bamidele reaffirmed his commitment “to press freedom, an open parliament, and continuous engagement with journalists. But we must work together to define the responsible use of social media.” He raised highly fundamental questions about the devastating activities of some individuals on social media, noting: “We have seen characters assassinated. We have seen public institutions blackmailed. We have watched people deliberately distort facts. We have seen people unjustifiably peddling lies. We cannot fold our hands and allows this illegality to continue. “I have been a victim of these outlawed activities at different times. I know many Nigerians have been victims as well. But the urgent questions are: Should we leave unregulated this space that define our lives in the decades to come? Or do we prefer a space where characters are assassinated daily, lies peddled, and public institutions unjustifiably discredited? “These are questions that key media actors – Newspaper Proprietors’ Association of Nigeria, Broadcasting Organisations of Nigeria, Nigerian Guild of Editors, and Nigeria Union of Journalists – must honestly answer in this age of information technology. Otherwise, we must all brace up for the consequences of our inability to act at the time that matters most. “We all know that information is critical to our national development as much as to our internal stability. Obviously, this suggests that the way we disseminate information, whether through the traditional or social media, must be well guided by international best practices. “This further suggests that information must be disseminated objectively and responsibly with the intention to inform and not disinform; build and not destroy; develop and not blackmail.” Speaking on the award from Sun Newspapers, Bamidele, however, noted that the award was not a personal achievement or trophy, but purely a validation of collective responsibility, thereby dedicating it to Almighty God, President Bola Ahmed Tinubu, GCFR, 108 other senators, and his constituents, who entrusted him with their mandates. According to the statement, ” He received the award Friday night from the Founder of The Sun Publishing Limited and Chairman of the South East Development Commission, Senator Orji Uzor Kalu, accompanied by several serving senators, governors (serving and former), and his political associates from Ekiti and Lagos States. While thanking The Sun Publishing Limited for conferring the prestigious honour on him, Bamidele emphasised again the need to judge the National Assembly not by the volume of bills passed into law, but by the impact of its initiatives on the lives of the people. He said: “I believe in proactive lawmaking. I believe Nigeria must move from reactive governance to proactive governance. I believe our laws must be evidence-based, efficiently implemented, effectively monitored, periodically reviewed, and ultimately measured by their impact on citizens. https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/stat.title_zh: 州警察：参议员Bamidele称，国会本周将把法案提交给蒂努布
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/stat.body_zh: 第一层对不负责任地使用社交媒体提出了重要疑问。阿布贾——参议院领袖、埃基蒂州中部选区的全进步大会党参议员奥佩耶米·巴米德莱透露，国民议会本周将把《州警察法案》提交给总统博拉·蒂努布批准。他说，国民议会预计另外4个州议会将在2026年11月17日复会当日或之前提交报告，并表示，在这一进展下，下周将是国民议会作出决定并奠定基调的一周。巴米德莱说，无论其余各州是否提交报告，国家都必须继续前进，实现人民的愿望。巴米德莱表示，预先立法的原则促使国民议会决心通过《州警察（宪法修正）法案》；据他介绍，该法案提议设立联邦警察机构和州警察机构。巴米德莱是在获得《太阳报》“年度参议员”奖项后发表上述言论的，奖项表彰他高效管理议会事务以及采取主动立法的做法；这种做法指导了参议院自2023年6月就职以来的所有工作。参议院新闻处在周日的声明中进一步解释称，在逾15年未能成功改革国家警察体系之后，设立州警察机构如今已从口头倡议变为现实。国民议会的记录显示，巴米德莱透露，不少于32个州议会“已经批准《2026年州警察（宪法修正）法案》。至此，我们已成功跨越《尼日利亚联邦共和国宪法》1999年修订版第9条第2款规定的宪法门槛。‘目前，我们预计另外4个州议会将在2026年11月17日国民议会复会当日或之前提交报告。这表明，下周将是国民议会作出决定并奠定基调的一周。无论其余各州是否提交报告，我们必须继续前进，实现人民的愿望。‘目前我们有义务将《2026年州警察（宪法修正）法案》提交给武装部队总司令、尼日利亚总统博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布阁下（GCFR）批准。我们必须清醒地履行这项职责，以代表选民行事，并维护国家和平、进步与稳定。’他进一步解释道。与《州警察法案》的批评者相反，巴米德莱澄清，这项倡议并非旨在建立族裔武装或州级军队，而是要在明确的宪法保障下，建立由州主导、以社区为根基的治安体系。参议院领袖表示，作为人民的议会，国民议会始终有意识且认真地推动以人为本的立法，这些法律直接影响公民福祉。截至11月4日，尚未批准该法案、使其能够转交国民议会的6个州是卡诺州、十字河州、阿比亚州、尼日尔州、本乌耶州和奥约州。不过，参议院给予其余6个尚未就是否支持拟议宪法修正案表明立场的州议会截至11月15日提交意见，并警告称，未能在截止日期前回应将被视为拒绝批准。其余6个州预计将在11月15日前传达决定，届时国民议会拟将拟议宪法修正案提交总统博拉·蒂努布，供其随后批准。这一进展使重组尼日利亚治安体系更接近宪法修正程序的最后阶段；在国民议会完成必要程序后，预计将获得总统批准。参议院领袖在倒数第二周向议员通报与36个州议会就拟议修正案展开磋商的进展时透露，赞成数量已经超过宪法规定的36个州议会三分之二门槛。巴米德莱随后说：“为避免疑虑，让我再解释一遍。《尼日利亚联邦共和国宪法》1999年修订版使用了三个关键词。第一个是‘通过’，第二个是‘批准’，第三个是‘ assent（总统批准）’。‘我们的制宪者，也就是我们的先辈之所以使用这些特定术语，是为了确保《尼日利亚联邦共和国宪法》的任何部分，都不能在未获得治理各层级所有关键利益相关方认可的情况下轻易修改。‘通过法案是国民议会的责任，而这已经完成。全国36个州议会中至少三分之二必须予以批准，随后还必须由总统给予批准，才能完成宪法修正程序。’参议院领袖解释，宪法要求经过有意设计，旨在确保国家最高法律修正案得到各级政府关键利益相关方的参与和认同。巴米德莱强调，已经收到的30个州批准显著超过宪法要求的24个州，并将这一进展视为广泛支持拟议改革的证据。他说：“有两点需要强调。第一，这项宪法修正案要继续推进，至少需要获得三分之二各州的批准。‘这里有两件事需要强调：这项法案通过至少需要三分之二各州同意，而三分之二就是24州。迄今我们已经获得30个州的批准，这表明各州议会民选代表把这项法案在尼日利亚人民中的受欢迎程度反映了出来。’他说。截至当周已经批准该提案的30个州是阿达瓦瓦州、阿夸伊博姆州、阿南布拉州、包奇州、贝耶尔萨州、博尔诺州、埃Delta州、埃博尼州、埃多州、埃基蒂州、恩古州、贡贝州、伊莫州、希加瓦州、卡杜纳州、卡齐纳州、凯比州、科吉州、夸拉州、拉各斯州、纳萨拉瓦州、奥贡州、翁多州、奥孙州、博尔乔州、尼日尔河三角洲州、索科托州、塔拉巴州、约贝州和赞法拉州。他说：“我们还推动通过了《2023年国家社会投资计划法》，为我国的社会保护体系提供法定支持、协调机制和问责机制，以减少贫困、实现经济包容，并改善弱势尼日利亚人的社会福利。‘我们以高度责任感通过了《2024年最低工资（修正）法》《2025年税收改革法》《2025年投资与证券法》《2026年选举法》《2024年尼日利亚保险业改革法》以及《区域发展委员会法》等法律。这些法律中的每一项都推动了我国经济转型、强化了公共财政，并提升了选举公信力。’巴米德莱在列举议会成就时说道。在感谢媒体深化国家民主方面发挥强大伙伴作用的同时，巴米德莱重申，他承诺“推动新闻自由、开放议会，并持续与记者互动。但我们必须携手合作，明确负责任地使用社交媒体。”他针对社交媒体上一些 individuals 的破坏性活动提出了极为根本的问题，并指出：“我们看到有人遭到暗杀。我们看到公共机构遭到勒索。我们看到有人蓄意歪曲事实。我们看到有人毫无根据地兜售谎言。我们不能袖手旁观，任由这种违法行为继续下去。‘在不同时候，我也曾是这些非法活动的受害者。我知道许多尼日利亚人也曾是受害者。但迫切需要回答的问题是：我们是否要让这个定义我们未来数十年生活的空间继续处于不受监管状态？还是宁愿拥有一个每天都有人遭到暗杀、有人兜售谎言、公共机构遭到无端诋毁的空间？‘在信息技术时代，这些问题必须由主要媒体参与者——尼日利亚报业协会、尼日利亚广播组织、尼日利亚编辑协会和尼日利亚记者工会——诚实作答。否则，我们所有人都必须做好承受后果的准备，因为我们在最关键的时候未能采取行动。‘我们都知道，信息对于国家发展和国内稳定至关重要。显然，这意味着我们传播信息的方式，无论通过传统媒体还是社交媒体，都必须以国际最佳实践为指导。‘这还意味着，传播信息必须客观、负责，目的是告知而非混淆视听；建设而非破坏；发展而非勒索。’不过，在谈到《太阳报》授予的奖项时，巴米德莱指出，该奖项并非个人成就或战利品，而纯属对集体责任的肯定，因此他将其献给至高的上帝、博拉·艾哈迈德·蒂努布总统（GCFR）、其他108名参议员，以及将授权托付给他的选民。据声明称，他于周五晚从《太阳报》出版有限公司创始人兼东南发展委员会主席奥吉·乌佐尔·卡卢参议员手中接过奖项，多名现任参议员、州长（现任及前任）以及来自埃基蒂州和拉各斯州的政治同仁陪同出席。在感谢《太阳报》出版有限公司授予他这一殊荣时，巴米德莱再次强调，不应以国民议会通过并成为法律的法案数量来评价它，而应以其各项举措对人民生活所产生的影响来衡量。他说：“我相信主动立法。我相信尼日利亚必须从被动反应式治理转向主动治理。我相信我们的法律必须以证据为依据，得到高效执行、有效监督和定期审查，并最终以其对公民的影响来衡量。此处表达的意见不代表《先锋报》的观点或其任何员工的观点

https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.summary_zh: 韩国总统府星期日表示，正在考虑将不得假释的终身监禁纳入一项旨在加强公共安全、打击针对弱势群体犯罪的计划。2023年，内阁批准了一项《刑法》修正案法案，拟引入不得假释的终身监禁，使犯下滔天罪行者永久与社会隔离。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body: South Korea's presidential office said Sunday it is considering life imprisonment without parole as part of an initiative aimed at strengthening public safety and cracking down on crimes targeting vulnerable people. The initiative will focus on crimes targeting socially vulnerable people, including relationship-based crimes and crimes with apparently random motives. The government will also step up efforts to eradicate crimes involving scams, illegal drugs, illegal private lending, digital sex crimes and false or fabricated information, among other offenses that disrupt people's daily lives or threaten public order, presidential chief of staff Lim Kwang-hyun said. Lim said the initiative follows instructions from President Lee Jae Myung at a Cabinet meeting last week to concentrate government-wide resources on protecting people's lives and making daily life safer. "In cases involving economic harm that exploit people's desperate circumstances, we will pursue those responsible even overseas, dismantle the criminal operations at their source and block criminal proceeds," Lim said at a briefing. Under current law, inmates serving life sentences may be considered for parole after serving 20 years. In 2023, the Cabinet approved a bill to amend the Criminal Act to introduce life imprisonment without parole as a means of permanently isolating perpetrators of heinous crimes from society. The proposal would have allowed courts to distinguish between life sentences with and without the possibility of parole. The bill failed to pass the 21st National Assembly before its term expired in May 2024
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.title_zh: 总统办公室考虑在公共安全举措中引入终身不得假释制度
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/southkorea/.body_zh: 韩国总统府周日表示，正在考虑将不得假释的无期徒刑纳入一项旨在加强公共安全、打击针对弱势人员犯罪的计划。该计划将重点打击针对社会弱势人员的犯罪，包括涉及人际关系关系的犯罪以及表面上动机随机的犯罪。总统府首席秘书林光贤表示，政府还将加大力度铲除涉及诈骗、非法毒品、非法私人放贷、数字性犯罪以及虚假或捏造信息的犯罪，并整治其他扰乱民众日常生活或威胁公共秩序的违法行为。林表示，这项计划贯彻了总统李在明上周内阁会议的指示，即集中全国政府资源保护民众生命安全，让日常生活更加安全。林在新闻发布会上说：“对于利用民众陷入绝境之机、造成经济损害的案件，我们将追究幕后的责任人，即使他们身处海外，也要从源头瓦解其犯罪网络并阻断犯罪收益。”根据现行法律，被判无期徒刑的囚犯服刑20年后可获考虑假释。2023年，内阁批准了一项修正《刑法》的法案，拟引入不得假释的无期徒刑，作为使罪行极其严重的犯罪者永久与社会隔绝的手段。该提案原本允许法院区分可能假释与不得假释的无期徒刑。法案未能在本届任期于2024年5月届满的第二届国民议会表决前获得通过

Nvidia topped Korean investors' net-buying list for U.S.-listed stocks from Nov.
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.summary_zh: 投资者无视黄仁勋丑闻，逢低买入。数据显示，上周韩国投资者大举买入Nvidia股票，将前首席执行官Jensen Huang婚外情曝光及其随后辞职所引发的股价大幅抛售视为买入机会。Nvidia自11月以来一直位居韩国投资者净买入美国上市股票的榜首。
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body: Investors shrug off Huang scandal to buy the dip Korean investors aggressively bought Nvidia shares last week, seizing on a steep sell-off triggered by revelations of former CEO Jensen Huang's extramarital affairs and subsequent resignation as a buying opportunity, data showed Sunday. Nvidia topped Korean investors' net-buying list for U.S.-listed stocks from Nov. 9 through Friday, with the amount reaching $319.75 million, according to SEIBro, a data portal operated by the Korea Securities Depository. The figure represented a 717 percent surge from the previous week. The buying marked a sharp reversal from the start of the week, when Korean investors initially sold a net $6.6 million worth of Nvidia shares on Nov. 9 following Huang's public admission of marital infidelity. But the selling was short-lived. Korean investors resumed buying the following day and stepped up purchases on Friday, snapping up a whopping $254.85 million worth of Nvidia shares as the stock plunged as much as 14 percent intraday on news of Huang's resignation. The buying spree extended to domestically listed exchange-traded funds (ETFs). The five Korea-listed ETFs with the highest weightings in Nvidia drew about 1 billion won ($746,268) in net purchases from retail investors over the same period, according to Korea Exchange data. The buying spree suggests that investors viewed Nvidia's steep decline as a bargain-hunting opportunity, analysts say, even as uncertainty surrounding its leadership weighed on the stock. "While the recent scandal involving Jensen Huang has raised uncertainty, we see limited risk of a direct impact on artificial intelligence (AI) demand or supply contracts," said Lee Kyoung-min, an analyst at Daishin Securities. Lee said Nvidia's earnings report next Tuesday (local time) could be a key turning point for a potential rebound not only in Nvidia shares but also in AI and semiconductor stocks more broadly, provided the company demonstrates strong demand and a clear road map for next-generation graphics processing units. Beyond their appetite for Nvidia shares, some Korean investors have also shown support for Huang himself, despite the controversy surrounding his departure. Huang has long enjoyed a favorable reputation in Korea, thanks in part to his repeated praise for Korean chipmakers and his approachable public persona. His widely publicized gathering over fried chicken and beer with Samsung Electronics Chairman Lee Jae-young and Hyundai Motor Group Executive Chair Chung Euisun further charmed the Korean public. Some Koreans have also signed an online petition titled "Stand With Jensen," calling for Huang's reinstatement as Nvidia CEO. The petition had garnered about 126,500 signatures as of noon Sunday. Kim Kyeong-pyo, who identified himself as an Nvidia shareholder, described Huang as a visionary leader and expressed confidence in his leadership. "I strongly believe that Nvidia's continued success depends on Jensen Huang's leadership. I sincerely hope he will continue to lead the company and guide Nvidia toward even greater achievements," Kim wrote
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.title_zh: 英伟达居韩国投资者每周美国股票买入榜首位
https://www.koreatimes.co.kr/economy/202.body_zh: 投资者淡化黄仁勋丑闻，逢低买入Nvidia股份。数据显示，韩国投资者上周大举买入Nvidia股份，把前首席执行官Jensen Huang婚外情曝光及随后辞职引发的股价暴跌视为买入机会。韩国证券存管机构运营的数据门户SEIBro数据显示，从11月9日至周五，Nvidia位居韩国投资者净买入美国上市股票的榜首，净买入金额达到3.1975亿美元，较前一周激增717%。这一买入规模与本周初相比出现显著逆转。Huang公开承认婚姻不忠后，韩国投资者于11月9日最初净卖出价值660万美元的Nvidia股份。但抛售并未持续。韩国投资者于次日恢复买入，并在周五加大购买力度，在Huang辞职消息推动股价盘中一度暴跌14%之际，抄底买入价值高达2.5485亿美元的Nvidia股份。这轮购买热潮还延伸至韩国境内上市的交易型开放式指数基金（ETF）。韩国交易所数据显示，在同一时期内，Nvidia持仓权重最高的5只韩国上市ETF获得散户约10亿韩元（746,268美元）的净买入。分析师表示，这轮购买热潮表明，尽管公司领导层的不确定性压制股价，投资者仍将Nvidia股价的大幅下跌视为低价买入的机会。大信证券分析师Lee Kyoung-min表示：“尽管近期涉及Jensen Huang的丑闻加大了不确定性，但我们认为，人工智能（AI）需求或供应合同受到直接冲击的风险有限。”Lee表示，如果Nvidia展现出强劲需求和清晰的下一代图形处理单元发展路线图，其下周二（当地时间）发布的财报可能成为Nvidia股份乃至更广泛AI和半导体股潜在反弹的关键转折点。除热衷于购买Nvidia股份外，一些韩国投资者也支持Huang本人，尽管他离职引发了争议。Huang长期以来在韩国享有良好声誉，部分原因是他经常称赞韩国芯片制造商，而且其平易近人的公众形象广受认可。他与Samsung Electronics董事长Lee Jae-young及Hyundai Motor Group执行董事长Chung Euisun一起吃炸鸡、喝啤酒的聚会广为传播，也进一步赢得了韩国公众的喜爱。一些韩国人还在网上签署了一份题为“Stand With Jensen”的请愿书，要求Huang恢复Nvidia首席执行官职务。截至周日中午，请愿书已获得约126,500个签名。自称Nvidia股东的Kim Kyeong-pyo称Huang是一位具有远见的领导者，并对其领导能力表示信心。Kim写道：“我坚信，Nvidia持续取得成功有赖于Jensen Huang的领导。我衷心希望他能继续领导公司，带领Nvidia迈向更加辉煌的成就。”

https://unn.ua/en/news/the-united-states.body: The Pentagon is reviewing the plan to withdraw troops from Europe: instead of 25,000, around 5,000 may be withdrawn. Trump will make the decision. The administration of U.S. President Donald Trump may significantly reduce the scale of the planned withdrawal of American troops from Europe. While NATO allies previously feared a reduction of the contingent by 25,000 troops, they now expect the withdrawal of approximately 5,000. Bloomberg reports this, citing informed sources, writes UNN . According to the publication, the Pentagon is reviewing its plans due to increased defense spending by European allies and the importance of U.S. military bases in Europe for operations in the Middle East. In particular, the war with Iran demonstrated how dependent the United States is on European infrastructure for the deployment of troops and aircraft and for supporting combat operations. We have a lot of resources there that are exactly where we need them. I do not expect anything major According to Bloomberg sources, the main reduction may affect Germany, which hosts the largest U.S. military contingent in Europe. At the same time, NATO's eastern flank is planned to be strengthened. Countries bordering Russia have offered to assume part of the costs of maintaining U.S. troops. The final decision will be made by Donald Trump. Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth is expected to present the president with relevant recommendations on December 1. For now, the Pentagon continues to assess possible scenarios and their implications for European security. At the same time, U.S. legislation limits the possibilities for reducing the military presence. Congress previously prohibited reducing the U.S. contingent in Europe below 76,000 service members without the necessary consultations with allies and a risk assessment. According to Bloomberg, political changes following the midterm elections to Congress may also complicate the implementation of a large-scale withdrawal of American troops
https://unn.ua/en/news/the-united-states.title_zh: 美国已审查从欧洲大规模撤军的计划，五角大楼正为特朗普准备新的方案
https://unn.ua/en/news/the-united-states.body_zh: 五角大楼正在重新评估从欧洲撤军的计划：撤军人数可能不是25,000人，而是约5,000人。特朗普将作出决定。美国总统唐纳德·特朗普政府可能会大幅缩减从欧洲撤走美军人员的规模。此前，北约盟国担心驻军规模将削减25,000人，而如今预计将撤走约5,000人。《彭博社》援引知情人士报道了此事，UNN写道。据该出版物报道，由于欧洲盟国增加了国防开支，以及美国在欧洲的军事基地对中东行动的重要性，五角大楼正在重新审视相关计划。特别是，与伊朗的战争表明，美国在部署部队和飞机以及支援战斗行动方面对欧洲基础设施有多大的依赖。我们在当地拥有大量资源，而这些资源恰好位于我们最需要它们的地方。我不预计会有任何重大变化。据《彭博社》消息人士称，削减规模最大的影响可能涉及德国；德国驻有欧洲规模最大的美军部队。与此同时，北约东翼计划得到加强。与俄罗斯接壤的国家已提出承担维持美军驻留的部分费用。最终决定将由唐纳德·特朗普作出。预计国防部长皮特·赫格塞斯将于12月1日向总统提交相关建议。目前，五角大楼仍在评估各种可能方案及其对欧洲安全的影响。与此同时，美国立法限制了减少军事驻军的可能性。国会此前禁止在未与盟国进行必要磋商和风险评估的情况下，将美国驻欧洲部队规模削减至76,000名现役军人以下。据《彭博社》报道，国会中期选举后的政治变化也可能使大规模撤走美军变得复杂

https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.body: BENIN CITY – THE Edo State Commissioner for Information and Strategy, Hon. Kassim Afegbua, on Sunday defended Governor Monday Okpebholo’s pledge to deliver 2.5 million votes for President Bola Tinubu in the 2027 presidential election, describing the figure as a target achievable through massive voter mobilisation and the state government’s development projects. Afegbua, who spoke on Arise Television’s Sunday morning programme, monitored in Benin City, said the target was based on the state’s growing voter population. He said that the Independent National Electoral Commission (INEC) had put Edo’s eligible voters at 2.865 million. The commissioner said the state government was determined to mobilise, sensitise and persuade voters to support Tinubu’s re-election, arguing that the administration’s infrastructure and social development projects had provided reasons for the people to endorse the President. He said, “The context at which we made that statement is the fact that we are setting a target for ourselves. After all, the new voters, as at last week when INEC released the figures, is 2.865 million people. What happens if we get 2.5 million? Is it a crime? “We are doing so much, we are working so much, we are building infrastructure, we are touching the social development aspect, we are building schools, health sectors, and all of that,” he said. Afegbua added that the government’s responsibility was to convince Edo voters to support Tinubu for another term, particularly because of the increased federal allocations to states. He said, “Our responsibility is to woo them, plead with them, appeal to them that they should allow the man who is providing the funding with respect to increase allocation to the state to continue so that they can see more development. “It is even dangerous for economic growth of any country for you to disrupt the flow or the process as it were now, when things are getting stabilised,” Afegbua said, adding that Edo was ready to deliver Tinubu in 2027. The commissioner disclosed that Okpebholo was expected to begin a tour of the state’s 192 polling wards to canvass support for the President, stressing that the government would work to ensure voters were mobilised and their votes counted. “Edo people are ready. We are going to deliver Edo State to President Tinubu, and we are very proud of it, and we are going to work assiduously,” he said. Afegbua also defended the Director-General of Tinubu’s Presidential Campaign Council, former Zamfara State Governor, Abdulaziz Yari, over his remark that Nigerians could still go to the market and find food to buy, urging a holistic interpretation of the statement. He said Yari’s position did not mean the country was without economic challenges, but that food remained available in Nigerian markets, unlike in some foreign countries experiencing grocery shortages. According to him, food availability depended on the markets consumers patronised, noting that direct purchases from farmers and local markets could offer cheaper prices than exclusive stores. Comments expressed here do not reflect the opinions of Vanguard newspapers or any employee thereof
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.title_zh: Afegbua称，2027年Okpebholo为Tinubu赢得250万张选票的目标可以实现
https://www.vanguardngr.com/2026/11/2027.body_zh: 贝宁城——埃多州信息与战略事务专员卡西姆·阿费格布瓦阁下周日为州长蒙代·奥克佩博洛作出的承诺辩护。州长承诺在2027年总统选举中为总统博拉·蒂努布争取250万张选票。阿费格布瓦表示，这一数字是通过大规模动员选民和推动州政府发展项目可以实现的目标。阿费格布瓦在贝宁城收看的Arise Television周日晨间节目中说，这一目标以该州不断增长的选民人口为基础。他说，独立国家选举委员会（INEC）认定埃多州符合条件的选民人数为286.5万。专员表示，州政府决心动员选民、开展选民教育并说服选民支持蒂努布连任，认为政府推动的基础设施和社会发展项目，为民众支持总统提供了理由。他说：“我们作出这一表述的背景，是我们正在为自己设定目标。毕竟，截至上周INEC公布数据时，新登记选民为286.5万人。如果我们获得250万张选票，会是犯罪吗？”“我们正在开展如此多的工作，我们正在建设基础设施，正在改善社会发展的各个方面，正在建设学校、医疗部门以及所有相关设施，”他说。阿费格布瓦补充说，政府的责任是说服埃多州选民支持蒂努布再任一任，特别是因为联邦向各州拨款有所增加。他说：“我们的责任是争取他们、恳求他们、劝导他们，让这些人允许那个提供资金、促使州获得更多拨款的人继续执政，好让他们看到更多发展成果。”“如今各项事务正在趋于稳定，任何国家若要扰乱这一资金流动或程序，对经济增长而言甚至都是危险的，”阿费格布瓦说，并补充表示，埃多州已准备好在2027年为蒂努布赢得胜利。专员透露，奥克佩博洛预计将开始走访该州192个投票站，为总统争取支持，并强调政府将努力确保选民得到动员，其选票得到统计。“埃多州人民已经准备好了。我们将把埃多州交给蒂努布总统。对此我们深感自豪，并将不懈努力，”他说。阿费格布瓦还为蒂努布总统竞选委员会主任、前扎姆法拉州州长阿卜杜勒阿齐兹·亚里辩护。亚里曾表示，尼日利亚人仍可去市场购买食物，阿费格布瓦敦促应全面理解这番言论。他说，亚里的立场并不意味着尼日利亚不存在经济困难，而是与一些遭遇食品杂货短缺的外国相比，尼日利亚市场上仍有食品供应。他认为，食品能否买到取决于消费者光顾哪些市场，并指出，直接向农民购买或前往当地市场采购，价格可能比在专卖店购买更便宜。此处发表的意见并不代表《Vanguard》报或该报任何员工的观点

https://dailytrust.com/bichi-power-will-.body: Chairman of the House of Representatives Committee on Appropriations, Rep. Abubakar Bichi, has urged Northerners to support President Bola Tinubu’s re-election bid, saying power will return to the region after the president completes his constitutionally permitted second term. Bichi said the North should allow the South to complete its eight-year tenure before power shifts back to the region. The lawmaker, who represents Bichi Federal Constituency of Kano State, stated this in an interview with the News Agency of Nigeria (NAN) in Dutse, Jigawa State, on Sunday. He argued that the North had already enjoyed eight years in power under former President Muhammadu Buhari, while the South had so far served four years under Tinubu. “What is the magic? We have done our eight years under the late former President Muhammadu Buhari. Now they have done their four years; let them finish so that we can move on. “Let President Tinubu finish his second term, then power will come back to the North as well. President Tinubu loves the North, and he has done well for the region,” he said. Bichi also dismissed claims that Tinubu had neglected Northern Nigeria, insisting that the region had benefited significantly from the administration’s policies, infrastructure projects and other interventions. He described the growing support for Tinubu’s re-election in the North as impressive, saying the turnout at the All Progressives Congress (APC) presidential campaign rallies reflected the people’s satisfaction with the administration. “Contrary to claims in some quarters that Tinubu does not care about the North, the president has demonstrated commitment to the development of the region through major infrastructure and other intervention projects. “The turnout of people from the North is impressive, and it is a clear testimony that the people are happy with what Tinubu has done so far. “President Bola Tinubu has performed credibly in the North, and there is no state that has been left out,” he said. Citing Jigawa as an example, the lawmaker said Tinubu had approved about N80bn for the Greater Dutse Water Project to address one of the state’s major developmental challenges. He also highlighted ongoing and completed road projects in the state, particularly the Kano-Hadejia road, which he said spans approximately 200 kilometres. According to him, the Kano-Danja section has been completed, while work on the Danja-Hadejia stretch has reached about 80 per cent completion. Bichi further said several irrigation projects had been completed in Jigawa, describing the interventions as evidence of the Federal Government’s commitment to infrastructure development and agriculture in the region. “As Chairman of the House Committee on Appropriations, I know what President Tinubu has done in many parts of the North, and it is fantastic,” he said. He listed Kano, Jigawa, Katsina, Sokoto, Kebbi and Zamfara among the states that had benefited from the president’s development initiatives. The lawmaker expressed confidence that the people of Kano would appreciate Tinubu’s contributions, promising to provide further details of projects executed in the state. He urged Northerners to reciprocate what he described as the president’s commitment to the region by supporting his administration and recognising its achievements. “It is time for the people of the North to pay back what President Tinubu has done for us,” he said. Bichi maintained that Tinubu’s performance should be assessed beyond political affiliations, urging residents of the region to support the president in completing his tenure. https://dailytrust.com/bichi-power-will-.title_zh: Bichi：Tinubu第二任期结束后，北部将恢复供电
https://dailytrust.com/bichi-power-will-.body_zh: 众议院拨款委员会主席、议员阿布巴卡尔·比奇呼吁北部地区支持总统博拉·蒂努布连任竞选，称总统完成宪法允许的第二任期后，权力将重返该地区。比奇说，北方应让南方完成八年任期，之后权力再转回北方。这位代表卡诺州比奇联邦选区的议员于周日在吉贾瓦州杜塞接受尼日利亚新闻社（NAN）采访时表示。他指出，在前总统穆罕马杜·布哈里执政时期，北方已经享有八年执政权，而南方在蒂努布领导下目前仅执政四年。他说：“这有什么神奇的？在已故前总统穆罕马杜·布哈里领导下，我们已经完成了八年任期。现在他们也完成了四年；让他们做完，这样我们才能继续前进。‘让蒂努布总统完成第二任期，权力也会回到北方。蒂努布总统热爱北方，也为该地区做出了良好成绩。’比奇还否定了有关蒂努布忽视尼日利亚北方的说法，坚持认为该地区从政府的政策、基础设施项目及其他干预措施中获得了显著益处。他形容北方对蒂努布连任的支持不断增长，令人印象深刻，并称全进步大会党（APC）总统竞选集会的出席人数反映了民众对本届政府的满意。他说：“与某些方面声称蒂努布不关心北方相反，总统通过大型基础设施和其他干预项目，展示了推动该地区发展的决心。‘北方民众的参与人数令人印象深刻，这清楚证明民众对蒂努布迄今取得的成就感到满意。‘博拉·蒂努布总统在北方表现出色，没有任何一个州被排除在外。’这名议员以吉贾瓦州为例说，蒂努布已批准约N80bn，用于大杜塞供水项目，以解决该州面临的主要发展挑战之一。他还强调，该州有多项道路项目正在推进或已经完工，尤其是卡诺—哈代贾公路，其全长约为200公里。据他介绍，卡诺—丹贾路段已经完工，丹贾—哈代贾路段的施工完成度约为80%。比奇进一步表示，吉贾瓦州已经完成多个灌溉项目，并称这些干预措施证明联邦政府致力于推动该地区的基础设施建设和农业。他说：“作为众议院拨款委员会主席，我了解蒂努布总统在北方许多地区所做的工作，而且成效非常出色。”他列举了卡诺、吉贾瓦、卡齐纳、索科托、凯比和赞法拉等州，称这些州均从总统的发展举措中受益。这位议员相信，卡诺州民众会认可蒂努布的贡献，并承诺进一步介绍该州已实施项目的详细情况。他敦促北方民众通过支持本届政府、认可其成就，来回报他所称的总统对北方的付出。他说：“现在正是北方民众回报蒂努布总统为我们所做之事的时候了。”比奇坚持认为，对蒂努布施政表现的评估不应局限于政治立场，并呼吁该地区居民支持总统完成任期。加入《每日信任报》WhatsApp社区，快速获取身边的新闻与动态
